chapters.title: Chapter 701 - 690: The Annihilation of Ten Thousand Spirits
paragraphs: What if he doesn’t walk away?
Would Mo Kui meet the same fate as the Twelve Sword Stars?
"Still hesitating!"

Ding Ling originally intended to subdue Mo Kui, making him the Sword Spirit of the Giant Que Sword. After all, Mo Kui was exceptionally strong. If he became the Sword Spirit, the Giant Que Sword would surely transform into a peerless Demon Sword!

But with Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill at full level, just a few glances at Mo Kui revealed his untamable nature, highly rebellious, and if weaker, he might even backstab the sword bearer at any time.
In that case.
Ding Ling snorted; the next instant, a torrent of Spirit Killing Sword plunged from the sky, crashing into Wuming’s Sea of Consciousness with a roar, targeting Mo Kui.
Mo Kui sensed it, roared in anger, and fought desperately, but was still annihilated by the ninety-fold augmented torrent of Spirit Killing Sword.
Profound Yin Sword Armor!
With a thought, Ding Ling activated the Sword Armor, which followed the Spirit Killing Sword torrent, protecting Wuming’s Sea of Consciousness.
In the Sea of Consciousness, chaos reigned, as if it would collapse and shatter at any moment, but stabilized immediately with the entry of the Profound Yin Sword Armor.
Whoosh!
Mo Kui was annihilated, leaving behind a stream of light like a meteor tail.
It was swallowed by the Sword Spirit in one gulp.
In an instant.
A Demon Dao Swordsmanship technique entered Ding Ling’s mind, and upon a brief recollection, he mastered it at full level.
[Agility +0.6]
It was a Shattering Level skill.
Ding Ling scanned the other Sword Spirits in the Sword Pool, and without further thought, another torrent of Spirit Killing Sword spread over it.
Pop! Pop!
One by one, Residual Spirits vanished like bubbles, destroyed and gone.
One after another, beams of Spiritual Light appeared in the depths and above of the Sword Pool.
The Sword Spirit emerged from Wuming’s Sea of Consciousness, opened its mouth, and sucked in the rolling Spiritual Light.
Then.
[Dragon Flash Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Agility +0.2]
[Mountain Guardian Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Agility +0.3]
[Yuefei Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Longhu Swordsmanship Full Level]
[Inverted Scale Piercing Sword Full Level]
[Thrusting Sword Skill Full Level]
The Sword Pool was like a Sword Sea, the Residual Spirits within countless.
Ding Ling wiped out tens of thousands in one breath.
The sword skills obtained exceeded eight thousand.
Though over ninety percent of the sword skills could not provide Attribute Points.
The tiny portion that did provide Agility Points.
Resulted in an agility increase of +10.2 overall.
[Agility: 149.8]
Unknowingly, agility was approaching the world’s limit value.
In addition.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Progress: 21%]
Previously, it was 5%.
It jumped a full sixteen percentage points.
This gain came from acquiring the Ten Thousand Dao Forest, Profound Yin Twelve Swords, Wudang Secret Skill, Demon Dao Swordsmanship, and the myriad of sword skills just collected!
The Ten Thousand Dao Forest, Profound Yin Twelve Swords, and Demon Dao Swordsmanship were all considered world-class Supreme Skills, the other Wudang Secret Skills were also of exceptional quality.
Thus, this sudden 16% advance.
"Excellent."
Ding Ling surveyed the Sword Sea.
Perhaps because too many spirits were slain.
Ding Ling could no longer find other spirits easily.
He didn’t bother looking anymore.
Instead, he turned to explore other areas of the Sword Realm to slay spirits.
Regrettably.
Most of the spirits in other regions were in forms like Sword Scorpions and Sword Crocodiles, and the sword skills obtained were basically the same as those from the Sword Pool.
For instance, the Sword Crocodile.
Several were slain in the Sword Pool, yielding the ’Sword Crocodile Escape Swordsmanship’; killing more Sword Crocodiles resulted in the same swordsmanship.
This showed the swordsmanship was unique to this species.
Other species displayed similar traits.
Ding Ling had essentially slain them all in the Sword Sea.
He couldn’t be bothered to kill more.
Since it was pointless to kill them.
He turned towards the Sword Mountain territory, releasing the Sword Spirit.
Whoosh!
The Sword Spirit opened its mouth, devouring the Spiritual Light, its aura visibly skyrocketing.
It seemed it wouldn’t take long.
The Sword Spirit would reach the Peak of Great Perfection.
By then.
It should be enough to step into the Grain Avoidance Realm as a Sword Spirit, able to live freely between heaven and earth without needing to consume Sword Thought, etc., for sustenance.
"Zhang Sanfeng."
The Sword Spirit was the lord of this domain; through its eyes, Ding Ling saw everything clearly.
In the far realm, Zhang Sanfeng was still sitting cross-legged, surrounded by rotating Dao Rhyme, his aura and realm had risen to an extraordinarily high level.
"Truly a prodigy of the ages."
Ding Ling marveled silently, standing in place as he waited for the Sword Spirit to finish devouring the Spiritual Light.
He inquired of Wuming about Bai Suzhen.
Wuming provided more detail than Little Zhao had.
But the details were still limited.
Ding Ling had become much stronger now, the Sword Spirit had also stepped into the Realm of Great Perfection, allowing him to see far into the Sword Realm through the Sword Spirit’s eyes.
He once again spotted the serpent-shaped gap.
"Bai Suzhen was taken by a spirit in the form of a python into that serpent-shaped gap?"
Ding Ling was uncertain and curious.
Bai Suzhen...
A python?
He thought of "New Legend of White Snake".
But this Bai Suzhen was clearly not that Bai Suzhen, why was she involved with the Snake Spirit?
Ding Ling was puzzled, glanced at the Sword Spirit, instructed Wuming to stay put, and then took Little Zhao’s hand, their figures shifting as the landscapes flashed beneath their feet.
Moments later.
Ding Ling arrived at the side of the serpent-shaped gap.
"Hiss hiss!"
Giant python spirits emerged and hissed at Ding Ling, their eyes glaring fiercely as if ready to devour anyone.
Ding Ling’s wrist turned slightly, the Emperor’s Sword unsheathed with a clang!
A Sword Qi extended a thousand feet, and with a crack!
Hundreds of Snake Spirits were instantly annihilated.
Various beams of Spiritual Light wavered in the void.
Ding Ling captured them, and the next instant, they merged into his body.
Granting him mastery of another skill.
[Snake Technique Full Level]
[Agility +0.2]
It was a technique related to speed used by the Snake Spirits.
All these Snake Spirits knew this skill.
Thus, despite many being slaughtered, only this one skill was obtained.
"Should I go in and take a look."
After exterminating all the Snake Spirits.
Ding Ling paused at the serpent-shaped gap, peering inside.
A blood moon hung in the sky, enveloped in mist with occasionally bizarre, twisted figures darting through it.

Beneath the high sky, the ground was filled with withered wood like a forest, clusters of rotting God Grass, and the smell of decay continuously assaulted Ding Ling’s nose, exceedingly foul beyond compare.
"What kind of ghostly place is this? Connected to the Sword Realm?!"
Ding Ling was puzzled, thinking a bit, he decided to enter this realm. After all, Bai Suzhen was a rare friend he couldn’t ignore.
Thus.
He instructed Little Zhao to wait in place before entering this world.
Profound Yin Sword Armor!
Upon entering, Ding Ling immediately activated the armor.
The Sword Armor’s protection was unparalleled in the world, and being ninety-fold augmented, its might was boundless to the extreme.
Ding Ling didn’t believe anyone could breach this sword armor quickly.
Ding Ling had numerous Body Protection Skills.
But the Emperor’s Sword could only enhance skills and techniques related to Sword Intent and Sword Qi.
Therefore.
Ding Ling could only use the Spirit Killing Sword, Profound Yin Sword Armor, and other sword-related skills and techniques.
Click, click!
As Ding Ling stepped into this realm.
The whole world seemed to boil over.
Countless bizarre creatures surged towards him as if to submerge and destroy him.

chapters.title: Chapter 702 - 691: Demon Realm
paragraphs: Ding Ling let out a cold snort, the Emperor’s Sword trembled, and strands of Emperor’s Sword Qi shot out.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
The sword qi surged northward, like a mighty river sweeping through the void. Amidst the clangor of clashing sharp weapons, thud thud! One mysterious creature after another was pierced and destroyed.
This world is likely connected to the Sword Realm.
Thus, when these mysterious creatures are destroyed, strands of spiritual light also appear.
Ding Ling used the Dragon Capturing Skill to grasp all these spiritual lights, absorbing them into his body.
Then.
[Snake Dance Skill Full Level]
[Agility +0.2]
[Snake Swallowing Skill Full Level]
[Agility +0.2]
More than a dozen snake-related techniques, all at full level.
"Have I fallen into the world of snakes?"
Being close.
Ding Ling could see very clearly.
Those twisted, root-like mysterious creatures were, in fact, snake spirits of varying sizes!
These snake spirits generally only possessed the level of a Grandmaster.
Though any one of them falling into the Jiuzhou world could cause countless casualties and endless disaster for the people of Jiuzhou.
But in Ding Ling’s eyes, they were nothing more than ants to be easily crushed.
With the ninety-fold increase.
Groups of snake spirits comparable to Grandmasters were all destroyed.

Ding Ling trod the Free-Will Ascension Step, moving like a gentle breeze, walking through this world at great speed, a thousand feet in an instant, disappearing from Little Zhao’s sight and heading into the unknown depths of the world.
Little Zhao was somewhat anxious.
Several times she wanted to move forward into this world.

But recalling Ding Ling’s instructions, she could only suppress her myriad strange thoughts, activate the Profound Yin Sword Armor to protect herself, surrounded by swirling sword qi, any approaching snake spirit would be sliced into pieces with a clang.
This Profound Yin Sword Armor not only protected the body and spirit but could also attack both physically and mentally, making it an unparalleled skill.
"Young Master. Why hasn’t he returned yet?"
Little Zhao waited for several hours.
Just as she was growing anxious, Ding Ling arrived beside her, treading on strands of sword qi like a streaming light with a whizzing sound, and said to her:
"Let’s go."
"Young Master. What about the Elder?"
Little Zhao peeked behind Ding Ling, not seeing the Demon Lord Bai Suzhen.
"She found her own opportunity and is undergoing a rapid transformation."
Thinking of the Heaven-Ascending Path that Bai Suzhen had described in detail, Ding Ling felt quite complicated.
The world he had just entered was the famous Demon Realm from the ancient era!
It was a battle between demons, mortals, and gods.

That led to the collapse of the Demon Realm, falling from the Ninefold Heaven, and the creatures living there at the time were all killed by an unparalleled divine power, leaving the Demon Realm unguarded and eventually near collapse, having no choice but to attach itself to the Sword Realm to exist!
After attaching to the Sword Realm.
The deceased creatures of the Demon Realm formed into many ’spirits.’
These spirits, many of which fell into the Sword Realm, formed into ’Sword Scorpions,’ Sword Crocodiles, Swordfish, Sword Tigers, the Twelve Sword Stars, and so on as spiritual objects.
Indeed.
The Twelve Sword Stars are also the spirits of the Demon Realm.
And they were also the renowned Twelve Demon Gods of the Demon Realm!
Everyone was skilled with the sword!
A single sword could change the color of the world.

When the Twelve Demon Gods existed, the Demon Realm was at its peak. Unfortunately, a battle between demons, mortals, and gods not only led to the collapse of the Demon Realm, but the fall of the Divine Realm as well!
And the Twelve Demon Gods naturally also perished in that battle, nearly annihilated in soul.

If the Demon Realm had not timely attached to the Sword Realm, the residual thoughts of the Twelve Demon Gods would never have had the opportunity to become the Twelve Sword Stars, but would have faded into nothing with the passage of time.
Ding Ling explained the truth to Little Zhao.
Little Zhao was surprised and stunned:
"No wonder the Twelve Sword Stars felt so mysterious and powerful. They seem to know a lot yet were unclear about their own origins. So this is the reason."
"Indeed."
Ding Ling nodded:

"The Twelve Sword Stars are the ’transformation of the residual thoughts of the Demon Gods after death,’ and I estimate Mo Kui is the transformation of the residual thought of a Demon God from the Demon Realm. Whereas Jian Yue is the transformation of the complete spirit of a peerless genius from the Human Realm. Only the spirit of complete soul has the chance to gather the Light of Dawn and form a Domain Crystal."
Mo Kui also did not have a Domain Crystal.
And the Domain Crystal can be used by multiple people.
If Ding Ling reaches the Peak of Sword Spirit Great Perfection.
The Domain Crystal will be of little use to him as well.
At that time.
He could grant the Domain Crystal to Little Zhao, assisting her in reaching a higher level of strength.
Now Little Zhao, with her Perfect Supreme Sword Bone, if she also produces a Sword Spirit, she would undoubtedly become a Sword God with limitless potential!
Ding Ling originally considered entrusting Jiuzhou to Nie Feng and others.
But now, seeing Little Zhao, Ding Ling had a new idea. Although Nie Feng and others were good, they still needed time to grow.

However, Little Zhao, by a fortunate coincidence, had her strength greatly enhanced by the Twelve Sword Stars, now already a being of Great God Level. If she also gives birth to a Sword Spirit Body, Little Zhao’s future would undoubtedly be limitless.
"What about the elder Bai Suzhen? Is she not leaving the Demon Realm?"
"She needs to wait for a while."
Ding Ling glanced back at the depths of the Demon Realm.
He saw endless, countless corpses of the demon race.
And somehow, Bai Suzhen was extremely compatible with one of these demon corpses, using its power to absorb the essence, blood, and demon qi of the entire Demon Realm’s demon corpses!
If she succeeds in one day.
When Bai Suzhen emerges.
She will surely become a peerless demon lord of her generation!
"The elder transformed from a demon to a demon?"
Little Zhao was astonished.
"She remains herself. Regardless of her transformation."
Ding Ling’s harvest in the Demon Realm was considerable.
He killed numerous spirits.
These spirits consisted of not only snake spirits but also various other residual spirits from the Demon Realm.
They were bizarre existences that couldn’t enter the Sword Spirit.
The reason they couldn’t enter the Sword Realm.
Ding Ling surmised it was because these spirits didn’t understand Sword Skills!
The Sword Realm is very pure.
Purity dictates that only the residual thoughts, residual souls, etc., that understand swords can enter for transformation and sublimation.
[Tiger Roar Technique Full Level]
[Wolf King Howling at the Moon Skill Full Level]
[Leopard God Flashing Technique Full Level]
There were a total of more than fifty related skills.
All were residual spirits. And all were the skills of tribal spirit bodies formed by groups of various clans.
Therefore, every clan’s inheritance was about the same.
Killing a group or one yields the same skills.
Even so.
It greatly enriched Ding Ling’s foundation, giving him considerable understanding of the techniques used by the demon race.
In essence, it was not much different from humans.
Only that the demons focused on demon power, while humans relied on true power and inner strength.
Of course, there were the Twelve Demon Gods, who practiced Sword Techniques and Sword Skills, mastering Sword Intent and Sword Power as special demon beings.
They fell into the Sword Pool Land.
Many had already been slain by Ding Ling.
"Demon Realm, Divine Realm, Demon Realm... "
Once again, Ding Ling thought of the Heaven-Ascending Path that Bai Suzhen had depicted.

And all were the skills of tribal spirit bodies formed by groups of various clans.
Therefore, every clan’s inheritance was about the same.
Killing a group or one yields the same skills.
Even so.
It greatly enriched Ding Ling’s foundation, giving him considerable understanding of the techniques used by the demon race.
In essence, it was not much different from humans.
Only that the demons focused on demon power, while humans relied on true power and inner strength.
Of course, there were the Twelve Demon Gods, who practiced Sword Techniques and Sword Skills, mastering Sword Intent and Sword Power as special demon beings.
They fell into the Sword Pool Land.
Many had already been slain by Ding Ling.
"Demon Realm, Divine Realm, Demon Realm...
Once again, Ding Ling thought of the Heaven-Ascending Path that Bai Suzhen had depicted.

chapters.title: Chapter 703 - 692: Lower Realm
paragraphs: Ding Ling decided to wait until reaching the Peak of Sword Spirit Great Perfection before returning to Jiuzhou of the Human World. After finishing the affairs of Jiuzhou, he would then set off for the Heaven-Ascending Path.
"Ding Ling, do not rashly step onto the Heaven-Ascending Path before you have absolute strength, lest you be targeted by the gods!"
This was Bai Suzhen’s advice:
"I didn’t want to tell you before because I was afraid you’d be too impulsive, too curious. Now I can’t leave, and I don’t know when I’ll be able to, so I’m telling you everything.
Ding Ling, you are the hope of Jiuzhou, the legendary divine being who will help the people break through the calamity!
I believe with you here, everything will pass peacefully and smoothly..."
Bai Suzhen’s words still echoed in his ears.
Ding Ling sighed deeply, held Little Zhao’s hand, and returned to the Sword Mountain territory.
He waited for about two hours.
The Sword Spirit had absorbed enough spiritual light and reached the Great Perfection Peak state!
The soaring sword intent and sword qi unexpectedly became restrained and unadorned!
The Sword Spirit stood beside Ding Ling, looking even more like him.
Wuming and Little Zhao turned their eyes sideways, deeply moved.
The Sword Spirit then took a Domain Crystal from its dantian and handed it to Little Zhao, instructing her to seclude herself here and have Wuming accompany her.
The Domain Crystal has the effect of stabilizing the spirit body.
But now that the Sword Spirit has reached the Great Perfection Peak state, its spirit body is extremely stable, so whether or not it has the Domain Crystal doesn’t matter much to the Sword Spirit.
Furthermore, the limit of this Domain Crystal is to elevate the Sword Spirit to the Great Perfection Peak state.
Beyond this?
What path can the Sword Spirit take?
Ding Ling didn’t know, but since the Domain Crystal was ineffective for him, he didn’t have any reason to harbor it without helping his allies.

He explained the Domain Crystal’s effects to Little Zhao and told her that in a few days, he would come to see her, hoping that by then, her Sword Spirit would be born and reach the Realm of Perfection.
After finishing giving his instructions.
Ding Ling slashed open the Sword Realm with a sword and descended to the Lower Realm.
This time.
Since he set off from Sword Mountain, he landed near the Celestial Sect.
"Master."

The Divine Calculator had been staying in the dense forest not far from the Celestial Sect. At this moment, he suddenly saw a huge gap tearing open in the void and was startled. Looking again, he saw Ding Ling holding Xiaao Aoshi’s Emperor’s Divine Sword, standing like a god in mid-air.
His mind turned, realizing that Xiaao Aoshi must have been defeated, and he could not help but be delighted. He immediately rushed out and paid great respect to Ding Ling.
Ding Ling nodded and said:
"Apart from you? Where are the others?"
"Mingyue has already headed south to find Nie Feng. As for the Great Divine Official, she also decided to join you, so she went south with Mingyue to fight for you across the land and seas."
"Oh?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows slightly:
"What about the other treasures of the Celestial Sect?"
"I hid them all."
The Divine Calculator respectfully said:

"You’ve been gone for many days without returning. I was really worried, but had no other way, so I first went to the Void Sacred Realm and brought back the secret treasures, great medicine, medicinal wine, and secret manuals that I could find, and hid them in one place, just for your easy return and usage.
"You did well."
Ding Ling praised.
The Divine Calculator sighed with relief and couldn’t help but smile:
"I was also afraid that Emperor Shitian would suddenly return, so I acted very cautiously."
The Divine Calculator began to refer to himself as a minister.
It seems that he has completely recognized Ding Ling’s status as the New Emperor of Jiuzhou and has begun to regard himself as a minister.
"Emperor Shitian?"
Speaking of Emperor Shitian, Ding Ling casually asked:
"Have you seen him lately?"
"No."
The Divine Calculator focused and said:
"I have used all means and connections recently, collaborating with experts from Unrivaled City, the World Association and other places, but have been unable to find Emperor Shitian’s whereabouts."
"Your divination skill?"

’I know my fortune is shallow, and I dare not recklessly use this skill. Moreover, Emperor Shitian’s abilities are much higher than mine, and he also knows some divination skill. Even if I calculate correctly once, he might sense it and run away.’
Ding Ling asked no more.
Divination skill, this thing.
It’s fine for predicting the past and some ordinary people’s information points.
If it involves people with a majestic Qi fortune, forcing a calculation involves too high a risk of backlash and celestial punishment, making it not worthwhile, like a chicken rib.
So Ding Ling naturally did not make things difficult for the Divine Calculator.
Instead, he asked him to lead the way to the place where the great medicine was hidden.
"Yes. Please follow me, Master."
The Divine Calculator led the way.
Walking swiftly all the way.
In a natural cave fifty miles outside the Celestial Sect, there were many secret manuals and treasures hidden.
Ding Ling went straight forward and consumed the great medicine.
There was a lot of great medicine.
All were three or four hundred years old or more.
There were more than a thousand plants.
Even so, Emperor Shitian himself used a lot for refining beast medicine, longevity medicine, etc., otherwise there would be even more.
Ding Ling ate them all.
The progress of the War God Technique accelerated once again.
This time it reached about 67% progress.
Ding Ling then drank the medicinal wine.
Most of the medicinal wine was poisonous.
It is evident that Emperor Shitian must have had a physique that was immune to hundreds of poisons, not fearing ordinary venom.
Ding Ling was naturally also fearless, gulping down one jar after another of medicinal wine.
He drank as many as five hundred jars of liquor.
The progress of the War God Technique increased to 72%.
By reaching this point.
Ding Ling’s self-healing ability, endurance, resistance, etc., all improved significantly.
Not only that, but the power that could be exerted was stronger, more forceful, more concentrated!
A mere fraction of strength.
Now it can easily achieve three or four times the effect.
This is the War God Technique!
A divine technique born for battle!
After eating and drinking.
Ding Ling began to read the secret manuals.
There were as many as tens of thousands of secret manuals, all in all.
Most of them were second-rate or above secret manuals, an amount that was truly vast, indicating that Emperor Shitian usually read a lot of secret manuals.
He wanted to create the Holy Heart Technique, so naturally, he needed to read extensively, and these secret manuals were the foundation for it.
Not a single one was duplicated.
All were extremely exquisite techniques and laws.
Ding Ling spent two days reading them all.
As expected.
His agility increased quite a bit.
Moreover, this time it directly pushed his agility up to 160 points.
"Agility has also reached the world’s limit!"
Previously in the Demon Realm, he increased his agility significantly by killing many residual spirits and acquiring a lot of secret skills.
Now, after reading these, his agility naturally reached the limit point with ease.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Three-legged Progress: 31%]
It was 21% before.
An increase of 10 points.
Despite the fact that many secret manuals were read, and many top-notch skills were obtained in the Demon Realm.
But compared to absolute top-notch skills and laws like the Ten Thousand Dao Forest and the Profound Yin Twelve Swords, these secret manuals were still far inferior, so it only improved by 10 points.
That said.
But it wasn’t insignificant, considering they were all Emperor Shitian’s collection of secret manuals, and the quality wasn’t poor.
Ding Ling glanced at the relics collected by Emperor Shitian.
There were many precious meteorite irons and other strange items.
Any one of these would be enough to make most martial artists in the Lower Realm fight fiercely for it.

chapters.title: Chapter 704 - 693: Guan Yu vs. Fujimura Celestial Concealment
paragraphs: After all, the secret treasures here, even the most ordinary meteorite iron can forge a treasure saber no less than the Dragon-slaying Saber!
No need to mention the other secret treasures.
Swords like the Heaven-Swaying Sword, there are hundreds of such Divine Weapons!
But once Ding Ling acquired the Emperor’s Sword, Xuanyuan Sword, Snow-Drinking Saber, Greed Wolf Sword, and other top-tier Divine Weapons, he no longer paid attention to such ordinary blades.
Even so, these weapons are quite suitable for his subordinates.
Ding Ling never thought of destroying these Divine Weapons.

After all, compared to the materials of the Snow-Drinking Saber, these are far inferior; even if he forges another Divine Weapon in the future, he will use materials of the same level as the Snow-Drinking Saber!
Divine Weapons of other materials would just shatter in front of the Snow-Drinking Saber, Emperor’s Sword, and Xuanyuan Sword, making them fairly meaningless to wield.
Just like the Giant Que Sword or Drumming Golden Hammer, which were once considered top-tier Divine Weapons, they pale in comparison to the Xuanyuan Sword.
Therefore.
Ding Ling straightforwardly took out the Drumming Golden Hammer, picked some top-quality materials and secret treasures, and put them into the Storage Pouch.
Previously, when the Drumming Golden Hammer was placed in the Storage Pouch, it was too large to fit much else inside.
Now that it was taken out.
The Storage Pouch suddenly had much more space.
And because there were two Storage Pouches, Ding Ling managed to fill quite a lot of good things inside.
"Let’s go."
Seeing the abundance of treasures here, Ding Ling remarked:
"Later, have someone collect these things and send them to the Imperial Palace Treasury."
"Yes, Master."
The Divine Calculator respectfully responded, then inquired: "Where does Master intend to set the capital?"
"Luoyang!"
"Yes, Minister. I will certainly get it done."
At dusk.
Ding Ling headed south.
Passing through Unrivaled City, the moon was already high in the sky.
Yet, outside Unrivaled City, tension was mounting, Evil Qi filled the sky!
Upon close inspection.
It was Guan Yu wielding a saber at the front of a military formation, fiercely battling a master.
The fight was intense between them.
But clearly, Guan Yu was not the opponent.
As he was about to be defeated and seriously injured.
Guan Yu suddenly retreated a step, letting out a furious roar, and fiercely slashed out with his saber!
With this slash.
The world turned bright.
Ordinary people couldn’t even see the saber’s movement trajectory; even seeing the saber light was difficult, and in just an instant, the once invincible adversary dispersed like clouds and mist.
"Huff, huff!"
Guan Yu leaned on his saber, standing in place, gasping for breath.
"Such a remarkable move, City-Overturning Love!"
A tall, burly man, exuding a fierce aura, walked out, clapping and praising:

"I’ve long heard Martial Saint Guan Yu’s City-Overturning Love is unparalleled in the world, rarely matched. Now having witnessed it, it is indeed extraordinary. You even managed to kill the Sect Leader of Japan’s great faction, Hidden Sword Style’s Fujimura Celestial Concealment, with just one slash. This battle alone immortalizes your reputation, Guan Yu. However..."
He paused, his aura suddenly exploding as he roared:
"Your good days are over! Today, not only you, but everyone in Unrivaled City must die!"
Boom!
The sound echoed.
He suddenly punched towards Guan Yu.
Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities!
Thunder Strike Fist!
The instant this punch launched, thunder filled the void, booming towards Guan Yu, seemingly trying to crush him into dust.
"Despicable!"

Zhang Wuji shouted angrily, leaping forward, Nine Yang Divine Skill shielding him, reaching out a palm towards the thunder, but before he could approach, he got blasted tens of yards away by the force of the fist, spitting out blood relentlessly in mid-air, severely injured in an instant.
"Zhang Wuji (Husband, Wuji child...)"
Duann Lang, Shangguan Jinhong, Zhao Min, Xie Xun, and others couldn’t help but cry out.
Seeing no one could withstand that punch.
Guan Yu was about to be killed here.
Everyone showed expressions of grief and fury, their bodies trembling, yet feeling utterly powerless and helpless.
They all had fought, but now they were done.
With Guan Yu and Zhang Wuji left for the final showdown, and Zhang Wuji unable to withstand the Great Demon God’s fist force, let alone confront and clash!
While Guan Yu’s strongest move is City-Overturning Love, since he used it now, he cannot perform it a second time. The Great Demon God seized the moment to strike, how could Guan Yu resist?
Thinking that if Guan Yu dies, they all might die here too.
Duann Lang, Shangguan Jinhong, and the group couldn’t help but sigh:
"To die with unfulfilled ambition! It’s truly regrettable!"
As they prepared to accept their fate, suddenly from the night sky, at the Celestial Pole Position, a sword light shot forth.
Boom!
In just an instant, the Thunder Strike Fist dispersed!
"What?!"
The Great Demon God was shocked, disbelief all over his face, instinctively looking up, seeing a figure suddenly flashing into view.
It was a young man.
He stood in the void, his attire fluttering in the fierce wind.
Vast and mighty, profound as a mountain, bearing the dignity of a Grandmaster.
Such an extraordinary individual turned out to be a youngster!
The Great Demon God was moved:
"Who is here!"
"Prince!"
Guan Yu’s eyes shone brightly, his heart delighted beyond measure, his tense heart and spirit instantly relaxed, his whole being unable to withstand, and with a thud, he collapsed to the ground.

Previously, he had fought the top expert of Hidden Sword Style, Fujimura Celestial Concealment for a hundred rounds, supported by the Supreme Blade Intent granting occasional bursts of strength; otherwise, he might have been killed by Fujimura Celestial Concealment long ago.
Though he eventually explosively killed Fujimura Celestial Concealment.
His energy was utterly spent. He could only stand with fervent blood and indomitable spirit.
"Venerable Lord!"
"It’s Venerable Lord!"
Duann Lang was ecstatic, as if divine help had arrived, couldn’t help but exclaim, paying respect to Ding Ling.
Shangguan Jinhong also showed joy.

Zhao Min was visibly shaken. She knew how strong her husband Zhang Wuji was, more than anyone else, yet the supposedly unbeatable Zhang Wuji couldn’t handle the fist force, but Ding Ling casually broke through it with a strike, crushing that thunder force. Such incredible prowess!
Too extraordinary!
No wonder he is...
"Venerable Lord!"
Zhao Min’s heart was filled with reverence, she started addressing Ding Ling as Venerable Lord, like Duann Lang and others.

Supported by Zhao Min, Zhang Wuji stood up, watching Ding Ling, celestial and saint-like, descending from the void, besides admiration, he was full of envy. How could Ding Ling, at such a young age, possess such powerful martial arts, while facing a formidable enemy, still be able to freely descend? How many others could achieve that?
"You must be the City Lord of Unrivaled City, the new Emperor of Jiuzhou, the human foremost mentioned by the Alien, Ding Ling!"
The Great Demon God tensed, shouting.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling slightly spun the Emperor’s Sword in his hand.

How many others could achieve that?
"You must be the City Lord of Unrivaled City, the new Emperor of Jiuzhou, the human foremost mentioned by the Alien, Ding Ling!"
The Great Demon God tensed, shouting.
"Indeed."
Ding Ling slightly spun the Emperor’s Sword in his hand.

chapters.title: Chapter 705 - 694: Great Demon God
paragraphs: "Are you the Great Demon God?"
"That’s what the world calls me."
The Great Demon God said:
"In fact, I have another name—Xiaao Jingtian!"
He glanced at the sword in Ding Ling’s hand, and once he looked, he couldn’t tear his gaze away:
"The Emperor’s Sword! How did my brother’s Emperor’s Sword end up in your hands!"

"The Emperor’s Sword was unearthed from within the Sword Sect by The Smiling, Proud Wanderer. In essence, it could still be considered a relic of the Sword Sect, how could it be claimed as your brother’s sword?"
Ding Ling glanced behind the Great Demon God, seeing a dense crowd of Japanese ninjas, swordsmen, and swordmen, each full of spirit, with sharp eyes like wolves in the night poised to devour someone!
At this moment, besides their sharpness, their eyes also held alertness and tension, clearly indicating that they were intimidated by Ding Ling’s recent sword strike.
"Did you bring your entire force from Japan this time?"
Ding Ling said expressionlessly:
"Last time, the elite of the World Association was slaughtered entirely; was it not you, the Great Demon God, who did it?"
"It wasn’t me."
The Great Demon God replied coldly:
"This is the first time in recent years that I have set foot in the Central Plains. What bullshit World Association, is it worth me, the Great Demon God, to act personally?"
"Wasn’t you. That’s really strange."
Ding Ling sighed:

"The deaths of Qin Shuang and others clearly seemed like the work of someone possessing the Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities. How could it not be you? Dare to do but not admit. Xiaao Jingtian, you do not deserve to be the Great Demon God?"
Ding Ling was puzzled before.

But with his Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao reaching full level, he mastered the skills of Thunder Strike Fist, Mingyi Celestial Flame, and so on to a perfectly satisfying state. With a little thought, he realized that the deaths of Qin Shuang and others must have been due to the Thunderfire Power of the Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities, being brutally struck dead!
"As the Great Demon God, I keep my word, standing between heaven and earth! If I say I didn’t do it, I didn’t do it."
Xiaao Jingtian glared angrily at Ding Ling:
"You falsely accuse me. What is your ulterior motive? And anyway, I have killed countless people on my way here, even if the World Association was destroyed by me, so what?"
"That’s true."
Ding Ling nodded:
"I’ve indeed talked too much nonsense with you. In that case, go die."
As the words fell.
Ding Ling gave a shake of the Emperor’s Sword.
Emperor Sword Dao!
Whoosh!

A Sword Qi shot out from the Emperor’s Sword, with a ninety-fold amplified Sword Qi Sword Intent, reached Xiaao Jingtian in an instant like a thunderbolt. He only had time to instinctively dodge to the side, puff!
The Sword Qi grazed his shoulder, piercing through the void for a thousand meters, shooting through the group of Japanese ninjas, swordsmen, and swordmen like an aurora.
Just one sword strike!
Yet it instantly killed hundreds or even thousands of Japanese experts.

Some had their hearts pierced and died instantly, some had their shoulders pierced, fell to the ground, not dead but screaming in agony. The Emperor’s Sword Qi, after ninety-fold amplification, became extremely spiritual, once hitting a person, it would invade the person’s meridians and dantian everywhere, causing wanton destruction until that person died!
One sword rendered nearly a thousand experts powerless!
Everyone who saw this scene couldn’t help but gasp.
Especially seeing Ding Ling with an air of ease, clearly still having strength left, Duann Lang, Shangguan Jinhong, Zhao Min, Zhang Wuji, Guan Yu and the others were in extreme awe!
"It’s only been a short time since we last met. It seems the Venerable Lord has become much stronger again!"
Duann Lang’s heart trembled with joy, surprise, shock, and excitement:

"If I could seek a Secret Skill for rapid martial advancement from the Venerable Lord, wouldn’t I, Duann Lang, also hope to become a great and powerful person like the Venerable Lord in this lifetime?"
The World Association Gang Leader Xiong Ba, once perceived by Duann Lang as invincible and unmatched.
Now seemed really inferior!
Compared to his Venerable Lord, Xiong Ba was just an ant! To think Duann Lang had once earnestly hoped Xiong Ba would value him!
Not realizing Xiong Ba was just an insignificant grasshopper.
Once breaking free from that narrow well, following the Venerable Lord, Duann Lang then knew what was vision, glory, courage! What was a true master!
"You even learned my brother’s Emperor Sword Dao! How is that possible?!"
"Nothing is impossible."
With a twist of his wrist, Ding Ling’s Emperor’s Sword began shooting out sharp Sword Qi like a ’machine gun’.
The Sword Qi was like meteors cutting through the night!
Wherever it passed.
Everything was pierced, shattered, destroyed.
Trees, Japanese experts, small hills, giant rocks, thorns...
Nothing could stop the Emperor’s Sword Qi.
Anything that stood in the way was shattered to dust, easily pierced through.
"Ah!"
"Run!"
"Too strong!"
"He is not human!"

The Japanese experts screamed in terror and howled, not caring whether the Great Demon God Xiaao Jingtian would hold them accountable for fleeing the battle. They were all scared out of their wits, frantically scurrying away.
Like mortals facing a deity, they were powerless to resist, only able to passively await death.

The omnipresent sense of terror and panic surged in their hearts, and this feeling was magnified endlessly in the night, making it seem like the Death God could suddenly descend upon them at any moment to take them away. Their panic and trepidation explained their scattering and fleeing.
How could Ding Ling let this group of Japanese escape?
The speed of Emperor Sword Dao’s shooting increased.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Under the night sky.
Ding Ling stood firm, his feet unmoving from start to finish, just with a slight twist of his wrist, the Emperor’s Sword increasingly rapidly shot out brilliant, dazzling Sword Qi.
Even the night could not hide the Sword Qi’s immense, boundless radiance!
Wherever the Sword Qi passed.
It seemed to illuminate realms of darkness and deathly silence.
Yet soon.
With the rise of screams, these areas were covered by a misty, blood-red hue.
One by one, the Japanese experts were pierced through.
"Ah! I want you dead!"
Despite several furious roars, Xiaao Jingtian unleashed the power of wind, thunder, fire, and rain, attempting to kill Ding Ling.
Yet all were easily neutralized by Ding Ling’s Emperor Sword Qi.
After several tries.
Realizing they were futile.
He was horrified beyond belief, finding it unimaginable that such a powerful expert as Ding Ling could exist!
"Too powerful. This guy isn’t human!"
Xiaao Jingtian sensed staying here was certain death if targeted by Ding Ling, and he decisively transformed into a streak of lightning, fleeing.
How could Ding Ling let him escape?
With a sweep of his sword.
Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root!
Sword Qi filled the sky, forming a net of swords falling forward like cutting through tofu, amidst muffled thuds.
The last of the Japanese experts were all finished.
Then Ding Ling used Free-Will Ascension Step, shrinking inches at a wind-like speed, in a few instants, arriving first at the Great Demon God’s face.

chapters.title: Chapter 706 - 695: Proclaiming Himself Emperor
paragraphs: Ding Ling thrust his sword forward.
Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root!
As this sword was thrust out, the sky was filled with magnificent and fierce Sword Qi!
Densely packed, limitless and boundless!
In an instant, they completely engulfed the Great Demon God, Xiaao Jingtian.
This was a major move.
Extremely consuming of True Qi.
In a state of ninety-fold increase, Ding Ling would not easily use it, but now that he did, he instantly entirely covered the Great Demon God.
Crackle! Pop!
"Ah!"

The body of the Great Demon God suffered a brutal piercing and dismemberment. He felt an unprecedented surge of pain direct to his mind, suffering such agony like never before, he couldn’t help but feel panic, astonishment, fear, scream, and roar!
"Drizzling Frozen Rain!"
The Great Demon God looked at Ding Ling with a face full of hatred, suddenly roaring in anger:
"Go to hell!"
He had a premonition.
This time, he was doomed!
Ding Ling was too powerful.

Even though he had cultivated the Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities to the Realm of Perfection, at the night of the full moon, his power reached its peak, achieving an unbelievable Realm of Heaven and Earth!
Yet he was still being crushed by Ding Ling.
It’s imaginable if it were daytime when his power would leak, he would certainly be easily slain by Ding Ling!
Holding onto the belief of either success or death, the Great Demon God activated his entire power, continuously releasing two ultimate techniques.
"Overlord Thunder Shock!"
First, the move Drizzling Frozen Rain, under the moonlight, gathered Spiritual Vitality, transforming into rain that seemed able to freeze everything!
Following the Frozen Rain was Overlord Thunder Shock, darting through the gentle rain like lightning striking down towards Ding Ling’s head.
Yet it was futile.
Ding Ling merely activated the Profound Yin Sword Armor!

All attacks were easily blocked outside, the Great Demon God couldn’t believe it, he had reached the peak of the mortal realm, even his father he wasn’t afraid of, yet now he couldn’t even break Ding Ling’s defense.
"This is impossible!"
Boom!
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows and swung the Emperor’s Sword again!
Celestial Destiny Sword Dao!
Who Carries Out the King’s Will!

A brilliant Sword Qi capable of sweeping through the mortal realm quickly intermingled with the fierce Vigorous Qi of Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root. In a flash, it pierced through space and shot into the Great Demon God’s neck.
The Great Demon God flipped over to the ground, gasping heavily, as if wanting to say something, but the ensuing fierce Sword Qi immediately turned him into a sieve.
His heart was particularly targeted and directly shattered.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Great Demon God Xiaao Jingtian.]

[Note: The Great Demon God is one of the behind-the-scenes leaders pushing the Thousand-Year Tribulation, his power unparalleled, enough to overlook the mortal realm! He ventured into the Central Plains this time, thinking he could easily crush all forces and completely plunge the Central Plains into blood and fire. He even specifically staged to divert Xiaao Sanxiaao. Unexpectedly, he still failed in the end and was easily killed just by you.]
He died unwillingly! Unbelieving that there could be such an extraordinary power as yours in this world!
Indeed, he died.
Ding landed on the ground, grabbing the Great Demon God in mid-air, activating Eternal Youth Technique and Ten Thousand Dao Forest, the two Divine Skills.
Whirr!
The Great Demon God’s True Qi poured into Ding Ling’s Dantian.
Then rapidly refined by the two Divine Skills into True Water.
[Inner Strength Value +920]
In just a moment, three drops of True Water appeared in the Dantian.
[True Power Value: 84 points]
"The Great Demon God is much stronger than I imagined."
One should know that after Ding Ling breakthroughs again.
The quality of True Qi at the Shattering Level is higher.
The conversion efficiency has once again decreased.
Ordinary expert’s True Qi can no longer bring any benefit to him.
But the Great Demon God provided a full 920 points of Inner Strength Value.
Besides the extremely pure True Qi generated by the Secret Manual the Great Demon God cultivated, it’s also related to it being night.
On this night, the four Primordial Qi in the Great Demon God’s body, which are wind, thunder, fire, and rain, are at their fullest!
At this time, absorbing and refining his True Qi naturally yields maximum feedback value.
"Very good."

Ding Ling was very satisfied, casually throwing away the Great Demon God’s corpse, stepping into the void, instantly covering a thousand zhang distance, arriving outside Unrivaled City in a few breaths, landing in front of Guan Yu and others.
"Pay respect to Venerable Lord!"
Duann Lang, Shangguan Jinhong, and others immediately bowed and performed the grand ceremony.
Zhao Min, Xie Xun, Guan Yu, and others also followed suit in salute.
After Ding Ling signaled the exemption from ceremony, Guan Yu, Duann Lang, and others finally stood up.
Duann Lang asked about the results of the battle excitedly.
Ding Ling casually replied, then instructed Duann Lang and others to prepare the Great Army overnight, for he was going to personally invade Japan and other regions.
Duann Lang, Shangguan Jinhong felt both ashamed and excited.
To expand the territories and become the founding fathers!
This is something they look forward to and feel honored by!
This night.
At Zhao Min’s request.
Ding Ling used Longevity Venerable Qi to heal the severely injured Zhang Wuji and others.
Zhao Min, Zhang Wuji, and the group were naturally overwhelmed with gratitude.
The next day.
Ding Ling went to Luoyang.
Preparing to officially ascend the throne to become emperor.
In the following days.
People from the World Association and Unrivaled City also arrived one after another in Luoyang.

Divine Calculator, Great Divine Official, Nie Feng, Youruo, Duann Lang, Zhao Min, Guan Yu, Lü Bu, Zhang Wuji, Mingyue, and others led groups of people of ability to the Luoyang Imperial Capital, paying respect to Ding Ling, proclaiming long live the emperor.
Half a month later.
Ding Ling successfully established Jian Country.
Ensey Guan Yu, Lü Bu, Nie Feng, Duann Lang as generals,
Divine Calculator as Prime Minister, Great Divine Official as Minister of War, Zhao Min as Minister of Revenue, Mingyue as Imperial Guard Commander...
The rest were assigned various responsibilities.
Ding Ling trusted people without doubt, not using doubted people.
As long as one was a person of ability.
He appointed them regardless of gender.
In his Great Ming Dynasty, only character, Martial Arts, and intelligence were considered, not gender!
As long as they were extraordinary.
Women could also hold high positions!
And with Ding Ling’s successful founding of the nation.
The officials were in place one by one.
The whole dynasty manifested extremely fearsome cohesion and tension!
Any order or task given by Ding Ling could be swiftly accomplished through group efforts.
One must know that the officials on Ding Ling’s court.
Without exception!
Are all martial arts masters!
Non-martial arts officials, unless extremely excellent, would only be assigned to local positions!

Because this generation of Ding Ling’s officials must all be exceptionally strong, as they would face assassination threats from worldwide assassins and must always be ready to travel to other countries.
On this day.
Ding Ling set foot in Japan, wiping out all major forces in Japan in less than a day.
Jue Wushen, Japanese Emperor, and other powerful figures were easily killed, their True Qi fully absorbed.
[Inner Strength Value +60]
[Inner Strength Value +70]
As Ding Ling grew stronger.
Now absorbing Innate Experts can no longer provide any Inner Strength Value benefits to him.
Only experts above Grandmaster level can provide benefits.
Naturally, even Grandmaster level experts, their True Qi can barely provide considerable benefits to Ding Ling.

Naturally, even Grandmaster level experts, their True Qi can barely provide considerable benefits to Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 707 696: War God Technique Progress Maxed Out
paragraphs: Jue Wushen and the Emperor are strong, but they're no more than Grandmaster Level.
This is still due to them gaining many opportunities from the players' rampant leaks during this time.
If not, it's feared that they wouldn't have today's level of cultivation.
But all their fortunes and opportunities now fully benefited Ding Ling.
Ding Ling absorbed the True Qi of the Japanese strongmen.
Combined with a previous strand of True Qi.
A drop of True Water emerged again in the dantian.
[True Power Value: 85 points]
Further strengthening.
The ninety-fold amplified Sword Intent and Sword Qi are completely unrivaled.
Ding Ling estimated that his current strength and cultivation could easily sweep through the entire world.
That's exactly what he did.
Several times targeting the imperial capitals of other countries, a single sword strike directly collapsed palaces effortlessly!
He's already reached a level of god-like and immortal-like strength.
A single person is enough to match an entire world!
Duann Lang, Divine Calculator, Great Divine Official, Shangguan Jinhong, Nie Feng, and others could hardly keep up behind him!
Only because Ding Ling's conquest speed was too rapid.
Country after country.
They were easily defeated by him.
Some countries even organized Million Great Armies, mixed with some Shattering Level strongmen!
These strongmen were all ancient monsters who had obtained super opportunities and survived.
Similar to people like Emperor Shitian.
Only they were more low-key and stayed far from the Central Plains, reigning over and dominating the West and the seas, like they were from two different worlds from Emperor Shitian.
Ding Ling's arrival.
Instantly broke their defenses.
They couldn't believe that there were strongmen in the world that were a hundred times, even several hundred times stronger than them!
Completely not on the same level!

"I originally thought I already stood at the world's peak, living overseas, self-building a kingdom, being a carefree emperor, imperishable through hundreds of generations! Unexpectedly, there's someone so much more powerful than me! Is this person a celestial who descended to the mortal world?"
A Shattering Level strongman thought this without resting after being defeated by Ding Ling.
Ding Ling decided to unify the entire world.
Anyone daring to block his way!
Anyone attempting to oppose him, were all killed directly by his sword.
As Ding Ling continued to grow stronger, the ninety-fold amplified Sword Qi really became powerful enough to easily tear apart the void and the Sword Realm.
Merely Initial Tier Shattering Level strongmen.
In Ding Ling's eyes, they're no different than locusts.
Only less than six months' time.
The world unified!
This is still because Ding Ling slowed his pace.
If not.
A month might not even be needed for Ding Ling to unify the world.
And the reason for slowing down was that he wanted to wait for Nie Feng, Great Divine Official, and others.
To be governed and managed.
And these he entrusted to Great Divine Official, Divine Calculator, Nie Feng, and others.
Nie Feng and others' abilities visibly skyrocketed!
Nie Feng, who initially could only manage a hall.
In the course of moving against the wind, his management ability grew geometrically.
It can only be said.

Nie Feng truly deserves to be a rare genius seen once in a thousand years, not only immensely gifted in martial arts but also superb in military strategy, management, etc., top-notch in the realm of mortals!
Of course.
Only Nie Feng and others were not enough to manage a world.
Thus, they developed many subordinates.
Duann Lang rallied the old members of the Unrivaled City, as well as various kinds of Ascenders, and he led these people to guard the small countries in the West!
Lü Bu, Guan Yu, and others also used their methods to rally many Ascenders, players, etc., and were assigned the 'arduous' task of guarding a vast territory.
As for Nie Feng?
He brought Bu Jingyun and others along.
Ding Ling wasn't aware of how Nie Feng and Bu Jingyun reconciled and became as close as brothers once more.
Evidently, there's a complex story behind this unknown to others.
Ding Ling didn't delve into it.
He wanted the results.
After unifying the world.
He issued two commands.
To gather Great Medicine and Secret Manuals to the Luoyang Armory, Medicine Warehouse!
Thus.
Nie Feng, Duann Lang, Divine Calculator, Lü Bu, and others strove with utmost effort to gather Secret Manuals and Great Medicine.
And their subordinates are numerous, counted in tens of thousands.
Thus, with their orders, countless outstanding individuals began taking action.
After all, gathering Secret Manuals and Great Medicine for Ding Ling came with rewards.
Naturally, the rewards followed the Lower Realm's rules.
Of course, there were some differences compared to the Lower Realm, after all, the combat power in the Wind and Cloud World is much higher than the Lower Realm.
And this needed Divine Calculator, Great Divine Official, and other outstanding individuals to fill in the gaps.
Ding Ling just needed to set the general direction.
On this day.
Ding Ling finished reading the second batch of collections in the Armory.
The first batch alone had tens of thousands of volumes.
Covering astronomy, geography, music, chess, calligraphy, and painting, arrays, makeup, medical dao, etc., all-encompassing and all-inclusive.
Ding Ling spent several days to finish reading.
The second batch was similar.
Then Ding Ling went to the Medicine Warehouse to start consuming Great Medicine.
The Great Medicine piled up like a mountain.
Ding Ling began eating.
The progress of the War God Technique began to soar.
The increase was very steady.
After consuming all thousands of various aged Great Medicine.
The progress of the War God Technique is finally maxed out.
Boom!
A surge of extremely imposing, magnificent, vast, immeasurable, supreme Battle Intent and Battle Qi erupted fiercely from Ding Ling's body!
"This kind of Qi?!"
Wuming was moved and looked towards the depths of the Imperial Palace.
"It should be Your Majesty has broken through again."
Phoenix Dance, Ghost Tiger, Dragon King, the three servants said with faces of admiration.
Phoenix Dance and the three servants returned to following Wuming after he returned from the Sword Realm.
And Wuming had already achieved the Sword Spirit Great Perfection Body with the help of the Domain Crystal.
A body full of cultivation and creation had reached an incredible realm.
Not only him.
Little Zhao as well.
Over half a year ago.

Ding Ling broke into the Sword Realm, helped Little Zhao achieve Sword Spirit Perfection, and deepened her entry into the Sword Pool, capturing Residual Spirit, achieving a bit of Supreme Yin Sword Intent and Sword Qi, stepping into Sword Spirit Great Perfection. Later, Ding Ling let Little Zhao use the Domain Crystal to achieve the peak of Sword Spirit Great Perfection.
Only then did he give the slightly smaller Domain Crystal to Wuming.
After Wuming used up the Domain Crystal.
The Domain Crystal had already become so small that it was almost invisible to the naked eye.
Ding Ling knew.
It's no longer possible for this Domain Crystal to achieve anyone else, so he reclaimed the Domain Crystal and placed it within the Sword Spirit's dantian.
Although this Domain Crystal wasn't much use anymore, it had the effect of stabilizing the Sword Spirit shell.
And Ding Ling's Sword Spirit was extremely stable, so the Domain Crystal's effect was negligible whether it was there or not, just kept as a preventative measure for potential future use.
"Worthy of being Your Majesty."
Wuming worshipped extremely.
He's now the Sword Master of the Great Ming Kingdom.
Also one of the hundred officials.

The reason for agreeing to Ding Ling's proposal to become one of the hundred officials, is naturally because he owed Ding Ling far too much, impossible to repay, being one of the hundred officials could only slightly compensate.
That's secondary; the primary reason was that Wuming also wanted to assist the Great Ming Dynasty in rising with the wind, to become the world's most illustrious, supreme Peace Kingdom!

chapters.title: Chapter 708 - 697: Huaikong
paragraphs: The common people live in peace and contentment, with clothes to wear and food to eat.
This is what Wuming has always dreamed of.
And now, with the unification of the world,
This goal is being pushed forward at an extremely fast pace.
Wuming naturally wants to immerse himself in it, contributing his share of effort.
After all, at the end of the day, he is also a part of this world.
"Luckily, it is Your Majesty who unified this world! If it were someone else, the results would be unimaginable."
Wuming sighed.
"Indeed."
The Dragon King, Phoenix Dance, and Ghost Tiger all agreed in unison:

"Your Majesty’s divine power is boundless, capable of suppressing the entire world with his own strength! Although there are numerous heroes in the court and all over the world, in the face of Your Majesty, they can only submit obediently! These heroes are highly talented, and under their influence, governance, and management, the changes in the world are advancing rapidly towards an unknown direction!"
"Exactly. If it were someone else, these heroes would definitely be unwilling and rebellious. At that time, wars breaking out all over the world would not be surprising."
Wuming looked towards the depths of the Imperial Palace:
"Now that Your Majesty has grown stronger again, I believe the court will be more stable, and there will be greater cohesion and centripetal force!"
Wuming admired greatly:
"I never imagined that the trajectory of the Jiuzhou World would develop to this point today."
It wasn’t just Wuming.
Almost all the officials still in Luoyang were shocked and amazed:
"Your Majesty has already become absurdly powerful. Can he really grow even stronger?!"
"Huaimie."
In the General’s Mansion of Nie Feng, Nie Feng said to a tall and imposing man:
"Your Majesty’s talent is rare throughout the ages. He becomes stronger every moment, which is quite normal."
"I just find it somewhat unbelievable."
Huaimie looked shocked:
"To have already reached such heights as Your Majesty, and still be able to grow stronger. It’s simply unimaginable!"
"Indeed."
Beside Huaimie stood a man and a woman.
The man was heroic, and the woman was charming.
The two were none other than Huaikong and Bai Ling of Iron Heart Island.
At this moment, Huaikong and Bai Ling couldn’t help but praise in unison:

"I personally witnessed Tie Kuangtu wearing the Celestial Tribulation Armor, yet against Your Majesty, he was still no match, being stabbed to death with a single casual sword from Your Majesty. The feeling it gave me was overwhelmingly shocking. It’s unbelievable that such a strong figure as Your Majesty exists in the world!"
"Tie Kuangtu believed that with the Celestial Tribulation Armor, he would be invincible. But that was naive."
Nie Feng shook his head, glanced at the direction of the Imperial Palace, and said:

"Powerhouses like Emperor Shitian are scared into fleeing everywhere when facing Your Majesty, still nowhere to be found. I really don’t know who gave Tie Kuangtu the courage to dare to face Your Majesty head-on."
"But it’s a good thing he did."
Huaimie said angrily:

"This person is ruthless. If I hadn’t bribed some aliens to interfere, he would have killed my master long ago! And the day Your Majesty descended on Iron Heart Island was exactly when Tie Kuangtu was about to kill my master. It can only be said that Your Majesty came at the perfect time. Had he been a moment later, we would have been separated by life and death from my master Yin and Yang."
"Thank Your Majesty."
Huaikong and Bai Ling both bowed towards the direction of the Imperial Palace.
Ding Ling surveyed the whole world.
On the way, he accidentally arrived at Iron Heart Island, and seeing there were people on it, prepared to take the island effortlessly.
He hadn’t expected there to be people like Tie Kuangtu on the island.
And perhaps due to the island’s isolation overseas, there were only two or three players on it.
These two or three people were even bought off by Huaimie.
This meant that Tie Kuangtu was essentially kept in the dark regarding the players and Ding Ling.

Thus, when Ding Ling arrived at the island, Tie Kuangtu even clamored to effortlessly kill Ding Ling, only to be easily slaughtered by Ding Ling with a single seemingly light sword, and he died in utter disbelief, filled with shock and fear.
After Ding Ling killed Tie Kuangtu,
He subsequently met Huaimie, Huaikong, Bai Ling, and the imprisoned Iron God.
The various incidents during this period need not be elaborated in detail.
After staying for a day, Ding Ling left with Nie Feng and others who arrived on the island.
Iron Heart Island thereby officially announced its integration into the Great Ming Dynasty.
After they joined the Great Ming Dynasty,
They naturally contributed their due efforts in gathering Secret Manuals and Great Medicine for Ding Ling.
To show his loyalty, Iron God even offered the internal and external skills of the Sky-breaking Yuan Hand, as well as the Railway Celestial Mirror!
The Railway Celestial Mirror is a shattering-level forging technique.
After Ding Ling mastered this technique at full level,
He could create Divine Weapons of a level not inferior to, or even surpassing, those like Celestial Sin, Celestial Tribulation Armor, or Greed Wolf Sword!
It is precisely because of this technique,
Combined with other full-level forging and casting skills from different worlds!

Ding Ling then forged several immensely powerful ’Fire Qilin Swords’ and ’Fire Qilin Sabers’ at Luoyang Royal Foundry using Fire Qilin’s scales, meteorite iron left behind by Emperor Shitian, and other secret iron!
The Fire Qilin Sabers and Swords Ding Ling forged had no possibility of demonic influence, only because he utilized the Demon Scripture to thoroughly devour all the demonic power within them.
What remained was only a touch of pure divinity as well as the special attribute power inherent in the Fire Qilin scales.
The few Fire Qilin Swords and Sabers were awarded by Ding Ling to meritorious officials like Divine Calculator, Great Divine Official, Duann Lang, Lü Bu, Guan Yu, Nie Feng, etc.
There were only nine of these swords and sabers.
Those who obtained the Fire Qilin Sabers and Swords, without exception, were the top representatives in the court, so for a long period afterward, the Fire Qilin Sabers and Swords symbolized power!
And as for Little Zhao?

Ding Ling specially melted some top-tier secret treasures, combined with more Fire Qilin scales, to forge the tenth Fire Qilin Sword for Little Zhao! The power of this sword far exceeded that of the other swords and sabers!

For this sword, Ding Ling even endowed it with a bit of the ’Spirit of Sword Mountain’, a spirit originating from the Sword Mountain region of the Sword Realm! Ding Ling deliberately broke in to obtain it.
And Little Zhao’s sword spirit was already at the Great Perfection Level, so controlling such a Spirit Sword was naturally effortless.
Moreover, because the court officials daily advised Ding Ling to choose an empress, take concubines, and fill the harem,
Ding Ling also felt that this world needed to have someone truly of his own left behind.
Seeing Little Zhao’s wholehearted devotion to him, Ding Ling chose Little Zhao as the empress to oversee the backyard of the Luoyang Imperial Palace, commanding the entire palace’s guard team.
At this moment, Little Zhao looked at Ding Ling with a gentle, water-like affection, saying:
"Congratulations, Your Majesty, on achieving Great Success in Divine Skill."
Ding Ling slightly smiled, saying:
"How is the task I assigned going?"

"The whole world belongs to our Great Ming Dynasty. With the search by aliens and other interested parties, our Great Ming Dynasty’s great army has already located Divine Dragon Island. Once Your Majesty sets off, we can slay the dragon."
"Hmm."
Ding Ling stood up tall:
"Let’s go now."
During this period, he had already read two batches of books.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace progress: 43%]
Previously it was 31%.
Increased by no less than 12 points.
The number of Secret Manuals evidently played a significant role.
Of course.
There was also no lack of some high-quality Martial Arts Secret Manuals among these books.

chapters.title: Chapter 709 - 698: Forging the Blade
paragraphs: If it weren’t so, it wouldn’t have improved by a whole 12 points.
After reading through the first two batches of books.
He wanted to see the third batch.
It would require time to collect.
Ding Ling couldn’t wait that long and decided to seize this opportunity to go to slay the dragon.
However, before that.
Ding Ling decided to melt down a batch of top-tier Divine Weapons into a single blade.
He obtained from the Seven Weapons of Wind and Cloud: the Greed Wolf Sword, Celestial Blade, Snow-Drinking Saber, Silence-breaking Saber, Celestial Sin, and Unparalleled Sword!
As for the Hero Sword and Fire Qilin Sword, they already had owners.
Ding Ling did not go to ask for them.
The Fire Qilin Sword was replaced with the Fire Qilin’s scales.
Regarding the Hero Sword, Ding Ling has Vast Righteous Qi, when the time comes to forge the weapon, he can imbue it with a strand of Vast Righteous Qi, and it is expected to be extremely powerful.
As for these five weapons.
The Silence-breaking Saber came from Japan.
This saber is extremely sharp, even the handle is sharp enough to slice through gold and jade; Ding Ling moved through Japan unopposed, and by chance, this saber naturally fell into his hands.
As for the Unparalleled Sword?

Ding Ling personally went to Sword Worship Manor a few months ago and easily found the true Unparalleled Sword using the Eye of the Sword Spirit, and because the Sword Spirit Qi in him reached Great Perfection, this Unparalleled Sword did not resist Ding Ling, its new master.
Bu Jingyun’s fate had long changed, without the Qilin Arm, and because Ding Ling proactively took the sword, naturally he wasn’t in line for it!
And the reason for taking the sword.
Was because the Unparalleled Sword was also forged from the miraculous stone used by Nuwa to repair the sky. Ding Ling valued this miraculous stone.
Nuwa left behind four miraculous stones for repairing the sky.
Three of these have already come into Ding Ling’s possession.
Namely, the Ice Soul, Bai Lu forged into the Snow-Drinking Saber, and now the Black Cold forged into the Unparalleled Sword!
Ding Ling plans to melt these three Divine Stones into a new Divine Weapon.
And so he did.
The assistant for forging the weapon was the renowned Iron God!

Iron God is currently the manager of the Royal Foundry Department and also the Minister of the Ministry of Works, overseeing water conservancy, civil engineering, construction, transportation, industry, and more nationwide.
The Foundry Department naturally falls under his management.
Upon hearing Ding Ling wanted to forge a new weapon.
Iron God was delighted and eagerly volunteered to assist.
Ding Ling naturally agreed.
This forging.
Lasted forty-nine days.
It was longer than Ding Ling expected.

He mastered Iron Refining Hand, Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao’s Mingyi Celestial Flame, Nine Heavens Profound Wind, Thunderbolt, Power of Frozen Rain and occasionally initiated Iron Refining Hand to aid in refining and forging the weapon, otherwise, it would have taken even longer!
The moment the weapon emerged from the forge.
A sharp and dazzling Sword Qi soared into the sky, stirring up a whirlwind, and changing the color of the heavens!
It seemed so powerful that it could split the entire world in two!
"What is that?!"
Even Emperor Shitian lounging in Chang’an City noticed the movement from Luoyang and couldn’t help but feel shock:
"That Ding Ling, has he perhaps mastered another Supreme Blade Technique?!"
It’s no wonder he would think so.
During this time.
Emperor Shitian had long hidden his identity, deeply concealed in the city, and due to his mastery of disguises, bone-shrinking, stealth, and acting, no one has discovered his true identity.
He secretly developed an intelligence investigation organization in Chang’an City.
No member of this organization knew Emperor Shitian’s real name, they only knew him as their leader.
And the information they gathered would be promptly relayed to Emperor Shitian.
Thus, although Emperor Shitian has become so low-key that he is practically a decrepit elder in Chang’an City, whose daily activities are nothing but drinking tea and fishing, living leisurely.
But he still knows the affairs of the world.
Precisely because he knows this, he has become even more discreet.
Ding Ling’s strength.
Is simply outrageous.
Emperor Shitian secretly lamented more than once, ’Why was Ding Ling born while I, Xu Fu, still exist?!’
With Ding Ling around.
He, Emperor Shitian, dared not show his face! Because if he dared to appear, he would be easily killed by Ding Ling.
"Ding Ling’s talent is terrifying."
Emperor Shitian, looking towards Luoyang’s direction, muttered:
"Sweeping the world, splitting Sword Realm, it’s all just mere trifles. I can’t afford to provoke him, can’t provoke him! I must keep a low profile!"
Having had much interaction with some Aliens.
Emperor Shitian has picked up some rather trendy phrases.
"That Xiaao Sanxiaao’s two sons are unbelievably powerful. Who would have thought that old sly fox is even more insidious than me, secretly birthing such two sons!"
No.
Despite being so powerful and having lived for thousands of years without aging or dying, outliving me; he can still hide so well. Even I didn’t know before.
Too insidious, too cunning.
A person like this, secretly sending messages, wanting to unite with me to slay the dragon."
Emperor Shitian thought indignantly:
"Though tempted, I will definitely not fall for it!"
He had heard.
Ding Ling intends to slay the dragon.
Should he proceed.
He would be running straight into Ding Ling’s blade; isn’t that court death?!

"Xiaao Sanxiaao’s sons, the Great Demon God Xiaao Jingtian and Patriarch Xiaao Aoshi have already been killed by Ding Ling. I can understand wanting revenge. After all, it took thousands of years to bear two sons, who inherited his Dragon Turtle blood, could share his longevity, and were very strong.
Though those two sons were indeed unruly, somewhat bearing my Emperor Shitian’s manner!
But Xiaao Sanxiaao might just feel that those two sons are unworthy or disobedient.
When all’s said and done, a tiger won’t eat its cubs. No matter how angry Xiaao Sanxiaao was, he couldn’t have killed his own sons. Yet Ding Ling did. This enmity is indeed profound."
Emperor Shitian chuckled softly, with the corners of his lips slightly raised:
"If not for the arrival of these Aliens, if not for Ding Ling’s ruckus, I wouldn’t have known how deep the waters of this world run."
He felt a sense of trepidation:
’Thinking back, I once believed myself to be the World’s Number One, easily toying with others; wouldn’t my actions have been despised by Xiaao Sanxiaao, not to mention by even stronger individuals!’
Emperor Shitian recalled Emperor Qin Shi Huang.
That person who brought him nightmares till this day.

"Ding Ling acquired the Emperor’s Sword, equivalent to inheriting much of Emperor Qin Shi Huang’s power! To want to defeat him, perhaps even if the entire world united, it would be impossible. I must wait for the right opportunity."
Emperor Shitian also entertained the notion of pursuing some fortunes.
But whether it is dragon slayer, delving into Forbidden Realm, or entering Sword Realm and such places.
Are far too perilous.
He alone cannot manage it!
"I wonder when Ding Ling will go slay the dragon. Can I perhaps sneak an attack from behind then?"
Emperor Shitian thought thus but immediately shook his head in denial:

"No no no, it’s too dangerous. One strike from Ding Ling could kill me; this scheme won’t work. I better continue fishing, drinking tea. Old, so what, as long as I don’t die. If I can live, maybe one day I can break through to the void and ascend to immortality?"
Emperor Shitian, unable to obtain fortune in this world.
Dare not proactively pursue such grand fortunes for fear of Ding Ling tracing his steps, leading to his demise.
After all, the name All-Purpose King Ding Ling rings loudly in his ears!
