chapters.title: Chapter 710 - 699: Human Emperor Saber
paragraphs: He dared to bet that if he showed his face, Ding Ling might use tracking and tracing skills to find and lock onto him!
At that time, even ten lives wouldn’t be enough for Ding Ling to kill.
"I should wait for Ding Ling to shatter the void, and then take the ’Wind-assisted Celestial Ladder’ to seek opportunities in another world!"
Thus thought Emperor Shitian.
He is immortal.
His lifespan is extremely long.
He can afford to wait!
As for why he made such a choice?
Naturally, it was through communication with the Alien, learning many secrets.
The more he knows.
The clearer Emperor Shitian becomes about the vastness of the future heavens and earth!
Therefore, he absolutely cannot go against Ding Ling, absolutely cannot show his face!
He does not want to die! He wants to become immortal!
He wants to truly be ageless, immortal!
Luoyang.
Royal Foundry Department.
Everyone looked at the Treasure Saber in Ding Ling’s hands with shock on their faces!

The saber shone brightly, the blade flowing with seven-colored hues, and with a slight spin, fierce Sword Qi rotated uncertainly on the blade, ready at any time to burst out, slicing people to pieces!
Without using Vigorous Qi, the saber was already powerful enough to shatter a Grandmaster!
Clearly.
This was not a saber that ordinary people could control.
However, because this saber was forged by Ding Ling himself, and he manually injected a strand of Vast Righteous Qi from his chest and a bit of the Sword Spirit’s Spiritual Energy.
Thus, after the birth of this Treasure Saber.
It naturally became close to Ding Ling!
"What a fine saber!"
Ding Ling sensed it carefully, unable to help but exclaim.
In terms of quality, this saber even surpassed the Emperor’s Sword.

The Emperor’s Sword excelled in the ability to amplify by fifty times! But with Ding Ling’s War God Technique Full Level, constantly growing stronger, Ding Ling felt that the amplification of the Emperor’s Sword also had its limits!

Moreover, the Emperor’s Sword seemed to contain a vast and magnificent energy within it, previously undetectable, until Ding Ling became stronger, he experienced the terrifying and boundless nature of this energy.
This energy is fused with the Emperor’s Sword; the sword exists, the energy exists; the sword is lost, the energy disperses.
And this energy seems to be related to Jiuzhou and Heaven and Earth Qi!
It seems that only in this world can this sword unleash infinite power.
Therefore, although the Emperor’s Sword seems overwhelmingly powerful, it ultimately has its limitations.
Whereas the saber now in Ding Ling’s hands, regardless of its quality, sharpness, heat resistance, cold resistance, amplification, all possess impressive special effects.
He can not only cut hair and iron as if they were mud.
He can also autonomously absorb Heaven and Earth Spiritual Qi and other’s martial power, transmitting it to the swordsman!
Additionally, it carries extreme cold Qi, the source of extreme heat!
Yin and Yang blend together.
Indestructible! Once the forces of ice and fire explode, easily enough to severely injure the enemy.
"The Unparalleled Sword’s absorption of martial power, Spiritual Qi."
Snow-Drinking Saber’s extreme cold, sharpness, toughness;
Fire Qilin scale’s extreme heat, toughness, divinity;
Silence-breaking Saber’s sharpness, ferocity;
Celestial Sin’s ferocity, transformation;
Celestial Blade’s Purple Gold, Greed Wolf Sword’s ferocity;
Celestial Tribulation Armor’s defense, solidity;
Giant Que Sword’s heaviness;
Purple Blood Needle Hidden Weapon’s venomousness, penetration;
Gentleman’s Sword’s agility, mysteriousness;
Ice Soul’s incorruptibility and immortality.
Eight top Divine Objects;
Dozens of secret treasures;
More than three hundred types of Divine Iron from around the world.
Assistance from Iron God, Huaikong, and other disciples of Iron Heart Island.
Ding Ling led, using the Full Level Railway Celestial Mirror and other Forging Skills, Casting Skills, taking forty-nine days to forge one saber!
Utmost perfection!
Even the Emperor’s Sword cannot compare! Although it doesn’t have overly strong amplification ability.
But with this saber in hand, Ding Ling can surely be even stronger, fighting increasingly fiercely!
Moreover, this saber has three strange stones left by Nuwa during the sky-repairing as its core guide, making it immortal and indestructible, enough to exist eternally!
Ding Ling is very pleased with the appearance of this saber.
With this saber in hand, going to other worlds in the future, even some Xianxia Worlds, he won’t have to worry about lacking weapons.
This saber can absolutely accompany him for a long time!

"The scales of the Fire Qilin are completely exhausted. Not only that, the Divine Weapons I obtained, apart from Xuanyuan Sword, Emperor’s Sword, Green Pearl, and the broken Immortal Weapon Long Halberd, all other Divine Weapons have been merged into this Treasure Saber! Such a Treasure Saber, overwhelmingly powerful in this world, what Divine Weapon can match it?"

Ding Ling spent a few more hours crafting a sheath for this saber, then the blade entered the sheath, collecting its sharpness, and the internal space of the Royal Foundry Department finally calmed down completely.
"Congratulations, Your Majesty."
Iron God, Huaikong, and others all congratulated together.
Ding Ling smiled slightly, gestured to waive the courtesy, then walked out of the Foundry Department directly to handle some accumulated court affairs.
After Ding Ling left.
Iron God said with a face full of emotion and shock:
"Your Majesty deserves the name of All-Purpose King. This Casting Skill, Forging Skill, I can’t reach it even if I try my best! Looks like I need to work harder on the Railway Celestial Mirror!"
The fact that Ding Ling’s Railway Celestial Mirror instantly reached Full Level caused a shocking impact on Iron God, Huaikong, and others, which hasn’t dissipated until now.
Their views seem to have been overturned.
Even now assisting in forging this supreme Treasure Saber, they are still in a dazed state.
Being so amazed by Ding Ling’s extraordinary prowess!
"Indeed. Your Majesty is truly too strong."
Huaikong, Huaimie, Bai Ling, and others once again contacted Ding Ling up close, couldn’t help but be continually moved and admire.
Just because this time compared to the last, the pressure Ding Ling brought to them was greater!

Keep in mind that over these months they have also been diligently training, thinking they’ve progressed a lot. Yet compared to Ding Ling, they are still like Great Witches before Xianxia, nothing to compare to.
"Your Majesty indeed. Truly a model for us!"
After returning to the Imperial Palace to handle affairs.
He looked at the third batch, fourth batch of collected books.
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Progress 52%]
Before it was 43%.
Jumped 9 points.
Just because the quality of the first batch, second batch of books was higher.
Besides.
Including the previous two batches of books, Ding Ling’s Attribute Points growth was:
[Wisdom +0.5]
[Buddha Qi +4 points]
[Vast Righteous Qi +1 point]
Among the four batches of books, there were quite a few Buddhist Scriptures etc., making the Buddha Qi increase by 4 points.
And finally, a point of Vast Righteous Qi increased, being the result of accumulating strength gradually and then releasing it.

But because of the previous weapon forging, Ding Ling injected a point of Vast Righteous Qi into the Treasure Saber, giving the Treasure Saber a skill to repel evil demons, so now Ding Ling’s total Vast Righteous Qi is still only 3 points.
’Time to slay the dragon.’
Ding Ling, bearing two swords and one saber, stood there, majestic and unparalleled, exuding the Emperor’s Overbearing Aura, grandeur.
His saber.
Little Zhao suggested naming it Human Emperor Saber.
Ding Ling accepted.
He is the Human Emperor of several worlds.
Since the saber is forged by him personally, naming it Human Emperor Saber is entirely appropriate.
Tap tap!
Ding Ling just walked out of the main hall, accompanied by urgent footsteps, a voice containing slight panic, ’Your Majesty,’ caught Ding Ling’s attention.
Seeing the visitor was Wang Bodang, a general under Guan Yu, he couldn’t help asking:
"What happened?"

Among the four batches of books, there were quite a few Buddhist Scriptures etc., making the Buddha Qi increase by 4 points.
And finally, a point of Vast Righteous Qi increased, being the result of accumulating strength gradually and then releasing it.

But because of the previous weapon forging, Ding Ling injected a point of Vast Righteous Qi into the Treasure Saber, giving the Treasure Saber a skill to repel evil demons, so now Ding Ling’s total Vast Righteous Qi is still only 3 points.
’Time to slay the dragon.’
Ding Ling, bearing two swords and one saber, stood there, majestic and unparalleled, exuding the Emperor’s Overbearing Aura, grandeur.
His saber.
Little Zhao suggested naming it Human Emperor Saber.
Ding Ling accepted.
He is the Human Emperor of several worlds.
Since the saber is forged by him personally, naming it Human Emperor Saber is entirely appropriate.
Tap tap!
Ding Ling just walked out of the main hall, accompanied by urgent footsteps, a voice containing slight panic, ’Your Majesty,’ caught Ding Ling’s attention.
Seeing the visitor was Wang Bodang, a general under Guan Yu, he couldn’t help asking:
"What happened?"

chapters.title: Chapter 711 - 700: Sui and Tang Hero Wang Bodang
paragraphs: Wang Bodang, a valiant general and divine archer of the Sui and Tang World, a close friend of Li Mi, was destined to die according to the original storyline, but with players interfering, not only the Three Kingdoms plot collapsed, but also the Sui and Tang World fell into chaos.
Wang Bodang did not die.
He even gained significant power through repeated fortuitous encounters, embarking on the path of the Celestial Ladder.
He ascended several times.
Wang Bodang arrived at the Wind and Cloud World, just as Guan Yu was recruiting troops, and he voluntarily joined the ranks under Martial Saint Guan Yu.
Compared to Lü Bu, the valiant general.
The title of Martial Saint is renowned across various worlds.
Many famous generals came to seek refuge with the Martial Saint.
Thus.
Ding Ling had Guan Yu lead his troops to guard the north and west regions of Jiuzhou.
At this moment, Wang Bodang arrived looking fearful, and Ding Ling was quite surprised, as with Jiuzhou unified and himself suppressing the world, who would dare act recklessly?
Why is he so terrified?
"Your Majesty. Please save General Guan."
Wang Bodang knelt to the ground, his face full of sorrow:
"Guan, General Guan is about to die."
"Guan Yu is dying?"
Ding Ling was astonished and incredulous:
"Where is he?"
"Right outside the hall."
"Bring him in."
"Yes."
Wang Bodang staggered out, and shortly after he returned with two soldiers carrying a simple ’canvas stretcher’.
Ding Ling stepped forward, carefully observing.
He saw Guan Yu with his eyes tightly closed, face ghastly, breaths weak, seemingly only able to inhale without exhaling.
No wonder Wang Bodang was so frightened.
"I sought divine doctors, but they all expressed helplessness. I had no choice but to come and kneel before Your Majesty for help."
Wang Bodang said.
"Alright."
Ding Ling uttered without raising an eyebrow:
"Rest assured, as long as there’s still a breath left, I can heal him."
And indeed, that was the truth.
Lately, Ding Ling had read through four batches of books, which included medical techniques from this world.
And Ding Ling, having read them, reached full level.
Making his medical skills increasingly superb, reaching terrifying heights!
In the Celestial Dragon World, his medical prowess had already reached the point of being able to replace eyes and limbs.
In this world, his cultivation soared, and his medical skills grew ever stronger.
Earlier, he easily rescued Little Zhao, who had one foot in the Ghost Gate.
Now, treating Guan Yu, who also had one foot at the Ghost Gate, naturally posed no problem.
To make things easier.
Ding Ling directly used Longevity Venerable Qi in conjunction with Medical Saint Breathing Technique, Acupuncture Skill, and others to heal Guan Yu.
And Longevity Venerable Qi, truly unrivaled in its healing abilities.
After a period of time.
Guan Yu slowly awakened.
Wang Bodang was overjoyed and promptly hailed the general.
"Where am I?"
Guan Yu felt a splitting headache, and memories of brutal scenes suddenly flashed through his mind, causing him to exclaim in shock:
"What about my subordinates?"
"General. Apart from me and you, they, they are all dead."
"What?!"

Guan Yu was greatly shocked, just as he was about to inquire further, he glanced up and saw Ding Ling, immediately becoming solemn, he stepped off the stretcher and respectfully paid great homage to Ding Ling:
"Greetings to My Emperor, Long live My Emperor!"
"Rise, no need for formalities."
Ding Ling responded gently, and then asked:
"Guan Yu, what exactly happened to you?"
"To explain, it’s quite simple..."
Guan Yu and Wang Bodang, ’one word from you, another from him’ explained the situation clearly.
Since Guan Yu was guarding the north and west regions, he would occasionally lead a troop to patrol the two regions.
About ten days ago, Guan Yu led his team to patrol to the Western Realm, suddenly noticing something unusual.
He went forward to investigate.
Upon closer inspection, he saw a man with white hair, a dominating aura, practicing Kung Fu with several corpses.
Guan Yu may not have recognized the man.
But the players under Guan Yu’s command knew him very well, immediately shouting Xiong Ba!
Despite the shout, Xiong Ba did not react at all.
Only after the corpse in his hands shriveled and burned into charcoal did he slowly rise and approach Guan Yu and his group.
With an expressionless face, he waved his hand.

The surging Flaming Celestial Flame erupted from the Ten Directions Realm, and most of Guan Yu’s subordinates, except for a few masters, the ordinary soldiers, and alien guests, were directly burnt into charcoal by this strike.
Guan Yu was furious, engaging Xiong Ba.
Even resorting to City-Overturning Love.
But alas, was no match for Xiong Ba, ending up severely injured, barely breathing.
In the end, Wang Bodang pulled Guan Yu into a nearby forest, narrowly avoiding the disaster.
And Xiong Ba seemed devoid of consciousness, unaware of chasing Wang Bodang and Guan Yu.
Having killed everyone, he sat down cross-legged once again where he was, grabbing corpses, seemingly practicing Kung Fu again.
Wang Bodang dared not provoke further.
Seeing Guan Yu’s life hanging by a thread, he took Guan Yu in search of renowned doctors for treatment, but to no avail, forcing him to undertake a thousand-mile journey to Luoyang to seek Ding Ling.
Ding Ling, until recently, was busy forging weapons, naturally without time.
It was only today that Wang Bodang managed to bring the breathless Guan Yu to Ding Ling.
Upon hearing this.
Guan Yu understood everything, expressing gratitude to Wang Bodang and Ding Ling successively.
Ding Ling waved his hand and said:
"Tell me the exact location."
Guan Yu and Wang Bodang spoke.
Then Ding Ling tore through the clouds, transforming into a dazzling light and left.
He never imagined Xiong Ba would appear at this time, let alone dare to kill his people!
Thus...
The perfect opportunity to slaughter Xiong Ba or directly render him useless.
Xiong Ba’s daughter, Youruo, and son, God of Capture, are now imperial officials.
For their sake, Ding Ling decided to spare Xiong Ba’s life.
Of course, if Xiong Ba remains ignorant, Ding Ling will definitely decisively end him.
Following the Map.
Ding Ling traversed a thousand feet in an instant, moving with incredible speed.
In less than half an hour.
He had already crossed over a thousand miles, arriving near the map location point in the Western Region.
From a high vantage point.
He immediately saw Xiong Ba refining corpses.
"Is that Xiong Ba?"
Ding Ling pondered:
"Only knows corpse refining instinctively. Aside from that, devoid of consciousness, like a zombie."
Ding Ling was puzzled:
"What on earth happened to Xiong Ba to make him become like this?"
Ding Ling was still bewildered when Xiong Ba suddenly roared skyward, rumble! His body began to intensely transform, growing from normal height to over two meters in altitude.
All muscles.
Swelling like a muscular beast.
The flames on his body coiling and swirling unpredictably like fire snakes, he opened his mouth, spewing streams of flaming aura, his feet stamping heavily on the Earth Realm, stepping forward.
Thud thud!
Wherever he passed.
Deep footprints were imprinted on the ground.
The imprints carried flames and terrifying high temperatures, causing the air to crackle and pop.
Xiong Ba walked on.
Thorns withered.
Grass turned yellow.
Streams parched.
Trees shattered.

chapters.title: Chapter 712 - 701: Xiong Ba the Immortal
paragraphs: The region below seemed to have entered an apocalyptic scenario.
In just a brief moment.
The place Xiong Ba walked through had already turned to scorched earth.
Ding Ling cast his gaze toward the West.
The sight he beheld was also a desert region devoid of any greenery!
"Xiong Ba."

Ding Ling turned swiftly, resembling a bolt of lightning. With a whoosh, he landed in front of Xiong Ba, facing him directly, and shouted angrily. The overwhelming sound waves poured into Xiong Ba’s ears, causing them to bleed, and his chaotic eyes cleared slightly.
He slightly raised his head to glance at Ding Ling, seemingly recalling something, his pupils constricted and abruptly returned to chaos.
Roar!
Xiong Ba let out a fierce roar towards Ding Ling and suddenly swung his hand.
Whoosh!
Scorching flames appeared out of thin air, surging toward Ding Ling like a flying waterfall rushing to the sea.
Ding Ling leaped back a hundred yards, yet the flames followed, as if they wouldn’t rest until Ding Ling was burned to death.
Ding Ling swiftly drew the Emperor’s Sword, amplifying the Emperor Sword Dao ninety times.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!

A Sword Qi shot out from the sword tip, resembling a meteor piercing through the sky, passing through the flames and stabbing in front of Xiong Ba in an instant. Xiong Ba crazily reached out to grab it, thud!
The Sword Qi penetrated his palm and, with still some force left, shot into his chest, then completely pierced through!
Thud!
The Sword Qi pierced through Xiong Ba’s body, bringing out dotted blood-red flames!
Not blood.
Flames.
All of Xiong Ba, from head to toe, seemed to turn into a mass of fire.
Ding Ling was puzzled, overwhelmed, but his hand movements did not slow down. The Emperor Sword Dao showed its might, Sword Qi continuously shot out, clang clang clang!
Resembling falling rain, dense Sword Qi covered Xiong Ba.
In just an instant.
Xiong Ba was pierced through like a sieve.
Whoosh! Streams of flames flowed out of the holes on his shell-like body, Xiong Ba stood in the fire, looking fierce, pounding his chest as he roared at Ding Ling, like a fire ape.
Boom boom boom!

Xiong Ba took big strides, crazily charging toward Ding Ling’s position. The places he passed, trees withered, and the moisture in the earth seemed to evaporate cleanly in an instant. Before long, the area Xiong Ba walked through had turned to desolate soil.
Ding Ling frowned:
"Unafraid of pain, unafraid of death, what kind of monster is this?"
"What has Xiong Ba gone through, to turn into such a being?"
Ding Ling couldn’t think it through.
Since physical attacks were ineffective.
He decided to use spiritual attacks.
He amplified the Spirit Killing Sword ninety times.
Boom!
The Killing Sword surged forward like a torrent, the flames couldn’t block this Killing Sword at all, and soon, it covered Xiong Ba.
Xiong Ba’s frenzied body stopped this time.
He clutched his head, wailing and roaring.
His cries echoed across the eight levels of Heaven’s Edge.
His body trembled, suddenly tipping back and falling.
Boom!
He fell heavily to the ground, shaking the entire earth three times.
"Is he dead now?"
Ding Ling initially planned to spare Xiong Ba’s life.
But Xiong Ba’s mutation was too excessive.
Like a humanoid ferocious beast.
If such a monster invaded the Central Plains, it would certainly result in almost all rooms being empty, a thousand miles without a crow’s caw!
Ding Ling, as the Jiuzhou Human Emperor.
How could he allow such a thing?
Clang! Ding Ling sheathed the Emperor’s Sword.
Formed a seal with both hands, blew a breath toward the sky.
The next instant.
Rumble!
Whoosh!
Amidst the thunderous sound, the Nine Heavens Profound Wind descended, followed by drizzling frozen rain, falling on the ground, extinguishing those flames.
To Ding Ling’s surprise, these flames were extremely difficult to put out.
Even with the freezing rain targeting them, it took a considerable amount of time.
"This fire is extraordinary. No wonder it severely injured Guan Yu."
Even the Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao’s drizzling frozen rain took half a day to resolve the fire, revealing its scorching, stubborn, and powerful nature.
And this was with Xiong Ba lying on the ground, uncontrolled.
Controlled fire would definitely be stronger.
"Right."
After extinguishing the flames, Ding Ling walked toward Xiong Ba’s position, intending to examine Xiong Ba’s body more closely.
Because he suddenly recalled something.

"Guan Yu’s City-Overturning Love, Heaven and Earth Destruction, with one slash, he could instantly kill masters several ranks higher. Xiong Ba facing this move, wouldn’t be completely unharmed, right."
Clip-clop!
Ding Ling moved quickly, his Shrinking Inches speed allowing him to reach Xiong Ba’s side in just two breaths, reaching out to grab Xiong Ba when, boom!
Xiong Ba suddenly leaped without warning, a punch smashed heavily toward Ding Ling’s face.
Ding Ling exclaimed in surprise, reacting swiftly, amplifying Thunder Strike Fist forty times! And punched back toward Xiong Ba.
Boom!

The two punches collided heavily like mountains! Boom! Amidst the sound of thunder, Xiong Ba was blown away a hundred yards by Ding Ling’s punch, his entire arm exploded with cracking sounds, but he felt nothing, didn’t scream, didn’t cry, only roared like he had lost his sanity.
However, he seemed to retain some instinct.
Seeing he couldn’t defeat Ding Ling no matter what, even if Ding Ling had a high chance of completely erasing him, he suddenly turned around, dug his feet into the ground, whoosh!
Resembling a flash of firelight, he instantly fled toward the direction of the Western Realm.
So fast.
Like an aurora flash!
Even Ding Ling’s sharp eyes could only catch a glimpse of a firelight flashing in the void, then disappearing without a trace.
"Trying to run?"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows, amplifying Free-Will Ascension Step forty times, Shrinking Inches he traveled, and soon, Ding Ling caught sight of Xiong Ba again.
His body was shrouded in firelight, seeming to be ablaze, his whole face and body becoming increasingly shriveled, but his speed was only getting faster.
"Is this an escape skill that consumes one’s Essence Qi and flesh to achieve!? No wonder the speed is so ridiculously fast!"
Ding Ling was relieved.
"But could Xiong Ba still survive after expending every bit of Essence Qi and flesh?"
Ding Ling deeply doubted.
He thought Xiong Ba may have already perished.
Only leaving behind a mutated corpse.
Otherwise.
Why would the Spirit Killing Sword, amplified ninety times, be ineffective?
This Killing Sword could slay sword spirits, slay the Great Demon God, like killing chickens, it should have no reason not to kill a mutated Xiong Ba.
"It seems Xiong Ba has turned into an Immortal, soulless, mindless, zombie-like character?!"
What is the true nature of a zombie?
Ding Ling wasn’t sure either.
He just suddenly remembered an ancient text.
This ancient text he had seen in the third batch of books.
It recorded various detailed circumstances of zombies.

Among them, it mentioned that if zombies descend into the mortal world, they are Immortal species! Unkillable by man, unburnable by fire, impervious to physical or spiritual attacks, overwhelmingly strong, considered an unbeatable foe!
If not for zombies being muddled, thoughtless, and emotionless, the mortal realm might long have been governed and completely overturned by zombies.
And Xiong Ba’s situation was a bit similar to the ’Fire Zombie’ recorded in the ancient text.
The meaning is simple:
A zombie awakened with a fire attribute!

Ding Ling wasn’t sure either.
He just suddenly remembered an ancient text.
This ancient text he had seen in the third batch of books.
It recorded various detailed circumstances of zombies.
Among them, it mentioned that if zombies descend into the mortal world, they are Immortal species!
Unkillable by man, unburnable by fire, impervious to physical or spiritual attacks, overwhelmingly strong, considered an unbeatable foe!
If not for zombies being muddled, thoughtless, and emotionless, the mortal realm might long have been governed and completely overturned by zombies.
And Xiong Ba’s situation was a bit similar to the ’Fire Zombie’ recorded in the ancient text.
The meaning is simple:
A zombie awakened with a fire attribute!

chapters.title: Chapter 713 - 702: Loulan Ruins
paragraphs: Xiong Ba has most likely become a Fire Zombie.
This is something Ding Ling could never have imagined.
He doesn’t understand what Xiong Ba has gone through, but that doesn’t stop him from tracking him down to make sense of things.
He won’t stop until things are clear.
If such a zombie appears in the world.
Besides him.
No one in Jiuzhou would be able to deal with it.
Because it’s truly unsolvable!
An undying, immortal Fire Zombie wreaking havoc in the human world. If it’s allowed to wander aimlessly for years, Jiuzhou will surely be devastated by it alone.

"There are no records of the birth of Fire Zombies in the Wind and Cloud World. It seems that the arrival of the players has completely broken the storyline, causing some mysterious creatures in hidden corners to start awakening."
At times, Ding Ling would shrink the ground into inches, covering hundreds of feet in an instant. Sometimes he would fly, transforming into a stream of light, chasing after Xiong Ba.
Xiong Ba’s fiery aura was growing dimmer and dimmer.
No need to say.
Xiong Ba’s main purpose in refining corpses must have been to absorb the Essence Qi from those people for his own use.
"It seems that even though his consciousness is muddled, his instincts to become stronger and to survive are still there."
The instinct to become stronger prompts him to kill.
The instinct to survive prompts him to run.
"A monster strong person left with only instincts cannot be allowed to remain."
Ding Ling made a decision in his heart.
Once the source of the Fire Zombie is found out.
Such a Fire Zombie like Xiong Ba, he will completely suppress and destroy!
If not, once he ascends, who else in this world can subdue and suppress the Fire Zombie?
Whizz, whizz!
Xiong Ba and Ding Ling, one in front and one behind, one with flames all over his body, shooting through the sky like a flaming meteor, the other was a starlight flying past.
After a moment.
Xiong Ba suddenly crashed headlong and feet upward, straight towards the lower realm of the Western Desert, boom! A loud noise.
Xiong Ba’s figure suddenly disappeared.
Ding Ling’s eyes slightly widened, thinking it might be another otherworldly space?!
He flew down, his feet landing on the desert.
This was the place of destruction for the Ancient Loulan Kingdom of the Western Regions.
Ding Ling has read countless ancient texts.
His understanding of the Wind and Cloud World surpasses that of countless natives.
So, with just a glance, using the Feng Shui Skill, Stargazing Skill, Tracking and Tracing skills, Ding Ling immediately realized where this place was.
"The Ancient Loulan Kingdom was buried and obliterated by sand overnight."
"And according to legend, before that, the Ancient Loulan Kingdom had a fierce war with neighboring countries over a divine object!
"The war caused Loulan’s national strength to decline, and after a sandstorm, it disappeared into the river of history."
This information comes from the ancient texts Ding Ling read.
At this moment, Xiong Ba suddenly disappeared from here.
In his surprise, Ding Ling couldn’t help but use his Stargazing Skill, Mechanical Skill, Feng Shui Skill, etc., to observe carefully.
Sure enough.
After a period of time.
He found a clue. It was a place with abnormal Spiritual Vitality fluctuations where Xiong Ba disappeared. An ordinary person walking by wouldn’t notice it at all.
But if subjected to a heavy impact, it could temporarily break a barrier to enter an unknowable divine realm.
"Perhaps that’s where the Fire Zombie originated."
Ding Ling drew the Emperor’s Sword, circling around in place.
Sure enough.
No abnormality.
An ordinary Innate Strong Person came here, even if a great battle occurred, it would probably be difficult to stir the waves of this otherworldly space.
And Xiong Ba is obviously stronger than an Innate Strong Person.
Ding Ling naturally shouldn’t say much.
He only slightly amplified his Vigorous Qi tenfold and passed through the abnormally fluctuating realm with his entire body.
The next instant!
Ding Ling’s vision turned black and then bright.
He found himself surprisingly in a tomb site.
Here, gusts of sand flew, a dim scene, looking around, one could vaguely see some remnants of buildings and palaces.

With a flash, Ding Ling traversed an unknown number of feet, standing at the entrance of a palace. Upon looking, the palace had long decayed beyond repair, but faintly, on a stone carving, the words ’Loulan’ could be seen.
"Indeed, this is the buried Ancient Loulan Kingdom. No wonder no one in the world can find it; it’s hidden this deeply. Finding this place is like seeing ghosts."
Ding Ling sighed inwardly, activating ’Tracking and Tracing’, and headed deep into the ruins of this ancient kingdom. Before long, Ding Ling came to a stop.
He stood in front of a giant turtle shell.
There were also unusual Spiritual Vitality fluctuations on the turtle’s back.
Very obviously.
Xiong Ba disappeared from there.
"An otherworldly space layered over another. But compared to the otherworldly space that leads to the Loulan ruins, the space here seems to be perpetually open. Even ordinary people can sense it."
Ding Ling stepped forward, about to walk through this ’portal’, into the second otherworldly space.
Suddenly, he sensed something unusual about the turtle’s back, so he slightly lowered his head and examined it carefully.
Sure enough.
What he saw shocked him.
"The turtle’s back seems to be inscribed with an astonishing Magic and Skill!"
It was Ding Ling who sensed the exceptional divinity fluctuations from the turtle’s back.
"This turtle’s back has divinity...
"And the purity of the divinity far surpasses that of the Fire Qilin. It seems to be an ancient? Prehistoric? Or early era adult auspicious beast?"
The answer is hard to know.
But Ding Ling knows that since there are extraordinary aspects.
There must be hidden opportunities.
He observed and indeed discovered.
His eyes locked onto the dozens of characters engraved on the turtle’s back.
Each word was crafted with meticulously chosen wording, containing countless ways and principles.
With just a glance.
Ding Ling almost got lost.
But after all, his cultivation is impressive, and he quickly recovered, silently praising:
"Incredible. The person who engraved on this turtle’s back is definitely a High Tier of the Shattering Level! But such a strong person is likely also dead."
An auspicious beast whose divinity surpasses the Fire Qilin.
And with a turtle’s back.
It can only be a Dragon Turtle!

And it is rumored that the Dragon Turtle’s essence blood was obtained by Xiaao Sanxiaao, who knows if this Dragon Turtle was stripped of its essence blood by Xiaao Sanxiaao, leading to it becoming weak, resulting in a disaster and then dying here, or because of other reasons?
Ding Ling did not delve into it.
He just read through the dozens of inscribed words once.
The words are few.
But they contain myriad transformations, seemingly full of the ultimate principles of the universe, infinite changes.
Ding Ling was also unable to comprehend entry level understanding in a short time.
But it doesn’t matter.
He merely recollected slightly, and a book immediately appeared on the bookshelf of the library.
The next moment.
[No Desire Easy Formula Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +300]
In just an instant, a drop of transparent True Water appeared in Ding Ling’s dantian.
This drop of True Water seemed to contain a supreme, immeasurable sense of being without desire or demand, natural with heaven and earth, eternally unchanged!
When Ding Ling slightly circulated this heart method, his whole person became peaceful, as if in harmony with this realm, becoming ethereal, wise, and extraordinary.
[Non-Desire Easiest Skill Full Level]
The External Skill was also mastered in an instant.
In a moment.
Ding Ling seemed to have mastered countless different skills.
Among them was the skill of leveraging force, Star Shifting, Heart Method Healing, and various incredible Sword Skills!

chapters.title: Chapter 714 - 703: Fire Zombie Origin Land
paragraphs: This No Desire Technique is extremely powerful!
It’s in no way inferior to the Profound Yin Twelve Swords, and in some respects, it’s even superior! It’s a method that harmonizes with the profound truths of heaven and earth!
This method is hard to master initially.
But once you get the basics, you can unleash its boundless power.
As long as your mind remains calm, desiring nothing, you will always remain invincible, the stronger you face, the stronger you become!
Ding Ling recalled that Bu Jingyun also learned this method in Wind and Cloud III.
But how many years after was that?
Could it be that after such drastic changes over time and space, the region of the Ancient Loulan has once again transformed, revealing the Dragon Turtle’s back and the ruins of Ancient Loulan?
Is that why the destined ones obtained the No Desire Technique engraved on the Dragon Turtle’s back?
Who knows the truth.
It’s hard to determine.
But there’s no doubt that the future has already been altered!
The direction of the Wind and Cloud World is beyond anyone’s knowledge.
After Ding Ling mastered the No Desire Technique.
[True Power Value: 86 points]
He grew stronger once again.
Not only did his True Power increase,
but his mastery over the Sword Skill had also reached a transcendent level.
The Profound Yin Twelve Swords can fully be combined with the No Desire Technique, and its power will multiply!
"I’ve maxed out the No Desire Technique. Bu Jingyun’s No Desire Technique likely isn’t maxed out."
It’s just that the initial mastery of the No Desire Technique is difficult.
Achieving perfection is even harder.
Let alone Great Perfection.
"It’s time to check out the origin of the Fire Zombie."
Unexpectedly acquiring an astonishing method and skill here,
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.

The mental state required by this method is extraordinary; once Ding Ling activates it, he can align with nature, unperturbed even if the sky should fall, handling all tactics calmly! It’s a method perfect for killing and combat!
Tap tap!
Ding Ling stepped forward to the doorway and then walked straight through.
The next moment.
Before he could stabilize himself, a fist the size of an alms bowl suddenly appeared before him.

Instinctively, Ding Ling punched out with Thunder Strike Fist! Boom! His fist, infused with bursts of thunder, collided heavily with the enemy’s fist, accompanied by a cracking sound and a muffled groan as the assailant was sent flying dozens of meters away.
Seizing the opportunity, Ding Ling looked around.
With this look.
He saw clearly what kind of place this was.
Gloomy, desolate, barren, yellowish, and devoid of life, yet with a hint of lingering vitality!
It was a wasteland of dried wells and crumbling walls, red earth stretching for miles!
Only a few scattered figures here and there added a bit of color to this world.
Looking up.
It was a chaos-colored sky.
Impossible to see what lay beyond the heavens above.
And at the far end of this world, raging fires burned intensely, resembling a glimmer of hope in this dark, desolate world.
Ding Ling employed Shrinking Inches to move forward, striking towards Xiong Ba, who had just attacked him.
Rumble! Thunder flickered in his palm, and Ding Ling unleashed the Overlord Thunder Shock of the Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao!
"Thud!"
Xiong Ba suddenly knelt down, struggling to utter two words:
"Spare... me!"
Though his words were unclear.
Even the two words came out haltingly, taking a long while to utter, like a mute who just learned to speak.
Boom!
Ding Ling’s hand paused beside Xiong Ba’s head, retracting his arm, as he gazed at Xiong Ba intently.
Xiong Ba, having transformed from a grotesque beast-like form with muscular bulges, now appeared as a withered old man.
Clearly, his previous rapid escape had greatly exhausted him.
But compared to before,
Now Xiong Ba’s eyes were no longer a chaotic hue but rather much clearer, giving off a sense of being alive.
"Are you Xiong Ba?"
Ding Ling asked.
"Yes."
Xiong Ba painfully uttered, his voice grating and hoarse, like sandpaper scraping the ground. The scratchy sound was unsettling.
"Are you dead or not?"
"No, not dead!"
"Ha."
Ding Ling chuckled softly:
"What exactly happened to you?"
"I, I’ll take you, you’ll, you’ll find out."
Xiong Ba’s speech became increasingly fluent, but he still stuttered.
"Oh?"
Ding Ling gave Xiong Ba a deep look, indicating for him to lead the way.
Xiong Ba then rose, turned, and walked forward.
His gait was stiff, bouncing like a zombie.
Yet compared to ordinary zombies, Xiong Ba was excessively powerful.
But perhaps weakened, or perhaps he had exhausted all the Essence and Blood Qi from his previous corpse refinement, he seemed a lot clearer now, with a touch of human flavor to him.
Ding Ling found it quite incredible.
Even at this point.
Xiong Ba was still not dead?! Fire Zombie, zombie... Indeed, as expected of a supernatural being beyond the containment of the Heavenly Dao!
Rumble, rumble, rumble!
Xiong Ba bounced far, each leap spanning a hundred meters, each landing sounding like heavy horse hooves striking the ground!
After a while.
Ding Ling had reached the edge of this Otherworldly Space.
He saw a low grave.
The grave had already been forcibly opened.
Exposing a coffin.
Hundreds of zombies stood around the coffin.
Most of these zombies emitted black aura, their eyes lifeless and chaotic, devoid of any vitality, seemingly long decayed.
Only five zombies stood on a Five Elements Array, their bodies exuding firelight, contending against waves of black aura rushing towards them.
These five zombies, Ding Ling knew at a glance, must have recently mutated, just like Xiong Ba.
Because their clothing was distinctly different from the other zombies, clearly from a different era.
"That’s... it’s her, her..."
Xiong Ba pointed to the woman in the coffin:
"It’s her, her blood, that changed us, made us mutate."
Ding Ling stepped forward to observe closely.
The coffin was carved from cold jade.
The woman inside was dressed in a crimson robe.
She lay there silently.
Her face, pale with an eerie touch of black aura.
Her features impeccably refined, her beauty unparalleled, rare in this world, with an aura of ethereal and saintly essence enveloping her, one glance and you knew her extraordinariness.
Her fingers were bleeding.
As soon as approached.
The blood floated unusually, rushing towards Ding Ling like a flash, seemingly to merge with him!
Seeing this, Ding Ling instantly realized why Xiong Ba had turned into a zombie.
Moreover, Xiong Ba had brought him here with ill intent.
Ding Ling was furious.
Retreating several hundred meters with a single leap, he struck with a punch!
Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao!
Five Thunders Strike the Head!
Boom! Electricity crackled unpredictably on his fist, amplifying the punch forty times. As it blasted out, the cracking sound echoed across Heaven’s Edge, colliding heavily with the blood.
Boom!
The blood retreated a meter, but then accelerated, rushing towards Ding Ling once more.
Ding Ling was taken aback. A mere drop of this blood was so powerful.
Who exactly was this woman?!

A mere drop of this blood was so powerful.
Who exactly was this woman?!

chapters.title: Chapter 715 - 704: Female Drought Demon
paragraphs: Ding Ling immediately flicked his left hand, and the Emperor’s Sword’s tip launched a sharp Sword Qi!
Clang!

The Sword Qi and the blood clashed fiercely in the void, continuing for a while before the blood abruptly scattered into Blood Qi and then transformed back into a drop of blood, falling into the woman’s palm.
This drop of blood differed from before, it was dimmer and had lost much of its color.
It seemed as though its essence had been dispersed!
Crack!
The woman’s eyelids suddenly trembled, and she opened her eyes sharply.
Ding Ling’s vision was exceptionally strong and detailed, naturally allowing him to see clearly, making him even more vigilant and cautious, ready at any moment to escape.
This place was too eerie and strange.
He truly hadn’t expected that in the Wind and Cloud World, there would still be someone this powerful!
The Emperor Sword Dao at ninety times power could only break a drop of blood!
Too bizarre!
"Young man, come here."
A faint voice echoed in Ding Ling’s ear.
Ding Ling was startled, but swiftly retreated several hundred feet.
"Do not be afraid. I am the daughter of the Ancient Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan... Female Drought Demon!"
Her voice was as gentle as water, directly reaching into one’s heart, making it feel like heavenly music.
But this voice grew weaker and weaker, much like a flickering flame about to extinguish, emitting its last glimmer of light.
Ding Ling was taken aback:
"Female Drought Demon?!"
Isn’t the Female Drought Demon just the Drought Fiend?!
No wonder this place was dry, desolate, and barren, with hardly a trace of life.
The Drought Fiend would explain it.
According to ancient records: whenever a Drought Fiend passed through, not a single blade of grass survived, and the ground cracked!
She was the deity of droughts!
Of course, she also had contributions, and it was rumored that she played a part in defeating Chiyou!
"It seems that people still remember me."
The Female Drought Demon seemed to see through Ding Ling’s thoughts, softly spoke:
"I apologize for what happened earlier."
Ding Ling was silent.
"It is an instinct of mine at work."
The Female Drought Demon sighed, her voice desolate like autumn leaves falling, filled with a sense of death and helplessness:

"I must suppress the Demon Realm and guard the gate of the Divine Realm. This requires someone to help me. You saw it. My loyal subordinates, in order to resist the invasion of the Demon Realm, have all perished."
Her tone was filled with sorrow:
"Even the Immortal Zombies have died. In the end, it is the lack of power that allowed the Demon Dao to run rampant!"
Ding Ling listened in silence, not speaking.
The Female Drought Demon didn’t reproach Ding Ling, just continued speaking to herself:

"I am also about to reach my limit. But I must guard this place, otherwise, if the Demon Realm portal wide opens, Jiuzhou will completely fall, and the world my father struggled to protect will become a wasteland, utterly devoid of life. This is not something I wish to see. Even in death, I must guard this place!"
The Female Drought Demon paused, then continued:

"I am dying, caught in a state of unconsciousness, driven by the overwhelming desire to guard this place! Thus, my blood will, upon sensing the presence of a living person, want to merge with them, turning them into a Fire Zombie to assist me.
You saw it too.

The five Fire Zombies on the Five Elements Array were humans who intruded here a few months ago. I also didn’t want to harm them, but things have reached this point where I can’t do anything about it."
"Then how did Xiong Ba escape?"
Ding Ling asked.
"Xiong Ba?"
The Female Drought Demon’s eyelids moved as if seeing Xiong Ba, said:

"Him? His willpower is extremely strong, coupled with his unique talent, he managed to retain a sliver of independent consciousness, allowing him to escape. Others weren’t as fortunate. My blood transformed them thoroughly, into puppet-like beings devoid of consciousness, spirit, and perception, who know only to guard this place alongside me."
She apologized to Ding Ling once again.
Ding Ling, seeing the Female Drought Demon’s attitude, immediately asked:
"What evidence do you have to prove you are the Female Drought Demon?"
"I will show you the Demon Realm portal and the Divine Realm portal, then you will know if I’m telling the truth or not."
The Female Drought Demon strained to extend an unblemished hand, gently tapping the ground, Bang!
A coffin soared into the sky, spinning and floating to land not far beside Ding Ling.
Once the coffin was moved.
Boom!
A surge of Demon Qi seemed to break free from suppression, roaring straight into the sky! The Demon Qi surged endlessly, while to the left of the Demon Realm stood a gate of the Divine Realm.
The portal was dim and lackluster, seemingly ready to decay at any moment.

"You saw it. When Dao wanes, magic flourishes. If I perish. And without other Fire Zombies to guard, Demon Qi will flood into the human world, even Mystical Beasts will transform into Demon Beasts. Do you think humanity could withstand this tide of demonic flames?"
The Female Drought Demon sighed.
Ding Ling remained silent.
He was skilled in acting, observing people, stargazing, feng shui, etc., and naturally discerned that the Female Drought Demon wasn’t lying.
However, it might be because her realm far exceeded his, and what he saw could have been just an illusion she wanted him to see?
The logic here was hard to explain clearly.
Having been deceived by Chiyou once, Ding Ling was naturally cautious of these beings from the Ancient Era.
But this Demon Qi couldn’t be faked.
And it seemed the Female Drought Demon had been guarding the portal all along, otherwise, given her strength, she would have long entered Jiuzhou Land. Why stay here ’playing hero’?
Fighting against this Demon Qi, allowing herself to be completely exhausted?

Though Ding Ling and the Female Drought Demon’s realms were worlds apart, unable to discern if she was dying, he knew regardless of her state, just a drop of her blood could head-to-head with his ninety times magnified Sword Qi, proving her formidable strength could easily sweep across Jiuzhou, without a problem.
Yet she chose not to do so, instead willingly guarding this portal!
"It seems you have understood."

The Female Drought Demon laboriously sat up from within the coffin, turned to look at Ding Ling, a flash of radiant light passing through her crystalline and clear eyes, as if seeing through Ding Ling, showing a hint of astonishment on her face:

"Young man, your roots are ordinary, yet at such a young age, you’ve reached the High Tier of Shattering, ready to step into the Great Perfection at any moment, not to mention mastering countless Martial Arts.
You’ve learned so vast and complex Martial Dao, yet all are at Great Perfection.
Incredible. Such a feat was hard even for the Human Emperor of the Ancient times.
What astounds me the most is, you’ve actually mastered the Demon Scripture?! And it’s at Great Perfection!"
A streak of joy appeared on her face:
"With this Great Perfection Demon Scripture, you can navigate the Demon Realm freely, unafraid of the Demon Qi."
She sighed:

"Indeed, I endured several thousand years. Finally, I’ve awaited the destined one. You carry the Xuanyuan Divine Sword, the Treasure Saber forged with the Nuwa Stone as the core, and even my finger hidden in your Storage Pouch. Many of your things are related to us gods. It seems you are a blessed person sent by Heaven."
Her spirits slightly lifted, looking at Ding Ling with anticipation:
"Young man, what is your name?"
"Ding Ling."

chapters.title: Chapter 716 - 705: River of Time and Space
paragraphs: "Ding Ling."
The Female Drought Demon nodded and said:
"Are you willing to rescue the Human Race, to save Jiuzhou and this world?"
"Of course, I am willing."
Ding Ling solemnly replied.
"Good."
The Female Drought Demon smiled faintly, though her face was pale, it couldn’t hide her stunning beauty:
"I will grant you an opportunity. I hope that once you become stronger, you can soar ninety thousand miles up. Strike against the Demon Dao. Save all beings from peril."
She flexed her finger towards the direction of the Divine Realm gateway.
Thunk!
An ethereal sound swept past the ear.
When Ding Ling looked again, he saw the Divine Realm gateway had opened.
The Female Drought Demon said laboriously:
"Ding Ling, hurry. This is the Celestial Path leading to the Divine Realm. Step on the Celestial Path, and you will meet the Divine Being. He will teach you the Demon Suppression Technique."
Ding Ling hesitated, but after some thought, he stepped forward.
It was because he remembered that he still had the opportunity to return to the Lower Realm or traverse other worlds, in case of real danger.
At that time, he could choose to travel to other worlds right away to avoid it.
And the Female Drought Demon indeed seemed unable to hold on.
Without thinking much, Ding Ling pulled out the Fire Finger from his Storage Pouch and tossed it to the Female Drought Demon:
"Senior, take it."
The Female Drought Demon pinched the Fire Finger with her jade-like fingers, then attached it to her severed finger. Before long, her bleeding finger stopped bleeding.
Quite evidently.
This Fire Finger indeed belonged to her.
Ding Ling was astonished and puzzled, wondering why Emperor Shitian had gotten hold of this Fire Finger.
One must know that the power of the Female Drought Demon is beyond imagination; a single drop of her blood could give Emperor Shitian a hard time. How did Emperor Shitian acquire this Fire Finger?
The Female Drought Demon seemed to perceive what Ding Ling was thinking:
"My Divine Power is limited and cannot sustain the gateway to the Divine Realm for too long. Ding Ling, when you return, I will explain everything in detail."
Ding Ling could only nod. Then his body transformed into a stream of light, diving into the Divine Realm gateway.
Originally, he intended to kill Xiong Ba.
But considering the strength of the Female Drought Demon

Xiong Ba would likely become nothing more than a Fire Zombie under the Female Drought Demon. How could a benevolent deity like her, who cares for all beings, possibly allow a Fire Zombie to tread on Jiuzhou Land, bringing harm to the living?
Sure enough.
After Ding Ling stepped into the Divine Realm gateway,
The Female Drought Demon gently patted the ground.
The coffin flew up again, suppressing the portal to the Demon Realm.
The Divine Realm gateway, the Female Drought Demon left a man-sized gap for Ding Ling to return.
After she had obtained the Fire Finger, she seemed to have regained some vitality; her entire demeanor became slightly more spirited. She looked at Xiong Ba and said:
"You should not go out and bring harm to Jiuzhou."
Xiong Ba’s face showed fear and dread.
He attempted to flee at the side.
But with a gentle point of the Female Drought Demon’s finger, he was toppled to the ground.
Then the Female Drought Demon pointed at the positions of the other five Fire Zombies, and Xiong Ba involuntarily fell near them.
He neatly joined the five Fire Zombies to form a Six Harmonies Array.
The Six Harmonies Array was evidently superior to the Five Elements Array.
With Xiong Ba’s addition, the coffin shone brightly, and the suppression force seemed to increase once more.
Xiong Ba was immobilized, forced to cooperate with the other five Fire Zombies, his face showing evident frustration, resentment, discontent, and fear.
"In the Jiuzhou World, do you have no one you care about?"
The Female Drought Demon sighed softly and said:
"Don’t you wish to avoid the Demon Qi flooding the human world, causing your loved ones to fall into demonhood and perish?"
With these words,
Xiong Ba recalled something, and the resentment, frustration, and fear slowly faded from his face and eyes. He looked towards the sky, muttering incomprehensibly.
Thunk!
It seemed to pass through a curtain of water.
In the next instant, Ding Ling stepped onto a ladder akin to a Celestial Ladder.
Ding Ling was secretly astonished.
In the Valley of Eternal Spring of the Celestial Dragon World, there was a Celestial Ladder.
He had not expected that in the Wind and Cloud World there would be one too! And apparently, there was more than one.
He recalled Bai Suzhen telling him about the Path to Heaven, which required Infinite Power to activate at a specific time and place.
Ding Ling remembered the location; he planned to ascend to the pinnacle of the world before setting foot on that Path to Heaven.
Unexpectedly, he was a step ahead, stepping onto this gateway leading to the Divine Realm.
Tap tap!
Ding Ling was quite familiar with such a Celestial Ladder Path.
Thus he moved quickly.

Whoosh! Like the wind, he ascended rapidly, cutting through a dimensional world. In the next second, his vision brightened, revealing roiling waves all around, with numerous shadows appearing and disappearing in the water.
"Where is this?"
Ding Ling stood on the Celestial Ladder, overlooking the great river of the Lower Realm.
It was vast and broad beyond sight, with no clear origin, yet it flowed forward. At about a thousand feet ahead, a fork suddenly appeared.
The mighty river, or perhaps it should be called the ocean’s water, split into two from there.
But what struck Ding Ling as peculiar were these two diverging water paths.
One gradually became illusory and thin, like the moon in water.
The other grew increasingly real, like a mirage manifesting into reality.
"How strange."
Ding Ling glanced at it before moving on along the Celestial Path.
He knew the peculiarities of this ocean, yet he hadn’t rashly stepped into it to avoid unforeseen incidents.
"Finally, I see you!"
However, he had just barely dashed a hundred feet when a soft sigh suddenly echoed.
This voice carried a hint of satisfaction, as if someone whose lifelong wish had been fulfilled, experiencing great joy and freedom.
The sound hadn’t fallen entirely.
A shadow suddenly soared from the ocean, slamming a palm heavily in Ding Ling’s direction!
Rumbling!
This palm strike caused the world to tremble, the ocean to surge, and an energy storm surged frantically towards Ding Ling, as if to crush him to dust.
Ding Ling was alarmed; his instincts told him he couldn’t withstand this strike!
Yet, to his surprise, smack!
The palm was actually stopped outside the Celestial Path, unable to approach him.
But even so, it still made the Celestial Path tremble incessantly.
As if it might decay and collapse at any moment.
"Who are you!"
Ding Ling shouted angrily.
Who wouldn’t be angry when attacked for no reason?
Not to mention, the assailant clearly intended to kill him!
"People call me the Half-God!"
The figure exhibited extraordinary demeanor, his words powerful and sonorous.
He was armored all over, resembling a mechanical life form, emitting faint clicking sounds of gears turning, which Ding Ling heard despite their subtleness.
"Half-God?!"
Ding Ling was taken aback.
This was an unparalleled formidable figure; he never expected to encounter him here.
"Aren’t you from the future?!"
Ding Ling shouted.
"Indeed."
The Half-God sighed, standing on the crest of the ocean waves:
"I traveled upstream along the river of time, after many twists and turns, and finally found you!"
His eyes were profound:
"The future has already changed drastically, even the world I was in has begun to unravel, becoming void and hollow, all this because of you!"

Ding Ling ignored the Half-God and continued forward on the Celestial Ladder.
The Half-God seemed enraged and shouted:
"If it weren’t for your arrival, we wouldn’t be at risk of annihilation, wouldn’t be facing this disaster. It’s all because of you! So today, I must destroy you!"
Ding Ling was momentarily stunned, then quickened his pace.
He was the first ’player’ to enter the Fengyun world.
With his arrival, the Fengyun world began to head into the unknown, and as countless players and Ascendants entered, the storyline of the Fengyun world collapsed completely.
Can he be blamed alone for this?
Ding Ling looked at the Half-God.
This powerful being who could traverse time and space.
Currently, he was not his match.
Better to retreat to fight another day!
Whoosh whoosh!
Ding Ling used the Free-Will Ascension Step at forty times amplification, and amid the sounds of whooshing, had already disappeared towards Heaven’s Edge.
"You can’t leave!"
The Half-God chased with all his might, wanting to set foot on the Celestial Ladder.
But this Celestial Ladder had its own defenses, blocking him outside.
He chased Ding Ling along the defense light of the Celestial Ladder.
His palms occasionally struck towards Ding Ling’s position, making the Celestial Ladder tremble intermittently, as if it might collapse and shatter at any moment.
In the middle, Ding Ling amplified the Emperor Sword Dao ninety times, attacking the Half-God with Sword Qi, but it was easily blocked by the Half-God.
The Half-God’s attack could not reach Ding Ling.
But Ding Ling could hit him instead!

Ding Ling’s eyes brightened slightly and immediately unleashed various Ultimate Techniques at the Half-God. The booming sounds were unending, but besides suffering some minor injuries, the Half-God was completely unharmed.
Ding Ling was moved.
He no longer hesitated and sped up towards the top of the Celestial Ladder.
"You are not allowed to leave!"
The Half-God angrily struck the Celestial Ladder, his palms making it creak under the strain.
The strength of this person had reached a terrifying level for Ghost Gods.
Ding Ling hadn’t expected to meet the Half-God here!
Moreover, the Celestial Ladder in this Divine Realm portal could directly pass above the long river of time-space!
No wonder he felt a strange familiarity when looking at the river, it was because he saw some familiar people and things within the long river.
Upon closer thought, it seemed he saw figures like Wuming and Emperor Shitian among the figures occasionally leaping from the long river of time-space.
It showed they were heroes, strong beings.

Only strong beings might be able to leap temporarily out of the long river of time-space, while ordinary people could only sink into it, unable to leap, not even in death to be engraved in the heights of the long river of time-space, known to the world.
And Ding Ling?
Nonetheless, he walked over the top of the long river of time-space, such an incredible feat, if known to the world, would likely cause collective shock.
Da da!
Ding Ling passed through another dimensional world again.
"Ah!"
The roar of the Lower Realm’s Half-God grew more and more distant until it could no longer be heard.
He turned back to look, only to see chaos.
"Truly strange."
Ding Ling secretly marveled.

Indeed, the Celestial Ladder of this Divine Realm portal was like the Celestial Ladder in other worlds, able to pierce through dimensional worlds to reach a dimension completely different from the current world.
He continued to sprint, passing through another dimension, finally arriving at a new world.
He surveyed.
The world was vast!
Yet desolate, barren!
No signs of life!
Ding Ling instantly traveled a thousand feet, rushing, half a moment later, he finally saw ruins of a palace group.
Examining closely.
Only to find here desolate walls and overgrown weeds, clearly a ruin.
"Is this the Divine Realm?!"
Ding Ling was slightly disappointed.
Not at all like his imagination of a sky filled with Divine Buddhas.
"This is the Divine Realm!"
An abrupt voice sounded.
Ding Ling was startled, turned to look:
"Who?"
"I am here."
Ding Ling turned his head again, only to find a person standing before him at some unknown time.
Half of him was golden and radiant like the Great Sun.
The other half was black and deep like demons roaring at the Bottom of the Abyss;
Clad in a Kasaya, half serene and benevolent, half terrifying and hideous.
A monk.
"You are?!"
Ding Ling instinctively took a step back.
"I am the Great Sun Buddha!"
The monk clapped his palms together, chanting Amitabha Buddha, then said:
"Ding Ling. I know you. I’ve been waiting for you. You haven’t disappointed me, finding your way to this Celestial Palace."
"You’ve been waiting for me?
Ding Ling found it absurd.
"Indeed."
The Great Sun Buddha solemnly said:
"I know about the deeds of you Aliens. Moreover, based on the course of the future, I reach a conclusion. Only you might truly end the demons of the Lower Realm."
"Why can’t you, as Buddha, take action yourself?"
Ding Ling remembered.
It seems there is indeed a Great Sun Buddha in Fengyun world.
He resides above the long river of time-space, looking down on all beings.
Now walking through the ladder to here seems well fitting this situation?
The Great Sun Buddha indeed resides above the long river of time-space, capable of overseeing all beings!
"I cannot act."
The Great Sun Buddha sighed:

"Once I take action, I will become the Demon Buddha. You’ve seen my current situation. Once my Buddha nature can’t suppress my Demon nature, I will fall completely into the Demon Dao, becoming an actual Demon Buddha. Then, not only the Lower Realm will collapse, time-space, Divine Realm, Sword Realm, all worlds will shatter in the hands of the Demon Buddha!"
Ding Ling was shocked, confused:
"Then, how can I end the demons?"
Ding Ling thought about the task list.
He couldn’t help but feel overwhelmed.
How can he cultivate to be stronger than the Great Sun Buddha?
Unless...
The Great Sun Buddha is not considered part of Fengyun world!
It seems logical to think so.
Like in the Celestial Dragon World.

Above the Celestial Ladder Path in the Valley of Eternal Spring, there is a broken Immortal Realm. The Immortal Realm also has supreme beings! Ding Ling once fought Duan Yu’s ancestor Duan Siping in a Magical Battle.
Duan Siping’s methods absolutely surpass the Celestial Dragon World’s strongest ’Li Canghai’.
Yet the world task progression is not based on the Celestial Realm on the ladder path but on the Lower Realm’s Li Canghai.
It shows the existence of the Great Sun Buddha should be like Duan Siping.
It belongs to the dimension above the ladder path, to other dimensional worlds, not the Lower Realm, so the task progression targeted for the number one being should not be the Great Sun Buddha.
If it were indeed the Great Sun Buddha.
Ding Ling also doesn’t know when he would cultivate to the point of defeating him!
Because standing before this Buddha, Ding Ling had a sense of trembling, being as insignificant as an ant!
This sense so clear made Ding Ling involuntarily shiver.
"End the demon?"
The Great Sun Buddha clapped his palms together and said:

"I have a method that can destroy the demon. However, this method requires the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture of the Yellow Emperor to cooperate. Once you get this method, you can go to the Celestial Realm to seek the Yellow Emperor."
"The Yellow Emperor is still alive?"

chapters.title: Chapter 718 - 707: Great Sun Buddha
paragraphs: "When cultivation reaches a certain level, one becomes imperishable even if the heaven and earth decay."
The Great Sun Buddha said:

"It’s a pity, though, that I am still far from such a realm. So, we must protect this place we reside in, ensuring that heaven and earth don’t perish. For this, I, Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, and others have battled these monsters.
Although we emerged victorious,
the price was gruesome.
You have also seen the state of the Divine Realm. In that battle, countless divine spirits perished, and the Demon Realm collapsed and fell,"

"But as far as I know, in a great war among demons, humans, and gods, the Demon Realm has already collapsed, and the Divine Realm fell together with the Demon Realm. Yet, the Divine Realm remains, and the Demon Realm still exists?"
"Your understanding is quite fragmentary."
The Great Sun Buddha continued:
"Indeed, that battle caused the collapse of all the Great Realms. But there is a dark force in the Demon Realm that heals itself, allowing the Demon Realm to continually restore itself.
If it weren’t for the Female Drought Demon guarding the gates of the Demon Realm, the Demon Realm might have already been fully restored, returning to the world of men."
At this point, the Great Sun Buddha paused and sighed:

"As a divine maiden of the Celestial Realm, the Female Drought Demon, with her divinity and flames, is the nemesis of Demon Qi. Without her, heaven and earth, and we ourselves, might have long been perished."
Only then did Ding Ling realize the greatness of the Female Drought Demon, unavoidably growing a sense of admiration, and asked:
"The Female Drought Demon’s senior told me to visit the Divine Realm, where a divine being would teach me the Demon Suppression Technique. Was she referring to you, Buddha?"
"Indeed."
The Great Sun Buddha smiled slightly, half like a Buddha, half like a god, brilliantly radiant on one side, deep and dark on the other:

"In the Dao of Fire, the Female Drought Demon is exceptionally gifted, unparalleled! She sacrificed herself to guard the Demon Realm, willingly becoming a zombie abhorred by heaven, earth, humans, gods, and ghosts! Her deeds and merits are worthy of celestial praise!"
He looked at Ding Ling and said:
"Since the Female Drought Demon believes you have the chance to suppress demons, I will now teach you the Demon Suppression Technique."
The Great Sun Buddha’s speech became increasingly rapid:
"I cannot stay before people for long, due to the heavy demon nature within me. If I linger further, I fear I might turn into a demon again."
Ding Ling mentioned his learning of the Demon Scripture.
The Great Sun Buddha replied:

"Though your Demon Scripture is incredibly powerful, enabling you to traverse freely within Demon Qi, my soul and body have already merged with Demon Qi. If the demon perishes, I shall perish as well. Moreover, such demons are beyond your ability to extinguish; once you attempt to suppress it, this demon nature will fully erupt, and I fear even my Buddha nature won’t hold him back. If this happens, you will undoubtedly be vanquished by me here."
Having said this, he suddenly began expounding on the method:
"I have little time left. Ding Ling, watch carefully and listen attentively as I demonstrate the Demon Suppression Technique."
The Great Sun Buddha swiftly recited the mantra and demonstrated the moves.
Ding Ling watched meticulously.
Seemingly to make it clearer for Ding Ling, the Great Sun Buddha’s hand seals were not very fast, yet swift as a phantasm, discernible only by someone of Ding Ling’s level at a glance.
Clearly, every action of the Great Sun Buddha was precisely controlled, having evidently reached the pinnacle of natural mastery over power.
Ding Ling quickly finished observing the transmission.
Recalling briefly, in just an instant.
[Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell: Full Level]
An immense and boundless Buddha Light instantly emanated from Ding Ling.
Complemented by the Buddha Qi from his heart.
This Buddha Light further accentuated Ding Ling as if seated upon a lotus platform Buddha, carrying an inherent aura of deterrence!
"Remarkable."
The Great Sun Buddha marveled, impressed, and swiftly said:
"Next, I’ll transmit the Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse to you."
He demonstrated quickly.
After Ding Ling observed, it too reached full level in an instant.
The Buddha Light emanating from him grew more abundant and supreme.

The Great Sun Buddha’s heart trembled, Ding Ling’s astonishing talent exceeded his imagination; he knew Ding Ling must harbor a great secret, otherwise, how could one person be so extraordinarily abnormal to such an unbelievable degree?
He was very curious, wanting to uncover the truth, but as soon as this thought arose, his demon nature suddenly erupted, seeming to want to engulf him.
The Great Sun Buddha took a deep breath, not daring to inquire further into Ding Ling’s secrets, and solemnly said:
"Next is the Heaven and Earth Righteous Qi Curse, which I have comprehended after thousands of years. Listen carefully, watch closely."
Just after the Great Sun Buddha finished reciting the Heaven and Earth Righteous Qi Curse.
His face was already covered with black aura, his eyes deeply gazed at Ding Ling, with light flickering uncertainly, as if about to devour a person.
Ding Ling, heart pounding, called out ’Buddha!’
The Great Sun Buddha was startled, regained clarity, quickly recited ’Amitabha Buddha, sins, sins,’ and then twisted and disappeared from Ding Ling’s sight.
As he left, he didn’t even leave any parting words.
This showed how seriously his demon nature exploded this time; he couldn’t even spare the mind to talk with Ding Ling about other matters.
Ding Ling was speechless, bewildered, thinking:
"These three spell seal skills, although extremely advanced and formidable, are nemeses of evil demons. Yet, without a method to drive them, how are they to be used?"
Regardless of whether it’s the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, or the Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse, and the Heaven and Earth Righteous Qi Curse, they all surpass the shattering level of skill.
Such skills are too advanced.
The methods Ding Ling is currently cultivating cannot even fully activate them.
It’s like a child getting a giant hammer worth a thousand gold pieces, unable to lift it;
Or like a battery-powered bike trying to pull a truck, it just can’t move it.

"The Great Sun Buddha told me to go to the Celestial Realm to ask Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan for the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, saying the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, combined with the spell seal skills, can be used to exert their power. But where is the Celestial Realm? How should I reach it?"
Ding Ling wandered in the Divine Realm for a while, unable to find the Great Sun Buddha, until he couldn’t help but shout:
"Buddha, where is the Celestial Realm?!"
As his voice faded.
A golden line suddenly appeared in the void.
This golden line meandered forward, seeming to guide Ding Ling.
Ding Ling followed the tracking trail, arriving at a shattered palace’s entrance in the center of the Divine Realm, finding a portal that flickered in and out of sight with a flowing halo around it.
The golden line pointed directly at the portal.
After some consideration, Ding Ling stepped inside, and in the next moment, as if heaven and earth turned, he felt a dizzying sensation, then found himself already at the entrance of a grand palace.
This palace was extraordinarily vast.
Entirely constructed of white jade.
At this moment, Ding Ling stood on a jade step, looking around, resembling an ant in a world of white, incomparably small.
"This Celestial Realm is enormous."
Ding Ling was moved.
Compared to the Divine Realm.
Only this Celestial Realm finally seemed to possess a vastness and boundlessness enough to cause mortals to gaze in awe and worshippingly.

He continued to walk forward tirelessly along the seemingly endless jade steps, realizing suddenly after some time that he had unconsciously arrived at the very center of the grand hall in the Celestial Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 719 - 708: Master of the Celestial Realm
paragraphs: Ding Ling turned back to look.
The jade steps he had just walked were only 999 steps.

There was no infinite number, but rather a mysterious technique was imprinted on these jade steps. Once ordinary people set foot there, they would become extremely small, feeling everything immeasurably vast.
Only upon entering the Main Hall.
Would this feeling disappear.
Ding Ling was greatly astonished. Looking again at this Celestial Realm, though still extraordinary, it no longer had that immeasurable feeling.
And at the uppermost position of the Main Hall.
Sits a person.
This person was nothing but a skeleton, with no recognizable features, but just sitting there gave a sense of overwhelming dominance, enough to make Jiuzhou’s people submit!
"Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan?"
Ding Ling called out.
He didn’t know where Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan was.
But the golden thread no longer appeared, so he figured this should be his destination.
"Young man. I already know your purpose."
Following a voice gentle like jade.
From the skeleton, a golden light suddenly floated out.
The golden light quickly condensed into a human figure.
This man was tall and imposing, filled with Righteous Qi. He wore a dragon robe and a crown, standing on the steps, his eyes locked onto Ding Ling:
"Watch closely. This is the technique of the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture."
This man wasted no words, directly speaking of the technique to Ding Ling and demonstrated it at the same time.
He seemed to have no time to explain esoteric truths or essence.
Or perhaps he already knew of Ding Ling’s unrivaled talent, so he didn’t waste words, but went straight to the point, finishing the explanation and demonstration in just a moment.
Ding Ling recalled slightly.
In the next moment.
[Xuanyuan Heart Scripture Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +600]
A surge of Spiritual Vitality poured in.
The Spiritual Vitality of this Celestial Realm was much purer than that of the Lower Realm, and just a little absorption.
Ding Ling’s Dantian gained two drops of golden True Water!
This True Water was different from other True Waters; a single drop felt as heavy, vast, and supreme as a mountain.
It settled at the core of the Tai Chi Bagua in the Dantian.
The original core was the Ten Thousand Dao Forest, but now it became centered around the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture.

The True Qi and True Water of Divine Skills like the Eternal Youth Technique, Demon Scripture, Black Tortoise True Skill, Ten Thousand Dao Forest, No Desire Technique, and Nine Yang Divine Skill all rooted in a position of the Tai Chi Bagua, slowly rotating around the True Water of the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture.
Under the automatic operation of the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, other Divine Skills would rotate along, aiding the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, enabling it to exert great power!
"Achieved Great Perfection in an instant."
The dignified dragon-robed man sighed with appreciation:

"Indeed, the future of the world must belong to unparalleled geniuses like you. Only with individuals like you will there be a turning point in the heavens and earth! Ding Ling, now that I’ve imparted my Fundamental Technique, the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, to you, the arduous task of sweeping away the Demon Realm is yours. I hope you won’t disappoint me!"
The man laughed heartily, seemingly very gratified and satisfied:
"To have met a descendant like you before completely dissipating, I, Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, have no regrets!"
As the voice fell.
The man suddenly turned to light and vanished.
"Senior. Senior!"
Ding Ling was shocked, calling out several times but no one responded.
"This is..."
Ding Ling was unsure and puzzled, as Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan only passed on an exceptional Fundamental Technique to him before dissipating. What is the reason for this?
"Could it be that Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan has already died, and what just appeared was a wisp of his will? A remnant soul? Completing his last wish before disappearing directly?"
Ding Ling was at a loss:
"If that’s really so, then the situation in the Celestial Realm might be worse than I imagined."
The Great Sun Buddha doesn’t even know if Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan really died.
It’s evident that the Great Sun Buddha has always been suppressing his demon nature.

Perhaps Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan was also worried about his death being revealed, causing the Great Sun Buddha’s heart and spirit to be disturbed, and subsequently, his demon nature gaining the upper hand, by then the collapse of Jiuzhou and the destruction of various realms would only be a matter of time.
Therefore, Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan had to hide his death.
After all, as the Master of the Celestial Realm, an absolute powerhouse, his death alone would unnerve the Great Sun Buddha. How could the Great Sun Buddha not be aghast?
"Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, truly a worthy leader of the Human Race! This mind, this courage, this responsibility, is indeed rare in the world."
Ding Ling admired, bowing three times towards the skeleton of Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan:
"Senior, since I’ve received your heritage, I will certainly strive to sweep away the Demon Realm and restore peace to the world."
"Hahaha, good, good!"
In the faint air, Ding Ling seemed to hear an approving laughter echo in the void.
But when listening closely, no matter what, he couldn’t hear it again.
"An illusion?"
Ding Ling sighed and turned to leave.
But just as he stepped toward the Main Hall door.
He sensed the peculiarity of this Celestial Realm.
"Heaven and Earth’s Righteous Qi here is vast like an ocean, but it’s being consumed every moment, and this consumption seems to be directed towards the Demon Realm below?"
Ding Ling pondered.
The Righteous Qi of the Celestial Realm radiates centered around the skeleton of Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan.
It shows that even though Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan is deceased.
He hasn’t abandoned his mission to save all living beings, still silently protecting the world from behind the scenes.
"He is a great man."
Ding Ling admired.
He now was more and more certain that it was indeed a remnant soul of Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan that appeared before.
If not.
Why would he pass the technique directly, then disappear without much communication with Ding Ling?
Yet the remnant soul of Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan could know of Ding Ling’s affairs.
It seems the Celestial Realm must be connected with various realms?
Or perhaps Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan’s creation powers were so profound that even a remnant soul could perceive the general situation of different realms.
Or probably because he had connections with the Great Sun Buddha and the Female Drought Demon?
The truth is unknown.
But Ding Ling has received the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture and is preparing to leave.
"The Xuanyuan Heart Scripture is too powerful. It’s definitely a technique beyond the Shattering Level. It is impossible for the Wind and Cloud World to give birth to such a technique."
The highest level in the Wind and Cloud World might just be a stage above Shattering Great Perfection.
But this Xuanyuan Heart Scripture evidently surpasses a stage above Shattering Great Perfection, appearing to support Ding Ling’s cultivation for a long time, paving a smooth road for him!

"It seems, evidently, during the Ancient Era, the mixture of human, god, demon, and monster led to the collapse and downfall of the realms, causing the positional level of the Wind and Cloud World to plummet as well."
The Ancient Era of the Wind and Cloud World might have been a legendary era where Shattering was commonplace.
It’s just that with the outbreak of the Great War, the world was shattered many times, the world’s position fell, turning into the current Wind and Cloud World.
It was Ding Ling’s speculation.
The specific truth.
Needs to be verified.
Step by step!
Ding Ling retraced his steps.
Soon he arrived at the Divine Realm.
He wished to meet the Great Sun Buddha again, to ask for the cultivation skill of the Great Sun Buddha, if he could obtain the cultivation technique of the Great Sun Buddha.
