chapters.title: Chapter 720 - 709: Demon Realm
paragraphs: The future achievement can be imagined.
But Ding Ling thought of the unusual attitude of the Great Sun Buddha before he vanished, and immediately extinguished this thought.
The Great Sun Buddha was already beginning to lose control of himself.
If he came out and attacked, wouldn’t Ding Ling be done for?
It’s better not to take risks.
Thinking this way, Ding Ling sped up toward the location of the Celestial Ladder.
After some time.
He reached the location.
To Ding Ling’s surprise and shock, the Celestial Ladder was gone.
"One-time use?!"
Ding Ling was somewhat bewildered.
"Or was the Celestial Ladder destroyed by a Half-God?!"
Ding Ling was puzzled.
But since the Celestial Ladder was inaccessible, he could only choose to return to the Celestial Realm once again.
He had a premonition that the Celestial Realm should have a path leading to the Lower Realm.
For this reason, he even shouted toward the sky in the core territory of the Divine Realm:
"Buddha, is there a path from the Celestial Realm leading to the Lower Realm?"
Whoosh!
A golden thread came, pointing to the direction of the Celestial Realm, the meaning very clear.
Ding Ling knew in his heart, and immediately thanked the Buddha, then accelerated towards the Celestial Realm.
The Great Sun Buddha did not come out to see him, it seems he was also trying hard to suppress his own Demon Nature.
At this time, it’s better not to disturb him.
Ding Ling deeply understood how terrifying Demon Nature could be.
Qilin Blood is Mad Blood, also Demon Blood, severely weakened, yet Nie Feng and others couldn’t handle it and often fell into madness.
Chiyou, such an Ancient Great God, created the Demon Scripture, yet couldn’t avoid falling into the Demon Dao, which shows the terror of Demon Nature.
Although the Great Sun Buddha is strong, he is also a Buddha from the Ancient Era, essentially no different from Chiyou and other Ancient Great Gods.
And the Great Sun Buddha directly fought against demons and directly made contact with demonic forces!
His Demon Nature far surpassed Nie Feng and the like by countless times.
If a powerhouse like the Great Sun Buddha completely fell to demon, the world’s destruction wouldn’t be far off.
Ding Ling understood this deeply, naturally he wouldn’t tell the Great Sun Buddha about the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, lest it provoke him.
Whoosh!
Upon entering the Celestial Realm.

Ding Ling performed Shrinking Inches, activating Stargazing Skill, Geomancy Skill, and Array Skill occasionally to observe all directions. After a while, he found several connection spots in the Celestial Realm.
But except for the opening towards the Demon Realm, all other openings were completely sealed.
’There is a path to the Human Realm, but this path is likely broken.’
Ding Ling glanced at the ladder to the Human Realm, drifting uncertainly, seeming illusory and nonexistent.
Furthermore, around this ladder, the sealing power stretched endlessly.
It’s evident that to protect the Human Realm, the Celestial Realm had already cut off its retreat route, staying behind to fend off the Abyss of the Demon Realm alone.
"Could it be that I have to enter the Demon Realm?"
Ding Ling was uncertain and hesitant.
After thinking about it, he decided to give it a try.
All other Celestial Ladders were broken.
Moreover, they were all sealed.
With his current power, he couldn’t break the seal.
Even if he could, he wouldn’t do it.
Only because the sealing power had the effect of drawing Righteous Qi from a world.

Ding Ling could even sense the Righteous Qi of Sword Realm from a sealed mouth of a Celestial Ladder, flowing continuously to the Main Hall of the Celestial Realm, to cooperate with the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan’s bones in suppressing and dispelling Demon Qi.
"Heaven and Earth nourish Righteous Qi!"
"So the root of everything lies here!"
Ding Ling thought of the Dragon Vein in Lingyun Cave!
The Dragon Vein was also full of Righteous Qi; it was there to suppress Chiyou, a god who had fallen into demon.
And the Celestial Realm drew Righteous Qi from Sword Realm, Human Realm and other realms, using Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan’s relics as the core, suppressing the opening of the Demon Realm all around!
"No wonder I feel the Celestial Realm’s Righteous Qi is vast and magnificent. It’s because Righteous Qi from several worlds is converging here."
Ding Ling realized.
"But I’m afraid it’s hard to eradicate the demon."
Because there are countless people with Evil Thought and Demonic Thought, these people also provide ample nourishment for the Demon Realm.
Therefore.
Even if the Celestial Realm uses the power of Righteous Qi from several worlds, it can only barely suppress the opening of the Demon Realm.
Ding Ling walked to the opening of the Demon Realm.
There was also a Celestial Ladder here.
The ladder was pitch black, as if brushed with black paint, appearing sticky and sinister.
Ding Ling stepped onto it.
"I have no choice but to take the path of the Demon Realm."
"If I really can’t win, I’ll just cross into other worlds."
Thinking like this, Ding Ling couldn’t help but speed up.
All the way down.
He walked through various dimensions.
This time Ding Ling did not see the river of time and space.
It was obvious that the river of time and space was directly below the Divine Realm, not directly above the Demon Realm.
"What is that?"
Although he did not see the river of time and space.
Ding Ling saw different mystical landscapes in his rapid flight.
He saw the Sword Realm.
It floated to the right of the Demon Realm, extremely vast, between the material and spiritual, seeming illusory yet real;
Below this Sword Realm, there was a world akin to hell.
It was vibrant with colors yet contained an extreme darkness within, making one’s heart tremble upon seeing it.
Ding Ling merely glanced at it, and looked away.
He discovered that the Wind and Cloud world contained many worlds, large and small.
Some he had never seen, nor heard of.
"It seems all formed from fragments of worlds shattered by the battles among Ancient Gods, otherwise how could there be so many Otherworldly Spaces."
Otherworldly Space is like a Little World.
And there are many such Little Worlds in the Wind and Cloud World.
At this moment, Ding Ling stood at a higher dimension, overlooking below, clearly seeing various truths, naturally learning many secrets.
"Is this the perspective of God?"
Ding Ling glanced at the position of Jiuzhou, then continued towards the direction of the Abyss.
He did want to go directly to other worlds.
But beside the path of the Celestial Ladder, there was endless nothingness, Ding Ling tried, throwing a weapon to each side, they quickly decayed to dust.
It’s evident that the void world above the Demon Realm cannot be reached.
As for why the Half-God could tread the void world below the Divine Realm, it’s probably related to him borrowing the power of time back then?
The specific facts are difficult to ascertain.
After some time.
Ding Ling stepped to the bottom of the Celestial Ladder, thud!
A soft sound.
Ding Ling landed on the ground.
Before stabilizing.
Whoosh whoosh whoosh!
Magic Qi surged towards him from all directions, seemingly about to completely flood and assimilate him.
Ding Ling instinctively operated the Demon Scripture.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
"It’s indeed useful."
Ding Ling felt joy in his heart.
The Demon Scripture is indeed a Legendary Level Cultivation Technique against the Demon Dao and Demon Qi.
If it weren’t for Chiyou being not fully perfect in Demon Scripture before falling into demon, Demon Qi might not have been able to do anything to Chiyou.
Only a truly Great Perfection Demon Scripture can be fearless against Demon Qi’s erosion and even refine Demon Qi for one’s own use.
And even a Perfection Level Demon Scripture cannot achieve this.
Chiyou fell into demon, which proves something, it goes without saying.

chapters.title: Chapter 721 - 710: Celestial Soldier and Demon
paragraphs: Roar!
From the depths of darkness, angry howls and fierce roars echo intermittently.
Ding Ling gathers energy in his eyes, employing a ’Bright Eyes Skill’ offered by his subordinates earlier, enabling him to see clearly up to a hundred meters even in the dark night.
Upon looking, he sees countless demons nearby glaring at him with fierce intentions.
The demons are clad in armor, humanoid in stature, wielding spears or swords.
Upon seeing Ding Ling, they begin probing attacks.
Ding Ling activates the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, performs the Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse, and the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell.
In the next moment.
A Buddha Lotus appears beneath Ding Ling’s feet, adorned with dazzling treasure pearls, making Ding Ling look as if a Buddha descended to earth.

With each step he takes, lotus flowers bloom, causing the demon qi to retreat, and as he recites the ’Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell,’ waves of Buddha light ripple outward like surging water waves.
Wherever he passes.
Demon qi vanishes!
The demons retreat as if snow encountering warm sun, screaming in fear, those unable to retreat are directly transformed by the Buddha light, lamenting as they collapse to the ground.
"It works indeed."
Ding Ling breathes a sigh of relief.
Though the Demon Scripture can refine demon qi, it is hard to refine such a large amount of demon qi quickly.

After all, the Demon Scripture has a limit, preventing Ding Ling from falling into demon path, but if too much demon qi floods in and isn’t refined quickly, there is still a risk of Ding Ling succumbing to demonization.
Just like a person’s limited food capacity, force feeding beyond capability might be fatal.
Ding Ling realized relying on his own power alone, trying to refine massive and surging demon qi using a middle-tier Shattering level Demon Scripture, might be inadequate.
Now the beyond Shattering level magic and skills display unrivaled power, making Ding Ling delighted.
It’s because the demon qi purified by the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell becomes purer, transforming into Supreme Yin Qi, quickly absorbed and refined by the Demon Scripture.
Ding Ling proceeds forward.
Continuously activating Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse to purify demons and demon qi;
While activating the Demon Scripture to absorb and refine the purified Supreme Yin Demonic Qi! This kind of demon qi is pure without sinister or ghostly forces, usable by Ding Ling.
Walking along.
Demons roar in anger and retreat.
Seemingly uncomfortable, panicked, and furious with Ding Ling’s arrival!
Ding Ling observes these demons.
Their armor and weaponry mostly have decayed, yet faintly visible are some inscriptions on the armor:
’Celestial Soldier 1103’
’Celestial Soldier 2039’
"All are Celestial Soldiers."
Ding Ling is moved, sweeping his gaze over countless demons, all similar armored humanoid fierce demons!
"It seems after an ancient battle, although the righteous side barely won, they almost collectively perished."
Ding Ling hasn’t had the chance to inquire the Yellow Emperor or the Great Sun Buddha about ancient matters.
He decides to ask Female Drought Demon once he leaves this Demon Realm.
Female Drought Demon must be well-aware of these events.
Nonetheless, he understands.
Even her undying and immortal fire zombies are nearly extinct. As the Zombie Ancestor of this world, Female Drought Demon herself is on the verge of death!
This signifies the ancient battle likely resulted in total annihilation.
And the corpses of those who perished, are scattered across realms.
Some vanished, decayed, or like Yinglong, turned into skeletons guarding places like Lingyun Cave;
And those who fell into the Demon Realm from the righteous side were certainly assimilated by demon qi!
Their bodies and corpses likely mutated, transforming into the demons before him.
"All heroes. Such a pity."
Ding Ling shows no mercy.
These are all demons.
The former Celestial Soldiers and Generals are gone; now they are demons. If released to the world, Jiuzhou would certainly be utterly doomed.
Simply because any random Celestial Soldier demon here is a Grandmaster-level expert!
Celestial General demons are Shattering-level! At a glance, all are masters!
Numerous, endless!
An ordinary person entering here.
Might directly be scared to death!
"Looks like True Qi needs to be used sparingly."
Ding Ling dispels protective spells like Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse, directly activating the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, quickly advancing, one hand forming spell seals, purifying demons.
The other hand swiftly attaches, starting a frenzied absorption of demon qi from the demons.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
The demon qi on a Grandmaster-level demon roughly amounts to 50 points.
Regarding purifying such demons.
Ding Ling’s Xuanyuan Heart Scripture combined with Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell is almost overwhelming.
Therefore.
Ding Ling’s Demon Scripture can smoothly absorb and refine all the demon qi from demons in one breath, swiftly purifying it and making it his own.
"Directly absorbing, then purifying the sinister demonic power within using the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell. This way, it’s more convenient for my refinement."
Ding Ling’s eyes slightly brighten.
Feeling this method’s speed might be faster.
Even though the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell can purify and subsequently, the Demon Scripture can absorb and refine, the speed isn’t very fast.
Yet directly absorbing a demon, then purifying it with the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, in an instant, turns the sinister, manic, bloodthirsty demon qi into Supreme Yin Demonic Qi.
Supreme Yin Demonic Qi maintains some characteristics of demon qi but is more harmonious, lacking bloodthirsty and violent traits.
"Very good."
Ding Ling immediately steps with Free-Will Ascension Step, forming seal techniques with his left hand, right hand occasionally approaching each demon.

Although these demons have the support of Demon Realm, moving extremely fast, under Ding Ling’s forty-fold amplified Free-Will Ascension Step, he moves swiftly as if flowing light, Shrunken Inches enables him to close in on a demon instantly, then applying the hand seal, Demon Scripture works to instantly absorb all demon qi from the opponent.
Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell immediately collaborates to purify.
The sinister demon qi absorbed within immediately eliminated of bloodthirsty and violent negative attributes, becoming pure and peaceful.
Such demon qi can almost instantly be refined by Ding Ling for personal use.
[Inner Power Value +60]
The recently absorbed was a Grandmaster Peak-level Celestial Soldier demon.
Contributed higher demon qi.
Ding Ling thus traverses among the demons.
[Inner Power Value +51]
[Inner Power Value +53]
[Inner Power Value +60]
Not long after.
[True Power Value: 91 points]
Ding Ling’s body slightly vibrates, a majestic aura sweeps in all directions, toppling countless demons.
Ding Ling breaks through again.
Reaching the Realm of Shattered Perfection!
At this stage.
With forty-fold amplified Free-Will Ascension Step, Ding Ling’s speed becomes so fast that ordinary demons can barely see him with the naked eye.
Reaching this point.
Ding Ling overwhelms Celestial Soldier demons even more!
But perhaps due to another breakthrough.
This time the Celestial Soldiers’ contribution of Inner Power Value decreased significantly, generally only about 25 points.

chapters.title: Chapter 722 - 711: Great Advancement in Strength
paragraphs: It dropped by half.
Ding Ling did not worry much, with so many demons around, even if halved, it was enough for him to easily level up to the Realm of Shattered Great Perfection!
He slaughtered demons all the way.
[Inner Power Value +25]
[Inner Power Value +26]
From time to time, a Shattering Level Celestial General Demon would rush at him, only to be suppressed by Ding Ling with a palm, draining its demon qi!
Now Ding Ling had reached Shattered Perfection.
Under forty times amplification.
Each punch and kick held immense power, suppressing Initial Tier Shattering demons was as easy as crushing eggs with Mount Tai.
Not to mention, his current moves were all at Full Level!

His Black Tortoise True Skill coupled with No Desire Technique! Each punch and kick seemed as if heaven and earth were showing power! At times, the Mountain and Sea Fist Scripture was fiercely unleashed, each punch seemed to overturn the world, and at times the Black Tortoise Divine Palm struck directly at the Yellow Dragon! Each palm seemed to shatter heaven and earth!
Few Celestial Soldier and Demon, Celestial General Demon, hit by his punches and palms, were not crushed and suppressed.
Once a demon was suppressed.
Ding Ling would take the opportunity to approach, Demon Scripture came to breathe in demon qi, Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell was activated to purify demon qi.
In the next instant.
The demon qi was perfectly refined for his use by Ding Ling.
Thus he acted.
In Ding Ling’s dantian, visible droplets of Demon Path True Water appeared rapidly.
But in just half a day.
[True Power Value: 99 points.]
The speed of progress was unparalleled.
Far faster than consuming Great Medicine.
It’s important to know that at Ding Ling’s current realm, ordinary Great Medicine was ineffective for him.
Only those of the millennium grade could have any effect.
Or several hundred years Great Medicine must be combined with other medicines, refined into pills to enhance.
And now these demons, Celestial Soldiers could increase by about 25, Celestial Generals by about 190.
Thus, Ding Ling progressed so swiftly.

Were it not for the violent, fierce, bloodthirsty impurities in the Celestial General’s demon qi, greatly purified away by the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, Celestial Generals would not only provide 190 points.
But even so.
Ding Ling was quite satisfied.
Just because there were so many Celestial Soldiers and Demons, Celestial Generals.
Enough to allow him to easily progress to the Realm of Shattered Great Perfection!
Once again he lightly released a palm, suppressing a Celestial General Demon, then took the opportunity to operate Demon Scripture, absorbing flowing magic power into his body.
Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell was instantly activated, purging impurities like fierceness and bloodthirst from the demon qi, Ding Ling once again perfectly refined this demon.
[Inner Power Value +200]
This was a demon much stronger than typical Celestial General Demon.
But still crushed by Ding Ling’s forty times amplification.
Ding Ling approached once more, resolving six Celestial Soldier demons.
[Inner Power Value +25]
[Inner Power Value +25]
As another drop of Demon Path True Water appeared in his dantian.
[True Power Value: 100]
Thus he acted again.
[True Power Value: 101]
Another powerful wave surged from Ding Ling.
He broke through once more.
This time he reached the Realm of Shattered Great Perfection!

Each move held infinite power, as if easily shattering void, with forty times amplification of himself, Ding Ling discovered the tenfold amplification power of Ten Directions Invincible in Black Tortoise True Skill was rapidly weakening, reducing to the common threefold.
The amplification power of Divine Form also weakened to sevenfold.
Only Breathing Technique, Infinite Crossing’s tenfold amplification remained unchanged.

"It seems Black Tortoise True Skill also has a limit. Upon reaching Shattering Great Perfection, the amplification of Black Tortoise True Skill dropped by more than half, if it gets stronger, the amplification would continue to decline. After all, Black Tortoise True Skill is still a Shattering Level technique. It can’t continue to amplify when I’ve become immortal."
This is logical.
A Shattering Level technique.
Being able to amplify at Shattering Great Perfection is already very impressive.
And the logic applies to Divine Form Power.
Ding Ling sensed deeply and realized:

"Only by constantly strengthening Divine Form Power can it maintain the tenfold amplification status, if I continuously grow stronger, but Divine Form doesn’t rapidly strengthen with it, its amplification power will weaken."
Divine Form needs to devour Spiritual Mechanism, Primordial Qi, which is manageable.
But it needs to devour Divinity even more!
Otherwise, it’s hard to bring about substantial enhancement.
"It seems I must acquire some Divinity."
Ding Ling contemplated.
Fortunately, he was very pleased that Breathing Technique, Infinite Crossing did not weaken by half.
"Breathing Technique truly deserves to be a Fundamental Technique. Infinite Crossing is the power of heaven and earth wind and cloud, understanding why these two don’t weaken."
Ding Ling now calculated his amplification also as thirtyfold.
As for the fiftyfold amplification of Emperor’s Sword, it had also decreased significantly.
Clearly.
Emperor’s Sword also has a limit.
Its limit might just be the limit value of this world.
Thus 50 times amplification immediately dropped to about 40 times.
Even so.
It was still very strong.
Ding Ling continued slaughtering demons.
He found his skills could continue to rise!
"It seems the maximum power value of Wind and Cloud World might be higher than I imagined."
Ding Ling thought of Half-God.
Half-God is also part of the Wind and Cloud World’s plane.

While the Great Sun Buddha and Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan belong to strong individuals of another dimension, similar to the Broken Immortal Realm above Valley of Eternal Spring, not counting as within the plane world.
"In that case, this Demon Realm is truly my place of fortune!"
Ding Ling casually used Dragon Capturing Skill, capturing the Celestial Soldier Demon nearby, then placed a palm on it, Demon Scripture!
Whoosh!
Flowing demon qi entered the body, swiftly purified by Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell!
An instant.
[Inner Power Value +10]
After reaching Shattered Great Perfection.
Ding Ling’s Shattering True Qi Quality improved, naturally conversion efficiency reduced!
Now Celestial Soldier demons could only increase by 10 points.

Ding Ling moved towards Celestial General demons, under thirtyfold amplification, casually using Dragon Capturing Skill could easily capture them over, then placed a palm, Demon Scripture absorbed, Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell purified.
[Inner Power Value +92]
Predictably.
Celestial General demons also decreased significantly.
But relative to Celestial Soldier demons, they were much stronger.
Ding Ling pursued capturing, absorbing, refining Celestial General demons.
In just a moment.
More Demon Path True Water appeared in the dantian.
[True Power Value: 102 points.]
Indeed evolved.
"Originally thought Shattering was the limit of this world, later thought Shattering Great Perfection surely was. Now it seems I underestimated the limit value of this world."

Ding Ling’s hands did not slow, feet using Free-Will Ascension Step, under thirtyfold amplification, seeming like he transformed into a bolt of thunder, constantly weaving through various demon troops, one hand continuously striking, one by one Celestial Generals were selected, absorbed, refined by him.
His power began to surge frantically once again.
Despite the demons reaching peak of fierceness and violence, they still seemed to retain instincts, clearly powerless against Ding Ling.

chapters.title: Chapter 723 - 712: Wind God of the Divine Race
paragraphs: But Ding Ling could hunt them down with impunity.
These Celestial Soldiers and Generals demons also instinctively screamed, and then one by one turned to flee frantically.
They had been as frenzied in attacking Ding Ling before.
Now their retreat is just as swift.
Ding Ling chased after them.
From time to time, he captured one demon of the Celestial General, absorbing, refining, purifying, and enhancing!
Ding Ling was constantly getting stronger!
This feeling was extremely exhilarating!
However, just as he was indulging in capturing and refining, a sudden storm arose, and a hand emerged from the wind, slapping heavily towards Ding Ling’s face.
Boom! The airwave from the slap, the storm roared!
Raging winds converged into terrifying shockwaves, pressing down on Ding Ling.
Ding Ling, having reached the Realm of Shattered Great Perfection, and blending with the Heavenly Dao Natural Realm of the No Desire Technique, possessed an astonishing perception!
In an instant, he sensed a mysterious and powerful force sweeping towards him, so he was extremely vigilant. Sure enough, it took less than two breaths before the opponent made a move.
Ding Ling took the opportunity to retreat while launching a punch!
Mountain and Sea Fist Scripture!
Coiling Dragon Embracing the Moon!
With this punch, you could faintly hear the sound of a dragon’s roar, and also see a vague shadow of the moon, as the rolling fist wind surged forward, rumbling!
The fist force and storm crashed heavily together, and within a moment, the fist force swept through the storm like autumn leaves, shattering the storm, and hit a dark area with a loud bang.
A person was struck out by the fist force.

Ding Ling looked closely and saw that this person was peculiar in appearance, with a body like a deer, yet covered with leopard-like patterns, a head resembling a peacock’s, adorned with protruding strange horns, and a snake-like tail behind.
Such an abnormal person.
Even Ding Ling saw him for the first time, his mind churned with various knowledge, and soon he suspiciously shouted:
"Are you the Wind God!"
The mythical divine monster Wind God, looked just like this.
However, Ding Ling estimated this might be the Wind God’s Divine Form!
His real form should be humanoid.
Perhaps due to deeply embracing the demon nature, he maintained this Divine Form, never returning to normal.
"Wind God..."

The strange person spun in the void, unloading the fist force, and like an arrow released from a bowstring, shot towards Ding Ling’s direction, while his hands were no longer human hands, now forming seals, and once formed, the void was filled with raging Xun Wind carrying sky-covering Demon Qi, rushing towards Ding Ling:
"I am the Wind God! Such a familiar, yet strange name!"
The strange person seemed to have intelligence, his eyes occasionally flashed with clarity, but soon occupied by bloodthirsty, fanatical, demonic nature, he cackled monstrously twice:
"Since you know I am the Wind God, you should know my strength. Young one, your ignorance leads you into the Demon Realm, I, the Wind God, will ensure you never return.
"Wind God, you are of the Divine Race, you cannot betray the Divine Race, you cannot betray this world!"
Ding Ling shouted clearly.
After reading several sets of scriptures and countless ancient books,
Ding Ling thoroughly understood this world.
Naturally, he also learned the origins of Wind God and others.
In other worlds, Ding Ling didn’t know which side Wind God belonged to.
But in this world, Wind God belonged to the Celestial Realm Divine Race!
He was brothers with Chiyou, hence standing by Chiyou to oppose the Yellow Emperor, which Ding Ling understood.
And Chiyou opposed the Yellow Emperor due to succumbing to demon nature, Ding Ling didn’t know if Wind God stood with Chiyou after or he was influenced by Chiyou to succumb?
No matter the case, Ding Ling rarely saw someone from the Divine Race and hoped he could regain reason and clarity.
"Divine Race, world, betrayal..."
Cold glow occasionally flashed in Wind God’s eyes:

"I, the Wind God, live for myself, what talk is there of the Divine Race, betrayal? I am now the lord of a palace in the Demon Race! Young one, you mercilessly slaughtered my Demon Race’s Demon Soldiers and Generals, you deserve death. Today, I am here to kill you! Prepare to die!"
He howled long.
Hands waved towards Ding Ling’s direction.
Rumble!
A sky-covering tornado storm carried waterfall-like Demon Qi, pressing down towards Ding Ling’s direction, seemingly to completely cover, obliterate him!
Ding Ling could not escape, only activating Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, forming a spell seal with his hand.
In the next moment.
Lotus grew beneath his feet.
He spat out World-Purifying Buddha Light.
The Buddha Light resembled water waves, centering on Ding Ling, radiating outwards circle by circle, where it passed, the Demon Qi continuously dissipated.
But the Demon Qi was too abundant.
Endless.
Falling continuously from high above.
Ding Ling’s Buddha Light seemed like a candle flame in the wind, always on the verge of extinction.
"I will have you become a member of my Demon Race, become a fierce general under my command!"
Wind God howled:
"Young one, do not refuse, accept your fate!"
He waved his hands repeatedly.
Tornado storms swept towards Ding Ling.
Within the storms, infinite Demon Qi gathered.
Ding Ling stood at the very center of the earth-upturning storms, letting them beat, cover, and suppress.
Though he seemed on the brink of being crushed to pieces, in reality, he remained unmoved like a mountain.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Xuanyuan Heart Scripture combined with Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse, Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, continuously purified this overwhelming Demon Qi.
Demon Scripture took the opportunity to absorb.
Due to external assistance from the sweeping Demon Qi this time, Ding Ling immersed in the ’vast ocean’ of Demon Qi, naturally saw a surge in refining efficiency.
Clearly.
Wind God, as the lord of a palace in the Demon Realm, had reached a pinnacle in controlling storms and magic power.
Causing Ding Ling to be constantly submerged by Demon Qi, storm.
Ding Ling was protected by Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse, so no amount of Demon Qi could erode him for the time being.
It would only be refined strand by strand by the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell.
And then quickly absorbed by the Demon Scripture, transforming into nourishment for his cultivation.
[True Power Value: 109]
Ding Ling felt that he seemed to be breaking through again.
What breakthrough awaits after this Realm of Shattering Great Perfection?!
Ding Ling was full of anticipation.
Continue accelerating the refining of Demon Qi.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Endlessly, Demon Qi poured into the Dantian, transforming into True Water.
[True Power Value: 111]
Soon.
The True Power Value broke into a new boundary once more.
Ding Ling’s body trembled slightly.
He sensed countless True Water seem to gather into a ’Core’.
And at this moment.
Through Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, Ding Ling knew clearly how far his cultivation had progressed.
"After Shattering, it’s the Martial Arts Golden Core Realm!"
And the Martial Arts Golden Core is divided into nine grades!
First Grade being the highest, having the greatest potential.
But to condense a First-Grade Golden Core, one must meet a minimum requirement value: the total True Water must not be less than 191 points!

chapters.title: Chapter 724 - 713: Stronger Again
paragraphs: If 111 points are used to condense a Martial Arts Golden Core,
it will be the weakest Ninth-Grade Golden Core.
Ding Ling’s cultivation technique is quite extraordinary, so if he condenses a core, it will most likely start as a Sixth or even Fifth-Grade Golden Core.
According to the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture’s description,
cultivating a superior cultivation method like the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, a core condensing from 111 points of True Water, would be around Sixth-Grade.
However, Ding Ling’s dantian and meridians have so many extraordinary creations that he estimates if he condenses a core now, it may be a above Fifth-Grade core.
But that is not his goal.
His goal is to become an invincible powerhouse, naturally aiming to condense the strongest core! If not, his potential would be limited, narrowing his future path!
Therefore.
Ding Ling immediately stopped the condensation of True Water into a core, continuing to absorb and refine demonic qi, enhancing himself.
However, his further breakthrough did not escape Wind God’s eyes, and he was shocked:
"How is this possible?! Just a greenhorn! How can he be this strong?! He can actually refine demonic qi for his own use, this kind of skill, ability..."
Wind God was tremendously moved.
Immediately, he was enraged to the point of irrationality.
Ding Ling actually used him to break through!

At this time, it seemed he understood that although Ding Ling appeared to be at risk of being swallowed by storms and demonic qi at any moment, his feet were firmly rooted in the ground, steady as can be.
Every action he took aided Ding Ling’s enhancement!
Upon this realization,

Wind God was so angry he almost coughed up blood, his anger burning his heart, and his demonic nature erupted completely. His eyes filled with blood as if he had lost his reason, letting out an angry roar, he charged madly towards Ding Ling’s direction.
Ding Ling saw this and was not surprised, instead, he was delighted:
"Good timing!"
With another breakthrough.
As expected,
the amplification ability of Black Tortoise True Skill was reduced to barely doubling his strength.
His Divine Form could only amplify by three times.
The Breathing Technique and Infinite Crossing still amplified by ten times.
Thus, Ding Ling’s personal strength was instantly amplified by twenty-four times.

Chanting the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, it exploded thunderously, instantly purifying all demonic qi within dozens of meters, allowing Ding Ling to absorb 300 wisps of demonic qi in a moment.
[Inner Power Value +300]
[True Power Value: 112 points]
In an instant, his cultivation increased by one point.
This speed was exceptionally terrifying.

But it couldn’t last long, because the explosive power of the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell consumed a correspondingly terrifying amount of True Qi, if repeated continuously, Ding Ling might exhaust his True Qi soon, falling into a dire state where he might become possessed.
Therefore.
He could only erupt occasionally.

But even so, the brief eruption severely injured the nearby Wind God, whose body of demonic qi was like encountering a nemesis, sizzling as it burned, and in an instant, lost an unknown amount of energy, with his strength drastically reduced, his bloodshot pupils seemed to regain clarity due to the intense pain, looking at Ding Ling in horror, then swiftly stepping on Xun Wind, and fled to the skies.
His strength greatly diminished, knowing that he was no longer a match for Ding Ling, why would he stay any longer?
"Where do you think you’re going?"
Ding Ling saw that Wind God was deeply possessed, beyond salvation.
So he decided to ’transcend’ him!

Wind God’s demonic cultivation was definitely beyond the apex of Shattering Great Perfection, with both feet possibly stepping into the Martial Arts Golden Core Realm, but had not yet formed a Demonic Golden Core.
If he did form a core, Wind God would be even more terrifying.
But with his cultivation at such a level, if he reached the human world, who could be his opponent?!

Thinking of this, Ding Ling used twenty-four times the Free-Will Ascension Step, his entire being turned into a stream of light, quickly catching up with the heavily injured Wind God, then slapped him with his palm.
Black Tortoise Divine Palm!
Break through Guan Mountain!
This palm was extremely heavy, as if it could shatter mountains, extremely fast, like a meteor shooting across the End of the World Path, with a crisp sound, heavily landing on Wind God’s body, bang!
As if hit by a massive hammer! Wind God screamed horribly, falling from the void down below.
Ding Ling, stepping on wind and waves, rapidly chased.
Landed a heavy kick.
Fierce Strong Leg Technique!
Furious Trampling of Mountains and Rivers!
Right in Wind God’s chest and abdomen, bending his whole body like a bow, his face ghastly pale, mouth wide open, spewing out strands of demonic qi and demon blood.
With Profound Yin Sword Armor flowing around Ding Ling, it perfectly blocked all that demon blood from his body, then he started kicking Wind God repeatedly, thud, thud, thud!
After over ten kicks, Wind God’s entire being was shattered apart!
Seizing the opportunity, Ding Ling grabbed his main body, activated the Demon Scripture, and with one hand chanted the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell.
Whoosh!
Rolling demonic qi entered his body.
[Inner Power Value +300]

Compared to other demons, Wind God, whose cultivation exceeded Shattering Great Perfection, was extremely powerful, even though much of his demonic qi was depleted, still providing Ding Ling with a substantial 300 points of Inner Power Value.
[True Power Value: 113 points]
His strength further increased.
The power of Ding Ling’s palm and leg techniques and other moves also rose accordingly.
After killing Wind God.
Ding Ling casually tossed Wind God’s body, then rushed again toward the Celestial Soldiers and Generals.
Whoosh!

Ding Ling, like a bolt of lightning flashing across the void, quickly spotted the endless silhouettes of Celestial Soldier and Demon, which stretched as far as the eye could see, he dashed forward, caught a Celestial Soldier Demon in mid-air, and with a mere inhale, the Celestial Soldier didn’t even have time to scream before it was sucked dry. Then, Ding Ling casually released a burst of vigorous qi with his palm, easily causing the body to shatter and die!
Celestial Soldier Demons without demonic qi on them were extremely fragile, dying with a single hit.
[Inner Power Value +5]
Indeed.
After another breakthrough, the amount of absorbed demonic qi decreased again.
But the quality of Shattering True Qi had been further elevated, thus naturally reducing the conversion efficiency considerably.
Grabbed a Celestial General Demon in mid-air.
Sucked him dry in an instant.
[Inner Power Value +45]
Even the Celestial Generals decreased.
This was all within Ding Ling’s expectations.

He was not surprised, just quickly using the Dragon Capturing Skill, catching each demon mid-air, operating the Demon Scripture to absorb them dry, and the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell to purify them! Then, the Demon Scripture rapidly refined this pure demonic qi!
The speed was getting faster and faster.
Gradually, the demons began to look at Ding Ling like he was a Great Demon King!
Seeing Ding Ling rushing toward them, all let out an ’ow’ and scattered like animals or birds!
But where could they escape to faster than Ding Ling.
They were still easily captured, caught, and drained by Ding Ling.
[Inner Power Value +5]
[Inner Power Value +6]
[Inner Power Value +46]
Ding Ling’s True Water quantity kept increasing.
Drop after drop of Demon Path True Water kept appearing in his dantian.
Causing Ding Ling’s aura to continuously surge.
In just a moment of effort.
[True Power Value: 121 points.]
Ding Ling broke through again!
A powerful aura spread outward from him as the center, where it passed, more and more demons were easily knocked to the ground, screaming in terror.
This vast demon army was countless, yet pursued and killed by a single Ding Ling!
Apart from being discordant in their demonic hearts, it also had to do with how completely Ding Ling restrained them.

chapters.title: Chapter 725 - 714: Dominating Across Realms
paragraphs: The vast Buddha light emanating from Ding Ling’s body, the World Purification Spell chanted from his mouth, and the Demon Scripture that could refine their demonic qi, instinctively gave the demons an extreme sense of fear.
Being drained of demonic qi.
Then one would no longer be a demon, the body would decay and perish completely.
This was hard to accept for the demons living in the Demon Realm.
Though they only had some instincts.
But the instinct to save their lives, the instinct to flee from invincible powerful beings, was almost engraved into their bones.
So after failing to defeat Ding Ling, they fled in all directions, which was only natural.
Swoosh swoosh!
Ding Ling continued to pursue.
These demons were simply great medicine.
Too rare.
Missing this opportunity, and wanting to condense a First-Grade Golden Core?
Ding Ling reckoned it would be very difficult.

Because the resources of the Mortal Realm are limited, even though he is the emperor and can summon resources from all over the Jiuzhou World with a command, at his level, ordinary resources are already useless to him.
And high-level resources are limited, even if they were all for him to use, it may not guarantee the condensation of a First-Grade Golden Core.
Just because as cultivation progressed.
Even the Inner Power Value points provided by Grandmaster Level demons were decreasing.
You can grasp the essence by observing the parts, it’s imaginable that Great Medicine, which has developed resistance, would provide fewer points.
At that time.
Ding Ling aspired to reach the pinnacle of First Grade, but feared he could only lament helplessly.
Thus.
Ding Ling’s heart at this moment was joyful because this world was so rare.
"Originally thought coming to the Demon Realm would be a disaster. Never considered it would be a fortuitous encounter."
"Very well. Go all out. Condense True Water to over 191 drops!"
He currently had 121 points.
If he condenses the core.
There’s a high probability it would be Fifth Grade or Fourth Grade.
For others, it would probably be Eighth Grade.
points, for others, is Seventh Grade. And so on.

"I might not need 191 drops of True Water to condense a First-Grade Golden Core. After all, my transformational opportunity is much greater than ordinary people. But the minimum requirement is 191 drops; to ensure the Golden Core’s transformation is more natural, smooth, and perfect, I’ll still condense more True Water to the limit!"
Ding Ling thought as such.
Then he attacked the Celestial Soldiers and Generals Demon Creatures again.
Grabbing a Celestial Soldier demon in mid-air and inhaling.
[Inner Power Value +2 points]
Indeed, it dropped again.
As he continually strengthened, with the quality of True Qi continually rising, the transformation efficiency naturally decreased.
Grabbing a Celestial General demon, absorbing and refining.
[Inner Power Value +23 points.]
Likewise weakened.
But it’s still better than nothing.
Ding Ling continued the pursuit.

chapters.title: Chapter 726 - 715: Nine Heavens Profound Lady
paragraphs: It can be seen that the amplification of the Infinite Crossing is also related to the Power of Wind and Cloud between heaven and earth. In this Demon Realm, the Power of Wind and Cloud is limited and can’t infinitely support Ding Ling in casting the Infinite Crossing.
Therefore, it is normal for the amplification to weaken.
And as the Fundamental Technique, the Breathing Technique, the cornerstone of Martial Dao, always amplifies tenfold, showcasing its immense potential.
Ding Ling took a deep breath, amplifying himself by more than tenfold, moving like lightning through the groups of demon creatures.
His strength increased twentyfold.
With another tenfold amplification, the power of the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell was unimaginable. Wherever Ding Ling passed, it was as if a sun had fallen upon the glacial realm.
In an instant, demon creatures were swiftly dissolved away.
"So strong."
Ding Ling marveled:
"No wonder, it is indeed a technique meticulously researched by the Great Sun Buddha to deal with demon creatures!"
If his original strength was 10, multiplying that by forty would make it 400.
His current strength is 200, and with a tenfold amplification, it has now exceeded 3000.
Originally, killing Celestial Soldiers and Demons was like slaughtering chickens.
Now even more so, where he passed, it was as if a deity was crossing! All demonic creatures disintegrated and perished under his Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell!
Ding Ling was now god-like!
So powerful that with just a breath, he could extinguish a Celestial Soldier and Demon!
Whoosh!
After a period of time, the number of demons Ding Ling killed had already reached a million!

He was now too powerful, casting the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, with a tenfold amplification, akin to the sky collapsing, the Celestial Soldiers and Demons had no place to hide and could only die amidst wails and screams.
But after killing so many demons.
Ding Ling found that the number of demon creatures was decreasing.
Looking around.
The Demon Realm was desolate and deathly silent, only a few demon creatures were still running desperately on the ground, as if being chased by something terrifying.
"Seems like they’ve all hidden."
Without realizing it, Ding Ling found himself before a towering mountain reaching the clouds.
Within the mountain range, there were countless densely packed caves.
Inside the caves, various strange lights flickered unpredictably.
Ding Ling cast the Bright Eyes Skill, and in an instant, he saw through thousands of feet, seeing clearly what the strange lights inside the caves were.
They were also demon creatures.
Not only were there Celestial Soldiers and Generals, but even more so, there were fierce beasts and exotic creatures.
These fierce beasts were bizarrely shaped.
Many of them Ding Ling couldn’t even name.
He could only identify some more famous exotic creatures.
Such as: Lion-Tiger Beast, Blaze King Qilin Beast, Teng Snake, Vermilion Bird, Bi Fang, etc.
"Vermilion Bird, Bi Fang are all ancient Divine Beasts, I never thought they would also fall here and become demon beasts!
Ding Ling sighed.
The Divine Beasts’ divine power couldn’t withstand the erosion of Demon Qi.
Let alone mortals.
It’s a good thing he had methods of restraint, otherwise, entering the Demon Realm, he would’ve surely become a dead man.
"Since it’s a Demon Cave. That makes it easier to handle."

Ding Ling, with his left hand performing the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, and his right hand boiling with the Palm Power of the Black Tortoise Divine Palm, stepped into the cave with the Free-Will Ascension Step. In the next moment!
The cave resounded with screams, beast roars, and angry howls.
[Inner Power Value +10]
[Inner Power Value +20]
Quite a few fierce beasts and Divine Beasts had reached the Middle Tier of Shattering in strength.
Perfect for Ding Ling to slaughter at this moment.
He slaughtered all the way through.
In his Dantian, droplets of True Water began to form.
Soon enough.
He slaughtered through a cave, reached the depths, and saw the scene within the mountain’s belly, where more demon creatures gathered like clouds, endless and infinite.

"The number of demon creatures in the Demon Realm must be more than those in the Jiuzhou interface. To clear out these demon creatures, I must become stronger, otherwise, who knows how long it will take to kill them all."
Ding Ling hadn’t forgotten the promise he made to Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan.

Secondly, he was also the Jiuzhou Human Emperor, tasked with protecting Jiuzhou and shielding all living beings. If he wasn’t a Human Emperor, he wouldn’t bother, but being one, he naturally had to stand up and confront everything!
Thirdly, he had relatives and friends in other worlds, who could ascend to the Wind and Cloud World at any time.
He did not want this world to be eroded and polluted by demons!
Ding Ling leaped into the demon horde and began a great slaughter.
The quality of demons here was even higher!
Moreover, most were fierce beasts!
The Initial and Middle Tiers of Shattering fierce beasts accounted for more than ninety percent! Less than ten percent were High Tier.
But for every High Tier one he killed.
Ding Ling could gain about 95 Inner Power Value points.
Clearly, compared to Middle Tiers, the Demon Qi of High Tier fierce beasts was more surging, pure, domineering, and heavy! Thus, the conversion efficiency was naturally higher.
[Inner Power Value +97]
[Inner Power Value +20]
In just a short moment.
Ding Ling’s True Power Value had astonishingly reached 191 points.
Upon reaching this stage.
Ding Ling had a feeling.
He could form a First-Grade Golden Core at any moment and anywhere!
But he was not satisfied with this.
He wanted to see where the limit was.
Therefore, he chose to continue killing!

Right when the Demon Qi was rampant and Demon Blood was flying around, suddenly from an angle a sharp sword emerged, its blade hidden in the tumultuous Demon Qi, neither revealing itself nor displaying its might, only exploding suddenly when it reached Ding Ling’s back, boom!
The Sword Qi was dark and sticky like filth shooting out from the abyss!
Yet its speed was extremely fast, in an instant stabbing at Ding Ling’s back.
"Heh heh."
The assassin succeeded, and couldn’t help but laugh in excitement, but the next second, Ding Ling’s fist suddenly appeared beside her, boom!
Mountain and Sea Fist Scripture!
The fist tilted the world!

With a punch, it seemed as if the whole world was to be buried; the domineering Fist Force carried a rotating power, in a booming sound, directly hitting the assassin’s skull, shattering it, her scream echoed as she was sent flying hundreds of yards away, crashing uncontrollably into a mountain body.
"How is this possible?!"
The assassin’s entire body was embedded in the mountain, but she quickly broke free, her shattered skull visibly regenerating, her face showing fear as she looked at Ding Ling:
"How did you discover my Profound Lady Sword?!"
When the Profound Lady Sword is unleashed.
It is subtle and mysterious, aligning with the truths of the Heavenly Dao and nature, even one level higher could not detect it!
How did this little brat in front of her detect it?!
[Received a C-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate Nine Heavens Profound Lady.]

[Note: Nine Heavens Profound Lady has already demonized! And was sealed deep within the mountain’s belly. Your excessive slaughter caused Demon Blood to flood into the mountain body, allowing Nine Heavens Profound Lady to absorb endless Demon Blood, thus restoring more than ninety percent of her strength, enabling her to break the seal!
After emerging, the first thing she intended to do was to kill you!

Initially relying on her cultivation, which is one major realm higher than yours, she thought she could kill you easily, but almost got beaten to death by you instead! She was shocked and astonished!]
"Nine Heavens Profound Lady?!"
Ding Ling was also slightly surprised, then composed himself and said solemnly:
"Looks like yet another deeply demonized and beyond redemption member of the Divine Race!"
He could see clearly.
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady was extremely beautiful, in terms of appearance and figure, only a few like Little Dragon Girl could compare.
She was undoubtedly a peerless beauty in the world.
The most striking was her aura.

chapters.title: Chapter 727 - 716: Ancient Limu
paragraphs: The aura blending the qualities of a demon, an immortal, and a saint mixed around the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, made her look sacred, beautiful, yet enchanting!
It exuded a deadly allure.
Considering her charm.
In the entire world.
Across many realms.
None could surpass her allure!
Her charm was enough to make countless men fall for her at first sight and sink deeper with every encounter!
But what kind of person was Ding Ling?!
Having traversed many worlds, he had long become decisive in dealing with enemies, with a heart of stone.

Moreover, within him resided Vast Righteous Qi and Buddha Qi as safeguards, while in his Dantian, full-level power from the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture and other divine skills continuously operated, with the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell and other full-level techniques ceaselessly emanating gentle light.
This kept his heart from getting lost, rendering the allure of the Nine Heavens Profound Lady ineffective on him.
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady was even more astonished:
"It actually doesn’t work?!"
She could hardly believe it.

She clearly remembered during the ancient war among the gods, when she unleashed her Charm Power, countless Celestial Soldiers and Generals were captivated by it and turned to embrace the Demon Realm!
Unexpectedly, the young man before her could withstand it, and so.
"Boom!"
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady launched another attack on Ding Ling.
With a step in the void, she shot toward Ding Ling like an arrow off the string.
"Profound Lady Sword!"

In a flick of her wrist, the sword in her hand created myriad sword flowers, flashing in the void to form a Profound Lady Flying Immortal Painting! The sacred and magical energies interwove in the pattern, expanding to mountain size as it descended to engulf Ding Ling entirely.
Yet before it approached.
Ding Ling felt the dense Sword Qi shooting out from the Profound Lady Flying Immortal Painting.
He dared not take any chances, swiftly drawing the Human Emperor Saber.
He activated the No-Two Blade Technique with Xuanyuan Heart Scripture and No Desire Technique!
He slashed forward with a single blade.
Mountain City Torrential Rain!

This seemed like one slash, but in an instant, he cut out a dozen blades, each measuring a thousand feet, condensed to the utmost, resembling thousand-foot divine sabers cleaving down from the void, boom!
Boom boom boom!
The Profound Lady Flying Immortal Painting and the blade light collided in an instant, clashing for dozens of rounds in a flash.
As Ding Ling amplified the No-Two Blade Technique by several times!
Boom!

The thousand-foot divine saber grew increasingly realistic, majestic, and immeasurable, slicing down to directly chop through the Profound Lady Flying Immortal Painting, then with unstoppable momentum, slashed down in front of the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, whose face changed slightly, pulling up her sword to block!
Yet, she couldn’t stop it.
In an instant, Bang!
Blade and sword clashed.
An immense force surged to her wrist like a tidal wave, making her cry out in pain, her hand loosening as the divine sword in her grip clattered to the ground.
Ding Ling seized the chance to speed up his slashing!
Proud Cold Six Formulas!
Chilling Glance!
This slash was the quickest, yet soft, ethereal, tricky, and sharp to the extreme!
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
The Chilling Glance Ding Ling slashed out was both fast and ruthless, striking to the underarm of the Nine Heavens Profound Lady from an unimaginable angle in an instant!
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady retreated in shock!
But in the next moment!
With a crisp sound! Pop!
Her other left arm was completely chopped off.
It turned out Ding Ling wielded his blade in wrath, each slash faster than the last! Within a very short time, he had struck out dozens of concealed, subtle Chilling Glances!
This sword skill had been brought to perfection by Ding Ling!
Once successful.
Ding Ling pursued his advantage relentlessly!
Whoosh!
Accelerating forward, he swiftly snatched up the divine sword from the ground mid-air and tucked it into his storage pouch.
This sword was extraordinarily remarkable!
Absolutely a top divine sword from ancient times, as evidenced by its resistance to decay or assimilation in the magic-laden Demon Realm!
"Return my Profound Lady Sword!"
The Nine Heavens Profound Lady was furious.
Her eyes began turning red, showing signs of going berserk.
Clearly, this sword held unparalleled importance to her.
Ding Ling paid no heed, swinging yet another slash backward!
No-Two Blade Technique!
Clouds Breaking Through the Blue Sky!

Boom! A thousand-foot-long concentrated blade light, seemingly capable of slicing through the firmament and penetrating the earth, emerged, crackling the void, driving the Nine Heavens Profound Lady’s heart into a panic. Giving Ding Ling a rather bitter glare, she suddenly grabbed her severed arm and fled into a nearby cavern.
Boom!
The blade light skimmed past the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, carving a thousand-foot-long deep tunnel through the mountain! The blocking demon beasts were overturned and killed, their numbers untold.
"Hold on!"
Ding Ling shouted, his voice long and sonorous, stepping on the Free-Will Ascension Step, Shrinking Inches quickly chasing after!
With a blade in hand, he slashed horizontally and vertically, unstoppable.
The demon beasts blocking the path were easily pierced through!
However, these demon beasts could heal over time as long as Magic Power existed, reviving and returning eventually!
Thus, to kill them.
One must exhaust their magic power or thoroughly purify it.

But Ding Ling was racing against time, only focused on killing the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, having no time to purify or exhaust the magic power of these demon beasts, carving a bloody path with sheer force of his blade.
Boom!
Ding Ling tracked and traced forward.
Twisting and turning, having no idea how deep he had delved into the mountain.
He estimated he might have ventured over three thousand feet below the mountain’s surface by now.
Just leaping into a cavern.
A long spear thrust toward him, Ding Ling, ever wary, quickly retaliated with a backward blade slash, boom!
Both weapons cringed at the collision.
Ding Ling was startled, fixing his gaze.
Ahead, unknown when it appeared, stood a disgruntled nine-foot-tall robust man armed with a bow and holding a long spear!
He too seemed taken aback and side-eyed Ding Ling, saying:
"Who are you! Dare to intrude alone into the Demon Emperor Palace! You have great nerve!"
"Demon Emperor Palace?!"
Ding Ling’s sharp eyes peered behind the robust man, confirming there lay not far a vast, black-golden palace!
This palace emitted brilliantly lustrous light, appearing naturally embedded within the earth and caverns, resembling a naturally crafted magical treasure!
And this cavern, rather than a mere cavern, seemed a miniature Grotto Heaven World, at a glance Ding Ling knew the cavern’s vastness surpassed the territory of some small cities!
Around the cavern on all sides.
Besides the man standing before him.
There were four or five other figures with magic power soaring to the heavens, clearly remarkable in their own right.
"And who are you?"
Ding Ling couldn’t help but ask.
Know your enemy and yourself, find victory in every battle.
Ding Ling wanted to assess the situation before striking.
"I am the Guardian of the Demon Emperor, Limu!"
The robust nine-foot-tall man glanced at Ding Ling:
"In the ancient era, people called me Limu!"
Limu!
The same Limu invited personally by Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan to be a grand general?!
Ding Ling’s pupils contracted, not expecting that so many individuals of the Divine Race had fallen to the demon path!
"Since you’re consciously aware and know your identity, why aid the demons in their wickedness, harming the living beings!"

It exuded a deadly allure.
Considering her charm.
In the entire world.
Across many realms.
None could surpass her allure!
Her charm was enough to make countless men fall for her at first sight and sink deeper with every encounter!
But what kind of person was Ding Ling?!
Having traversed many worlds, he had long become decisive in dealing with enemies, with a heart of stone.

Moreover, within him resided Vast Righteous Qi and Buddha Qi as safeguards, while in his Dantian, full-level power from the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture and other divine skills continuously operated, with the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell and other full-level techniques ceaselessly emanating gentle light.

chapters.title: Chapter 728 - 717: First-Grade Golden Core
paragraphs: "Heh heh."
Limu first chuckled softly, then burst into loud laughter, causing the stone ceiling of the cave to tremble.
Suddenly, he stopped laughing and said solemnly:
"You don’t understand anything, you know nothing! Youngster, you look no older than twenty. Why come to the Demon Realm just to get yourself killed?"
He sighed and waved his hand.
Whiz whiz!
The five demon god-like figures behind him turned into black light and flew to Limu’s side, each glaring at Ding Ling with murderous intent.
Ding Ling frowned, thinking:

"Limu and the others are clear-minded, yet they willingly fell into becoming demons! Perhaps... their spirits have been twisted by demon nature, driving them insane and making them forget their true identities!"
With this in mind, Ding Ling casually asked two questions:
"Have you forgotten the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan? Forgotten that you were once gods?"
"Whether we’ve forgotten or not is none of your business."
Limu shook his long spear and thrust it towards Ding Ling:
"But you, as a member of the Human Race, dare to enter the Demon Realm alone! If you escape, it would make us Demon Realm guards look too incompetent! All of you, attack and kill him!"
As he finished speaking.
He was already calling for help.
Evidently, he found Ding Ling too difficult to handle alone.
Therefore, as soon as he finished speaking.
Clang!
The other five also attacked swiftly.
Even though their weapons were different, they were all extremely powerful, reaching the Martial Arts Golden Core Level!
Any one of them could easily overturn the entire Jiuzhou World!
The gap between a Martial Arts Golden Core strongman and a Shattering Level is incalculable!
And Ding Ling could defeat the Martial Arts Golden Core strongman.
Not only because his dantian had condensed 195 drops of True Water, surpassing the required amount for a First-Grade Golden Core!
But also due to his Full-Level Techniques, skills, and ability to amplify himself tenfold!
In other words.
Ding Ling’s current combat power could defeat a Golden Core Expert!
But against six Golden Core Experts, Ding Ling was overmatched.
Thinking of the somewhat inflated feeling in his dantian.
Ding Ling knew that he seemed to have reached his limit!
Perhaps he could still increase by one or two points.
But at this stage, he could already condense a core.

Therefore, when he saw the six attack simultaneously, Ding Ling immediately began condensing a core, perhaps because the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture far surpassed the Shattering Level techniques, and was at Full Level!
Or perhaps Ding Ling’s foundation was too solid and his background too vast and grand!
Or because Ding Ling had long reached the point of condensing a core, delaying further, leading to an overwhelming sense of fullness in the dantian.
Therefore.
As Ding Ling had the thought of condensing a core.
The next moment!
Boom!

drops of True Water immediately gathered into a mass, with the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture as the main core, assisted by the Demon Scripture, Ten Thousand Dao Forest, No Desire Technique, Eternal Youth Technique, Nine Yang Divine Skill, Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, World-Ending Demon Skill, etc.
A Tai Chi Eight Trigrams pattern rapidly condensed into a Fake Pill!
The Fake Pill turned from illusion into a Water Pill.
Then quickly transformed into a Golden Core.
And all of this happened within the span of two breaths.
The speed was so fast it even exceeded Ding Ling’s expectations.
Boom!
As the Golden Core was successfully condensed, a world-shattering aura erupted from Ding Ling’s body.
This aura’s strength had already surpassed Limu and the six!
"What?!"
The six, including Limu, were shocked and incredulous:
"How is this possible?! How long has it been?! How did such a terrifying transformation occur in him?! This is the Demon Realm!"

"Ordinary people entering the Demon Realm are quickly eroded and polluted by Demon Qi, becoming demons or demon beasts. Yet he remains unscathed, proving he must have some exceptional, miraculous trait!"
"This child is too frightening. He cannot be allowed to remain! He must be killed here; otherwise, the Demon Realm might be overturned by him alone!"
A member of the Human Race unafraid of Demon Qi.
This truly shook Limu and the others.
Not to mention this person had broken through to a level identical to theirs in mere breaths.
Before breaking through, he could already defeat any one of them.
Now that he’s broken through.
Can they still fight him?
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
Their weapons continuously pursued Ding Ling, slashing and chopping.
Ding Ling was stepping on the Free-Will Ascension Step while breaking through.
After the breakthrough was complete, he let out a long howl and suddenly wielded his saber!
No-Two Blade Technique!
Sky Dome Fury!
A single slash cleaved like lightning!
Once wielded, it seemed like celestial thunder rolling, saber light exploding, as if the heavens were angered, descending an apocalyptic saber tribulation!
Crackling! Dense saber light mixed with earth-shattering aura instantly covered Limu and the six.
Puff puff!
The six were slashed by countless blades in an instant, each wearing an expression of fear and disbelief, flipping to the ground.
Yet they were severely wounded by Ding Ling in an instant.
"Ha ha..."

Ding Ling laughed aloud, grabbing each of the six in mid-air, activating the Technique, absorbing their Magic Power, then activating the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, purifying the Magic Power, and refining it.
[Inner Power Value +1200 points]
[Inner Power Value +1300 points]
A total of six.
Each provided an average of 1200 points.
Providing a total of 7200 points.
In an instant.
more drops of True Water appeared in the dantian.
The True Water merged into the Golden Core.
Boom!
Ding Ling’s aura surged even higher!
[True Power Value: 219 points]
Even in the Golden Core Stage, the data performed remarkably.
But this time, the quality and level of the True Water far exceeded the past.
It’s essential to know that Ding Ling absorbed the Demon Qi of Golden Core Experts.
Their Demon Qi was of extremely high quality, extremely pure.
But even so, only a fraction was refined by Ding Ling, with over ninety percent of Demon Qi expelled and not absorbed.
The reasons being twofold.

First, the demons of the Martial Arts Golden Core, their golden cores’ bloodthirstiness, ferocity, and other negative Demon Qi were so deeply rooted that it was inseparable from their being, occupying most of it, resulting in a significant loss during the refinement process.
Second, their Martial Arts Golden Core were approximately Third, Fourth, or Fifth Grade, far inferior to Ding Ling’s First Grade! Thus, the conversion efficiency wasn’t as high as expected.
The purity of a First-Grade Golden Core’s True Qi is unparalleled. A casually wielded True Qi could effortlessly overthrow a Shattering Level expert!
This is the fearsome power of a First-Grade Golden Core strongman!
In the eyes of such a powerful individual.
A Shattering Level is merely an entity that can be destroyed with a breath of True Qi!

Unless one is extraordinarily gifted, like Wu Wudi, or Ding Ling, among the Shattering Level, an ordinary Shattering Level in the eyes of a First-Grade Golden Core strongman is no different from an ant.
"Very good."
Ding Ling was highly satisfied.
He had become even stronger.
Yet he also felt he was nearing the ultimate limit of this realm.
[Achieved C-Level Achievement Medal: Intimidate Limu.]

chapters.title: Chapter 729 - 718: Demon Emperor
paragraphs: [Received C-level Achievement Medal: Shocking Chang Xian.]
[Received C-level Achievement Medal: Shocking Dahong.]
[Note: As the Guardians of the Demon Emperor Palace, they were originally in slumber, but the irrigation of Demon Blood and the sounds of fierce battle awakened them.
Their main task is to guard the Demon Emperor Palace. Therefore, they did not rush to kill you.
When you intruded upon this place, they saw you and decided they must kill you.
Humans and Demons are irreconcilable.
This is the rule in their understanding!]
Upon hearing the prompt sound.
Ding Ling was startled.
Whether it was Limu, Chang Xian, or Dahong.
They were all trusted generals under the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan.
Unexpectedly, they have now become Guardians of the Demon Emperor Palace!
Ding Ling glanced at Limu and said:
"Now, can you tell me why you assist demons in their tyranny?"

Limu’s face was deathly pale, and the clarity in his eyes grew dimmer. Just as Ding Ling finished speaking, his eyes were overtaken by emotions such as ferocity and bloodthirst, indicating he had completely succumbed to madness.
Roar!
He roared at Ding Ling.
No different from the Celestial Soldiers and Generals and other demons outside.
Ding Ling looked at the others.
It was the same with them.
So he simply dealt with them one by one with a palm strike.
"It seems only by reaching the Golden Core Stage, can one maintain clarity of mind?"
Ding Ling thought of the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, Wind God, and Chiyou.
Based on the current situation, he drew a conclusion.
Wind God had not reached Core Formation, but his level must have reached the Golden Core Realm!
"Could it be that Wind God was able to arrive at the battlefield so quickly because he was sealed or buried there?"
Ding Ling glanced at the prompt panel.
As expected.
The annotation for Wind God’s Achievement Medal explained it quite clearly.
Ding Ling further inferred and came to a conclusion:
Wind God was indeed buried beneath that area.
He is also the Palace Master of a Demon Palace there.
The so-called Demon Palace Masters are four in number, each suppressing the southeast, southwest, northwest, and northeast regions.
Wind God suppresses the east and is the Palace Master of the Eastern Demon Palace.
And here, the Demon Emperor Palace?
Is the core realm.
The place where the true lord of the Magic Realm, the Demon Emperor, resides.
Even the Palace Masters of the Demon Palaces must obey his orders!
"Demon Emperor?"
Ding Ling raised an eyebrow and gripped the hilt of the Human Emperor Saber, shrinking the ground to an inch and arriving instantly at the Demon Emperor Palace.
At the very moment of arrival.
Ding Ling suddenly heard a voice:
"Ding Ling, come back quickly!"
The voice was clear and pleasant.
Very familiar.
It was the voice of the Female Drought Demon.
Ding Ling was astonished.
Before him appeared a door formed suddenly by water waves in the void.
"Go in quickly."
Ding Ling hesitated with uncertainty.
After all, no one knew if this was a trap set by someone impersonating the Female Drought Demon!
The Female Drought Demon’s voice had a tone of anxiety:
"If you don’t leave now, once the Demon Emperor takes action, you’re as good as dead."
As if to verify the truth of her words.
Bang!
The Demon Emperor Palace shook violently three times, and a massive hand that could blot out the sky reached out, slapping towards Ding Ling as if to smash him.
Ding Ling felt suffocated for a moment.
Daring not to hesitate any longer, he dove into the direction of the water wave gate.
Slam!

Almost immediately after Ding Ling entered the gate, with a loud bang, the hand struck heavily at the spot where Ding Ling had just stood, causing the Demon Emperor Palace to tremble wildly again, as if unable to withstand this power and about to collapse at any moment.
For a long while.
The Demon Emperor Palace finally regained calm, and a soft sigh came from deep within the palace:
"What a little rascal. To have inherited the legacies of the Great Sun Buddha, Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, and Chiyou, how troublesome!"
Plop!
Ding Ling’s vision went dark and bright.
Upon looking again, he found he had already arrived at the familiar Otherworldly Space.
Seated not far in front of him was an extraordinarily beautiful woman, forming seals with both hands.
The woman’s face was extremely pale. Seeing Ding Ling emerge, she released the seal, Bang! The water wave gate also dispersed into star points.
"Ding Ling."
The woman took a deep breath, then looked at Ding Ling with radiant eyes, her face full of joy:
"Did you succeed?!"
The woman was the Female Drought Demon.
Ding Ling felt great admiration for her, hence he spoke with respect:
"Yes, senior."
"Good, good, good!
The Female Drought Demon said ’good’ thrice, with a face of satisfaction she said:

"Now Jiuzhou has hope. Ding Ling, you truly are the master of the Xuanyuan Divine Sword and the Nuwa Stone! You lived up to the high expectations and succeeded in a short time, not to mention, it appears your cultivation..."
The Female Drought Demon took a breath:
"Has unexpectedly reached the Martial Arts Golden Core Realm, in such a short time?!"
[Received C-level Achievement Medal: You’ve earned the Female Drought Demon’s high recognition.]
[Note: Your success, your cultivation, and your deeds in the Demon Realm have all received the Female Drought Demon’s heartfelt admiration!]
The Female Drought Demon is also C-level.
It seems her current cultivation should also be at the Golden Core Realm?
Ding Ling couldn’t see through her.
He estimated her realm should be very high; otherwise, he wouldn’t have been able to fathom her with his First-Grade Golden Core.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling directly asked about her cultivation.
The Female Drought Demon didn’t hide it, saying:

"Different dimensions, different worlds, the maximum level of cultivation and martial power they can accommodate is naturally different. The Otherworldly Space where you entered the Loulan Ruins has the same upper limit as the human world."
She paused, then continued:
"Furthermore, the Sword Realm, Nine Void Realm, Demon Realm, Mountain and Sea Realm, and others all have the same upper limit as the human world.
While the Divine Realm, Celestial Realm, and Demon Realm have an extremely high upper limit, reaching the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm!"
"Martial Arts Primordial Spirit?!
Ding Ling was startled:
’The upper limit is so high?’
"Yes."
The Female Drought Demon nodded, saying:
"Because the Divine Realm, Celestial Realm, and Demon Realm, compared to the Demon Realm and the human world, although also scarred, have only dropped a few ranks.
Unlike the human world, Demon Realm, and other interfaces, whose world rank dropped to nearly the bottom!
Thus.
The human world and Sword Realm’s upper limit is only Shattering Level Great Perfection!"
Ding Ling didn’t expect such a situation.
It seems his guesses were not very accurate.
"And here?"
Ding Ling looked around.
"Here, because it is connected to portals with the Divine Realm and Demon Realm, yet separated from the human world, its upper limit is at the Golden Core Realm!"
The Female Drought Demon pointed to herself:

"I am quite special. The blood flowing within me is the Divine Blood of the Ancient Era, and because I am a Zombie Ancestor not belonging to the Five Elements or any world’s rank range. So my body and blood do not get greatly affected in such an environment. I can still exert my full strength.
Of course.
Compared to the Ancient God War days, now I am just a faint afterglow struggling to survive. Far inferior to my peak period back then."
Upon hearing this.
Ding Ling understood many secrets, but still had questions.
