chapters.title: Chapter 730 - 719: Skill of the Dao of Fire
paragraphs: "Senior, how did you perceive my situation just now?"
"I guard this place, and my will is almost bound to the gateways to the Divine Realm and the Demon Realm. So, anything or anyone near the gateway I suppress, I can sense."
The Female Drought Demon glanced at Ding Ling and said with admiration:
"And you were very close to the Demon Realm’s gateway then, so naturally I sensed you."
"What about the Demon Emperor..."
"The Demon Emperor Palace is suppressed below the Demon Realm’s gateway. As long as I’m alive, the Demon Emperor cannot come out of the Demon Emperor Palace to attack people in other regions."
Upon hearing this,
Ding Ling felt relieved.
He was puzzled before.
During his battle with Limu, Chang Xian, and others, why didn’t the Demon Emperor strike? It turns out it was not that he didn’t want to, but he couldn’t.
All of this is thanks to the Female Drought Demon!
Ding Ling felt admiration in his heart and asked again:
"Then why did I feel like my cultivation in the Demon Realm was reaching its limit? According to senior, shouldn’t I have reached the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm?"

"The world stature of the Demon Realm, Celestial Realm, and Divine Realm allows for the existence of someone at the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm, but no more than two people. Hence, in these Three Realms, only one Primordial Spirit Realm master can exist. Only when they die might a new Primordial Spirit Realm master be born."
Ding Ling felt confused at first.
But then he thought of the ’Saint’ setting in the novel’s primordial chaos, and felt relieved.
It seems that even in such high-tier worlds as the primordial chaos, the number of Saints is limited.
While the stature of the Three Realms of the Demon Realm is indeed high, allowing only one powerful person to exist seems reasonable.
Thinking of this,
Ding Ling asked again:

"In the Demon Realm, I saw the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, Limu, Chang Xian, Dahong, and other people of the Ancient Divine Race. They looked clear-minded, why did they willingly fall into the Demon Dao?"
"The power of the Demon Nature is extremely terrifying."
The Female Drought Demon spoke solemnly:
"It often fully activates all kinds of desires within a person! And it will infinitely magnify a person’s obsessions, greed, and desires!
By the time they realize it,
it’s already too late.
And at that time, trying to save them is impossible. They will willingly enter the Demon Realm for their desires!"

Ding Ling, being relieved, still did not understand what obsessions, greed, or delusions the Nine Heavens Profound Lady, Limu, and others had, that they would sacrifice their identities to join the Demon Realm?
"What about Chiyou?"
Ding Ling thought of this person.

"In the Ancient Era, he was extremely powerful! He was the first to fall into the demonic path, and after being defeated by my father in the Battle of the Deer, he was dismembered and suppressed in four directions. Part of his torso is in the Lingyun Cave.
So, the Chiyou you saw is not a complete Chiyou. But even so, this part of the shell contains the power of Shattering Great Perfection.
If the complete body of Chiyou were to reunite, it would once again become an unparalleled demonic entity.
Fortunately, the upper limit of the Human Realm prevents this.
Chiyou wants to break the world’s limit with his broken body. Yet it is not possible."
At this point,
The Female Drought Demon paused and told Ding Ling the other locations where Chiyou’s body parts are buried, finally saying:

"In the Ancient Era, we were unable to kill Chiyou. Besides his immortality, it was also because of his deep-seated demonic nature. As long as there is Demon Qi in his shell, in other words, as long as he can leverage the power of the Demon Realm, he can heal himself with Demon Qi and remain immortal!"
Her eyes were bright, full of anticipation as she looked at Ding Ling:

"Now is different. A human race master who has achieved Great Perfection in the Demon Scripture, Great Sun Buddha Technique, and Xuanyuan Heart Scripture has appeared! You will be the only hope to reverse Heaven and Earth in our world."
The Female Drought Demon spoke solemnly:
"Ding Ling, do you have anything else to say? Or are there any unfinished matters? If not, I will now assist you in entering the Demon Realm.
In the Demon Realm, with these cultivation techniques, you can quickly advance, and when you obtain ultimate power and clear the Demon Realm, we two together can try to kill the Demon Emperor.
If we can kill him,
there will be no more concerns."
Ding Ling’s task was not yet finished, so he expressed his desire to return to the Human Realm.
The Female Drought Demon did not insist, nodded, and said:
"In that case, you might as well try to completely suppress Chiyou’s remnants. If you succeed, it would also fulfill one of my father’s concerns."
"Yes."
Ding Ling suddenly thought of something:
"I don’t know how senior’s finger was obtained by Emperor Shitian?"
"It’s a long story. Simply put, my finger was cut off by the Demon Emperor during the Divine War and was blown into another Otherworldly Space."
"I see."
Ding Ling felt relieved, stopped asking, and instead chatted with the Female Drought Demon about cultivation techniques.
The Female Drought Demon was generous.
Knowing Ding Ling needed cultivation techniques,
she passed on all she had learned to Ding Ling.
She is an Ancient Divine Being.
The daughter of the Divine Emperor in the Celestial Realm!
The number of Secret Manuals she knew was countless.
There were too many.
Ding Ling listened with joy in his heart and remembered each one.
Then, with the help of the library, he rapidly achieved Full Level in each.
Mystical auras began to emerge from Ding Ling’s body.
[Inner Canon of Huangdi Full Level]
[Inner Power Value +600]
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Billowing True Qi surged over, instantly engulfing Ding Ling.
A drop of True Water immediately emerged in Ding Ling’s Dantian.
[True Power Value: 221 points]
Compared to the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture,
The Inner Canon of Huangdi is slightly inferior.
It’s evident that over the thousands of years in the Celestial Realm, Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan has innovated and created a stronger technique.
But even so,
The Inner Canon of Huangdi is considered a superior technique, capable of being cultivated to the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm!
[Fire Manipulation Skill Full Level]
This is a Skill that can control searing flames!
The prerequisite is that one’s body must withstand the high temperatures of the flames, otherwise, it is easy to burn oneself.
The Female Drought Demon, as the Fire Zombie Ancestor,
Has considerable resistance to fire!
Therefore, in the Dao of Fire, she knows many techniques.
[Fireball Skill Full Level]
[Fire Dragon Skill Full Level]
[Fire Tree and Silver Flower Skill Full Level]
[Starfire Technique Full Level]
[Heaven and Earth Burning Skill Full Level]
[Heaven-Scorching Earth-Burning Technique Full Level]
Although the Female Drought Demon was mentally prepared for Ding Ling’s talent,
Seeing Ding Ling instantly achieve a state of Great Perfection, she was stunned!
She went from disbelief to being petrified,
And finally, she became somewhat numb.
All of this happened in just a single hour.
Within this hour,

The Female Drought Demon spoke extremely quickly, teaching countless Dao of Fire techniques, and Ding Ling achieved Full Level in an instant, capable of freely controlling the flames in this Otherworldly Space without harm.
Clearly, Ding Ling’s physical body and shell have become so strong that they fear no ordinary flames.
"Such a formidable young person!"
"Incredible!"
The Female Drought Demon was deeply impressed and continued to discuss other techniques,
Discovering that Ding Ling also reached Full Level for each.
She talked non-stop for three days and nights.
Until she had shared everything she learned, as well as all the Martial Arts Secret Manuals she knew or understood with Ding Ling.
She finally stopped passing on techniques and looked at Ding Ling somewhat numbly, saying:
"I’ve shared all the techniques I had."

chapters.title: Chapter 731 - 720: The Mortal Realm
paragraphs: The Female Drought Demon paused, casting an enigmatic look at Ding Ling:

"Your talent is so extraordinary that it borders on the exaggerated, even terrifying. If the Demon Emperor learns of this, he will undoubtedly do everything in his power to kill you. Therefore, elevate your abilities as much as possible in the Mortal Realm to avoid being helplessly targeted by the Demon Emperor."
"Yes, Senior."
Ding Ling replied solemnly.
In his heart, he was quite delighted.
He had gained the teaching of the Zombie Ancestor, the Female Drought Demon.
His knowledge reservoir had suddenly soared by a whole level.
The techniques and skills the Female Drought Demon knew.
At a minimum, were all at the Grandmaster Level.
The majority were at the Golden Core Level.
Many were even at the Primordial Spirit Level.
With such high-quality techniques and skills under Ding Ling’s control, the progress of his Martial Arts Melting Furnace’s three legs instantly jumped by 28 points!
[Martial Arts Melting Furnace Three Legs Progress: 80%]
Such a significant increase.

Was due to the techniques he had acquired during this time like the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse, Heaven and Earth Righteous Qi Curse, Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, Inner Canon of Huangdi, Heaven-Scorching Earth-Burning Technique— all of which were above the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Level!
The quality was extremely high!
In addition, the Female Drought Demon’s discourse over three days and nights covered many ancient secret manuals, which were extremely precious and rare, numerous in quantity, and high in quality.
This was why the progress had surged so much.
"The moment the progress of the three legs is completed, it might be the time when all martial arts are refined into one furnace."
Ding Ling took a deep breath, and after chatting with the Female Drought Demon for a while, he bid her farewell and prepared to leave.
Before leaving, he glanced at Xiong Ba.
Xiong Ba had been watching Ding Ling, his gaze extremely complicated.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: You won the deep admiration of the Female Drought Demon.]
[Annotation: Your martial talent completely impressed her.]
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: You intimidated Xiong Ba and earned a certain degree of his recognition.]
[Annotation: Your immense martial power inspired awe in Xiong Ba, and your high talent left him far behind.]
Previously, he earned a C-level one from the Female Drought Demon.
Now he has another D-level one.
That two medals could appear on one person, and in a diminishing pattern, Ding Ling knew long ago, but wondered whether three or four could appear?
And Xiong Ba?
His strength hadn’t reached the Golden Core Level, which is why he only achieved a D-level medal.
Only those above Golden Core are eligible for C-level.
Grandmasters, Shattering Level strong are D-level.
And the weight of a D-level can also vary, with that of a Shattering Level strong providing more strength if used!
Ding Ling had previously logged out briefly; thus, he was naturally clear about it.
Clip-clop!
The further Ding Ling walked, the more he gradually disappeared from Xiong Ba’s view.
He let out a long sigh, his expression gloomy.
As he placed his feet in the positions of the Six Harmonies Array, following beside the Female Drought Demon, he seemed to become clearer in his perception.
The Female Drought Demon also glanced to the side, considering that Xiong Ba might very likely become a strong force among the Fire Zombies.
Fire Zombies capable of retaining their consciousness are rare.
Xiong Ba is among the outstanding ones.
Ding Ling exited the Otherworldly Space where the Fire Zombie Origin Land was located.
Crossing through that door, he landed on the back of the Dragon Turtle.
He contemplated taking away the turtle’s back.
But soon.
He sensed something unusual.
Maybe because his power had surged; upon reaching this realm, Ding Ling discovered that his strength was restricted, suppressing his cultivation realm to Shattering Level Great Perfection.
Ding Ling used the ’Divination Skill’ to slightly deduce and calculate.
Coming to realize:
If he forced himself to break free from this restriction, he would likely face the wrath and punishment of the heavens!
Might even be detested by the entire world!
At that time, all things might attack him as he walks!
"This restraining power, it appears to be a power of this world, this Heavenly Dao!"
Ding Ling realized.
Not attempting to forcibly break free.
The risk was too high; not worth it.
Moreover.
Even if he could only exert the power of Shattering Level Great Perfection.
His techniques were extremely advanced; with multiple fold enhancements, he could easily exert Golden Core Level powers to sweep through the Mortal Realm, Sword Realm, etc., without a problem.
As for the Dragon Turtle before him?
"It is the cornerstone supporting this portal’s existence. If I take away the Dragon Turtle’s back, this portal might vanish. Entering this Otherworldly Space again would become too difficult then."
"Better leave it here."
Ding Ling thought.
He even set up multiple arrays in the Eight Directions Territory of this turtle back.
Naturally intended to prevent others from taking the turtle’s back.
The turtle’s back is the hardest thing on a Divine Beast!
Consider how a single scale of a Fire Qilin can create a Fire Qilin Sword.
Such a large turtle back, how many Divine Weapons could be created from it?
Ding Ling completed the array arrangement and then left.
The Loulan Ruins still remained a scene of broken walls and ruins.
Nothing worth lingering over.
Swoosh swoosh!
At Ding Ling’s current cultivation realm, crossing thousands of feet in one step was like an ordinary occurrence, exiting the Loulan Ruins and stepping into the Mortal Realm in just a moment.
"Mortal Realm."
Ding Ling exhaled deeply.

Compared to the desolation of the Divine Realm, the solemnity of the Celestial Realm, the darkness of the Demon Realm, and the deathly silence of the Otherworldly Space, the Mortal Realm was indeed more beautiful.
Swoosh!
Stepping on the Free-Will Ascension Step, with the Infinite Crossing Power embracing him, Ding Ling moved towards the east like a gust of wind, a wisp of cloud, at extreme speed.
After some time.
He arrived at the Luoyang Imperial Palace Main Hall.
Seeing Guan Yu and Wang Bodang still guarding the Main Hall, he couldn’t help but ask a few questions.
Only then did he learn.
Three days had passed since he left Luoyang.
"It hardly felt like that long."
"It seems when traversing the river of time, the Half-God disturbed the flow of time, accelerating the passage significantly?!"
The actual situation.
Remained hard to comprehend.
But from the Female Drought Demon’s mouth, Ding Ling learned that the Demon Realm, Celestial Realm, Divine Realm, and Mortal Realm had the same temporal flow.
This pointed to a problem with the river of time.
In a short time.
Days had passed.
If more time were spent.
Would mountains and seas change?!
Ding Ling grew alarmed, increasingly feeling the need to pass on the teachings to Diao Chan and others in the Lower Realm.
"Once I finish the tasks of this world, I will go to the Three Kingdoms World and teach them the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture."
Compared to other techniques.
The Xuanyuan Heart Scripture excels in longevity.
Once at Full Level.
Living three thousand years is effortlessly attainable.
Of course, possessing Divine Blood would ensure even longer life.
Figures like the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, Female Drought Demon, and Chiyou all have Divine Blood. Divine Blood is only for members of the Ancient Divine Race.
Ding Ling and others are just ordinary humans, lacking such an advantage.
Although this is the case, the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture’s life-extending effects far exceed those of the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique and others.
"Your Majesty. And Xiong Ba..."
Guan Yu asked, full of anticipation.
"Resolved."
"Your Majesty’s divine might!"
Guan Yu expressed his submission.

"Your talent is so extraordinary that it borders on the exaggerated, even terrifying.
If the Demon Emperor learns of this, he will undoubtedly do everything in his power to kill you.
Therefore, elevate your abilities as much as possible in the Mortal Realm to avoid being helplessly targeted by the Demon Emperor."
"Yes, Senior."

chapters.title: Chapter 732 - 721: Water God Ancestor
paragraphs: Guan Yu and Wang Bodang, having gotten the answer they wanted, left satisfied.
Since Ding Ling said it was resolved, naturally they didn’t need to worry anymore.
They should go about their own matters now.
Meanwhile, Ding Ling chose to continue reading.
He hoped to quickly reach 100% progress on the Martial Arts Melting Furnace’s three legs.
The fifth batch of books obviously hasn’t filled the library in three days.
But perhaps due to the vast area guarded by Lü Bu, Nie Feng, and others, governance is constantly improving, meaning the speed of collecting secret manuals has also increased.
Thus, although not fully stacked, the quantity is quite considerable.
There are tens of thousands of them.
Ding Ling spent two hours and finished reading some of the collected secret manuals.
The progress jumped 3 points.
"This time, it’s time to slay the dragon."
Slaying the dragon is a must.
After all, the War God Technique lacks a large amount of divinity to condense the War God Spirit Body!
Only by condensing a ’War God’ within the body can one be truly immortal, unaffected even when decapitated.
"Your Majesty, I’ll accompany you."
Little Zhao said:
"I know the exact route."
"Alright. Lead the way."
Little Zhao’s cultivation is exceptionally high.

Having fully inherited the ’True Inheritance of the Twelve Demon Gods,’ her Heaven-Reaching Supreme Sword Bone, under Ding Ling’s guidance, has perfectly assimilated these benefits, pushing her cultivation to the Peak of Shattered Middle Stage, just one step away from High Tier.
Plus, she possesses the Great Perfection Level Sword Spirit and knows the Great Perfection Level Profound Yin Twelve Swords.
It’s fair to say.
Little Zhao can currently defeat Emperor Shitian.
Who would have thought Little Zhao would progress so terrifyingly after gaining her opportunity and fortune?!
Ding Ling didn’t expect it, and others certainly didn’t. This shows that if someone wants to quickly become a top-tier powerhouse, opportunities and fortunes are indispensable.
A small island twenty miles outside Divine Dragon Island.
Lü Bu, Nie Feng, and Bu Jingyun’s Great Army were camped here.
They had reached this place long ago.
They had been confronting the original residents of Divine Dragon Island ’head-on’ for quite a while.
They suspected whether Ding Ling would come, when suddenly Ding Ling and Little Zhao appeared from the sky, landing in front of them.
The three were taken aback.
Then bowed together ceremoniously:
"Greetings, Our King! Long live Our King! Greetings, Empress! Thousand-year Empress!"
"Rise from your bows."
Ding Ling asked calmly:
"So, hasn’t it been settled yet?"
"The Water Race people on Divine Dragon Island, through some method, released an invincible, indestructible monster. We couldn’t match it, could only retreat and wait for Your Majesty’s arrival."
Nie Feng said respectfully.
"Monster?"
Ding Ling’s eyebrows slightly raised:
"Lead the way, let’s take a look."
"Yes."
Lü Bu led the way, followed closely by Nie Feng and Bu Jingyun.
Over these past few months, Bu Jingyun had seen Ding Ling countless times.

On the second meeting, Bu Jingyun felt somewhat awkward, ashamed, and uncomfortable, but after seeing him often, he became numb and could now relatively comfortably view his relationship with Ding Ling.
Sometimes he would console himself with the alien words: It’s just a change of boss.
Moreover, this boss is extremely powerful and generous to subordinates! Much stronger than Xiong Ba.
Under such a powerful leader, Bu Jingyun naturally had no objections to being a general.
What frustrated him was that Xiong Ba had disappeared! He wanted revenge on Xiong Ba, but no doors seemed open!
But...
"I heard recently Guan Yu and others sent news of Xiong Ba, and Your Majesty personally went to verify it. Is this true?"
Bu Jingyun couldn’t hold back, stepped back two steps, bowed to Ding Ling before asking.
"It’s true."
"And Xiong Ba, what about him?"
Bu Jingyun’s eyes lit up.
Nie Feng sighed, thinking how lucky it was Youruo didn’t come along; otherwise, there might be trouble.

Lü Bu sneered, seemingly finding Bu Jingyun annoying. It was his first time seeing someone cooler than himself, naturally displeased! Were it not for Nie Feng’s mediation, he would have fought Bu Jingyun already!
Ding Ling glanced at Bu Jingyun, and flatly said:
"Xiong Ba is no longer human."
"... Is, is Xiong Ba dead?!"
Bu Jingyun asked tremblingly.
Ding Ling did not answer, instead walking forward on his own.
Leaving Bu Jingyun standing there, lost in thought, looking despondent.
Not exacting personal revenge.
For Bu Jingyun, it’s extremely hard to accept!
Very soon.
Everyone reached Divine Dragon Island.
Just as they stepped foot.
Boom!

A giant man wrapped in golden armor, wearing a horned helmet, possessing muscular, sturdy physique, took a single stride, descended vertically from a mountain, landing heavily before Ding Ling’s group, causing the ground to sink several feet! A powerful vortex centered around the giant man spread rapidly in all directions.
This force was extraordinarily intense.
Lü Bu couldn’t help but change his expression and step back, saying:
"Your Majesty. It’s him! An irrational, murderous undead!"
"Undead?"
Ding Ling looked at the opponent, recalling from comics, already speculating that this was most likely the Water God Ancestor of the Water Race.
Rumor had it that, hundreds of years ago, the Water God Ancestor accidentally wounded the Divine Dragon, causing dragon blood to infect his arm, making it invincible and impervious to weaponry.
And also due to dragon blood and his technique.
He managed to remain uncorrupted physically for centuries!
Of course, while his body could remain uncorrupted, his spirit couldn’t, hence he became completely irrational.
Thus, he typically remained dormant deep in Divine Dragon Island’s lake-island lake.
To awaken him, one must use Divine Power!
According to the original plot, the Water Race should have seized the Fire Qilin Sword to resurrect the Water God Ancestor.
But now?
Ding Ling inquired about this matter.
Nie Feng said he was unaware, but his Fire Qilin Saber remained!
Just as Ding Ling was going to ask more, the Water God Ancestor’s eyes turned red and charged rapidly towards Ding Ling.
Boom!
The Water God Ancestor’s speed was exceptionally fast, reaching Ding Ling within two breaths, then a fist swung heavily towards Ding Ling’s face.
Ding Ling slightly furrowed his brow, not sparing the Water God Ancestor, and also threw a punch.
Boom!
The two fists collided, producing a continuous cracking sound.
The Water Race people watching couldn’t help but show joy and began to move forward to surround Ding Ling’s group.
Suddenly, Boom! The Water God Ancestor flew back faster than he came!
Crackling! His entire skeleton seemed to explode, visibly, the Water God Ancestor’s nose and eardrums started bleeding.
The arm he just used to punch became limp, seemingly ruined.
"How is this possible?!"
"Ancestor!"
The Water Race rushed forward to assist, but the Water God Ancestor, now severely injured, became even more savage and irrational, thrust his intact right arm like an iron spear, Poof!
One of the Water Race trying to help was instantly impaled through the chest!

chapters.title: Chapter 733 - 722: Divine Water Technique Full Level
paragraphs: "Ah!"
The Water Race people screamed.
The Water Race leader, a middle-aged man with an imposing appearance, immediately shouted loudly upon seeing the scene:
"Everyone, halt!"
However, the crazed Water God Ancestor ignored him, charging directly at the Water Race people.

The Water Race leader was horrified and quickly performed the Divine Water Technique, chanting incantations as the body of the Water God Ancestor suddenly twisted bizarrely and headed towards Ding Ling’s direction instead.
The leader wiped cold sweat from his forehead, muttering:
"Fortunately, a master taught me the Corpse Control Technique, combined with my bloodline connection with the Ancestor, otherwise, we might have been completely annihilated just now."
He looked towards Ding Ling’s position, his expression cold, murderous intent evident:
"These people want to invade our Divine Dragon Island, and are the scum in the eyes of a master! They deserve extermination! But it seems the Ancestor isn’t a match for that young man?!"
Just as he was thinking this.
There was a loud bang.
The Water God Ancestor who had just rushed over was slapped to the ground by Ding Ling, who then stepped over him, boom!
Directly smashing the Water God Ancestor’s head, causing his skull to shatter.
The headless Water God Ancestor struggled for a moment, then remained motionless.
"Ancestor!"
The leader and others exclaimed, their faces changing color.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidate Water Race Leader.]

[Note: The leader, assisted by a master, greatly advanced his skills, he could still gain the upper hand against Nie Feng and others. He thought that with the support of a master, he didn’t need to fear even the emperor of the Great Ming Dynasty. However, you killed the Water God Ancestor in two moves, making him feel genuine fear, without knowing what to do!]
A master behind him?!

Ding Ling glanced at the Water Race leader, stepped with the Free-Will Ascension Step, Shrinking Inches, instantly crossing a hundred yards, arriving in front of the Water Race leader, staring at him, said indifferently:
"Who is the master behind you?"
Ding Ling felt it.
This master is likely the person releasing the Water God Ancestor to oppose his Great Ming Dynasty!
Has it come to this, and someone still dares to oppose him?
Either they have absolute confidence in their strength, disdainful of Ding Ling’s actions, or they bear deep enmity with exceedingly high skills.
No matter which, Ding Ling cannot ignore them.
"You, you..."
The Water Race leader took two steps back.
At this moment.
He truly understood what the absolute powerhouse described by Lü Bu, Nie Feng meant!
Too strong!
An Ancestor capable of overthrowing a nation was easily killed.
A character with such means.
Could it be...
"You, you are..."
The Water Race leader seemed to recall something, pupils widening, his face full of shock:
"Ding Ling, Emperor of the Great Ming Dynasty!"
"How dare you call His Majesty’s name?"
Lü Bu scolded:
"If you don’t want to die, surrender quickly!"
Lü Bu’s words completely confirmed his speculation.

Initially, the leader didn’t believe this! It was too far-fetched, after all!
In a rage, he even drove away the aliens.
Later, under a master’s guidance and words, he was convinced that the weak aliens group was just using Ding Ling to gain acceptance from people like them!

Thus, even though he had a deep impression of Ding Ling, he didn’t think Ding Ling was stronger than the master, even believing the master, who could easily suppress the Water God Ancestor, was the world’s most powerful, low-profile person.
However, Ding Ling’s recent fierce moves and killing the Water God Ancestor in two moves, made his heart tremble and shudder.
Upon hearing Lü Bu’s words, the leader’s legs weakened in fear, despite recalling the master’s words, couldn’t help but shout:
"We, the Water Race, were born to protect the Divine Dragon! We will never succumb to evil forces! If you want me to surrender, it’s utterly impossible!"
Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill Full Level, from the eyes of the leader and others, he saw their confidence, malice, hostility.
He sighed:
"If so."
Ding Ling slapped, smack!
Directly knocking the leader to the ground, then grabbed him midair, Eternal Youth Technique activated, Absorption, Transformation, Storage!
The True Qi of the leader’s body was completely refined.
Unfortunately.
It only slightly provided Ding Ling with some foundation, not even half a point of Inner Power Value.
Having reached Ding Ling’s level.
Unless it’s a Shattering Level Great Perfection existence.
Or someone above Shattering Level cultivating extremely powerful techniques, otherwise, the conversion efficiency is too low, absorbing feels the same as not absorbing!
Ding Ling was mentally prepared for this.
After all, he is now a First-grade Golden Core Realm powerhouse.
Ordinary cultivation techniques, Shattering Level Great Perfection figures, may not provide him significant benefits, let alone this kind of Grandmaster.
Even so.

Ding Ling still grabbed the leader, using the Emperor’s Sword to break the Sword Realm, bringing him into the Sword Mountain domain, activating the Domain Crystal, utilizing the Sword Spirit’s ability to extract others’ Consciousness Body memories.
Extracting some Techniques and Laws from the leader’s Sea of Consciousness.
These Techniques and Laws, if the Sword Spirit knows, it means Ding Ling knows.
So quickly.
[Divine Water Technique Full Level]
This is clearly also a Shattering Level technique.
Extremely powerful.
[Corpse Control Technique Full Level]
[Water Manipulation Skill Full Level]
[Diving Skill Full Level]
[Vajra Body Protection Technique Full Level]
The leader indeed truly had a vast amount of knowledge.
He knew only a dozen techniques himself, but the Techniques and Laws in his memory were extremely abundant.
Ding Ling mastered all at Full Level.

What slightly disappointed him was that the upper limit values of the Sword Realm and human realm are all at Shattering Level Great Perfection, so although the Divine Water Technique was full level, it couldn’t provide Inner Power Value.
Otherwise, going to higher worlds like the Demon Realm, Celestial Realm, a full-level Divine Water Technique would certainly add about 300 Inner Power Value.
This is the limitation of the Earth Realm.
The human realm, Sword Realm limited, can only lock cultivation at Shattering Level Great Perfection, naturally cannot be further enhanced.
"You, you, you..."
The leader gazed at Ding Ling fearfully:
"Are you human or ghost?"
He could extract others’ memories, easily breaking through to another mystical world; such godly means, how is it different from Ghost Gods?!
"I already know who is opposing me."
As Ding Ling advanced to First-grade Golden Core Realm.
Although the Domain Crystal has become negligible.
Due to the Sword Spirit receiving the support of his realm, in this small domain, it can still exert stronger power than before.
This is the crushing of realm!
Dealing with weaker individuals.
Within the domain.
The Sword Spirit now can easily extract memory from others, it’s not difficult.
And through the leader’s memory.
Ding Ling knew the leader’s hostility and murderous intent towards him.
Also clarified the name and appearance of the so-called master behind it.

chapters.title: Chapter 734 - 723: Divine Dragon
paragraphs: "Xiaao Sanxiaao, Wu Wudi!"
These are the two men.
No wonder the clan leader of the Water Race dares to confront the Great Army of the Great Ming Dynasty, even daring to venture to Divine Dragon Island and let the Water God Ancestor attack directly.
It turns out their confidence comes from these two men.
"It’s easy to understand Xiaao Sanxiaao. After all, I killed his son. But Wu Wudi, what’s this master doing here?"
Ding Ling couldn’t figure it out.
He has no animosity with Wu Wudi.
Why does he want to kill me?!

Ding Ling couldn’t find the answer from the clan leader’s memory; after all, separating memories only extracts a part, and this is because his realm is much higher than the clan leader’s, plus the Sword Spirit’s separation technique within the domain has reached a divine level. Otherwise, he wouldn’t know this much information.
"You, you..."
The clan leader was completely terrified.
He couldn’t imagine that there could be a peerless extraordinary person like Ding Ling in the world!
Ding Ling’s might, as described by the high population, was completely different!
Was it that the high population deceived him, or did Ding Ling hide his true strength?!
Pah!
Ding Ling slapped out, shattering the clan leader.
Since he was an enemy.
There was naturally no need to keep him around for irritation.
As the Human Emperor, he has the responsibility and duty to protect Jiuzhou.
But he guards the people and things he believes should be protected.
He will decisively kill what is not worth protecting!
Crack!

Ding Ling swung his sword, cleaving open the Sword Realm again. He emerged from it, then used Divine Movement Skill and Free-Will Ascension Step, transforming into a beam of light. Before long, he arrived again at Divine Dragon Island.
"Your Majesty!"
Lü Bu, Bu Jingyun, and Nie Feng called out in awe.
Ding Ling’s prowess had already exceeded their imagination. Cleaving open a world was as easy as idle play. How is this different from a god?!
Ding Ling nodded towards them and proceeded straight towards the central location of Divine Dragon Island.
The Divine Dragon was at the center of the island in the lake.
Da da!
Ding Ling took one step, covering a hundred yards, and in no time, he delved deeply into Divine Dragon Island.
The other Water Race people dared not stop him.
Ding Ling crushed the Water God Ancestor and the clan leader.
These two were akin to gods and emperors in the hearts of the Water Race people.
Now the god has fallen, the emperor died.

They were panic-stricken yet dared not oppose Ding Ling’s party. Of course, there were also death warriors loyal to the clan leader. Impossible as it seemed, they attempted attacks and assassination on Ding Ling and Nie Feng’s party, with outcomes naturally unfavorable.
A moment later.
Ding Ling used Breath-holding Skill, Diving Technique, and Water Manipulation Skill, diving like a fish into the depths of the lake island, and saw the Divine Dragon at the lake’s bottom.
It was exactly as the legends depicted—a Divine Dragon that was over a hundred yards long, extremely huge, with claws larger than several people!
Its entire body was boiling with demonic power!
As soon as Ding Ling stood before it, it seemed to sense him and suddenly opened its dragon eyes, as large as water tanks.
"Roar!"
With a sudden, furious roar, it opened its blood-red mouth and was about to bite Ding Ling!
"Deeply entrenched in demon nature, beyond salvation."
Ding Ling shook his head and swiftly drew his saber!
No-Two Blade Technique!
Clouds Breaking Through the Blue Sky!
One slash was sent out, with an amplification over tenfold, a dazzling, intimidating saber light materialized out of void, and dropped swiftly like a thunderbolt.
Boom!
The saber light clashed heavily with the dragon’s mouth, accompanied by crackling explosions and clattering splashes of water, howl!
A miserable cry, the Divine Dragon was slashed and sent flying over a dozen yards.
In the area it flew over.
One could see dragon scales and droplets of radiant dragon blood scattered!
Dragon blood condensed rather than dispersed, reminiscent of blood-red gems. They looked quite extraordinary!
Ding Ling casually seized two drops and sensed the overwhelming Spiritual Vitality, demon nature, and divinity.
Ding Ling instinctively operated the Demon Scripture to absorb the magic power,
the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell to purify the demon nature;
the War God Technique to absorb and refine the divine power.
His techniques were all at full level, coupled with a supreme cultivation. The two drops of dragon blood were refined swiftly and thoroughly.
"The War God Spirit Body condensed a wisp. As expected, it’s useful. If I capture all the dragon blood, the War God Spirit Body can surely be completely condensed. By then, I shall be immortal."
The Divine Dragon before him had already been completely covered by demonic power.
It was here because this place was related to the suppression of Chiyou’s partial body.
Much like Lingyun Cave.
The Divine Beast’s power was used to counteract the demonic powers of Chiyou.
Regrettably.
The Divine Beast’s divine power had retreated step by step, corroded by the demon nature. Lingyun Cave was like this, and so was the Divine Dragon here.
"It seems the suppression of Chiyou’s body must be completed ahead of schedule."
Ding Ling thought to himself, then wielded the Human Emperor Saber, chasing after and slashing the Divine Dragon.
The Divine Dragon was immensely powerful, having reached the Realm of Shattered Great Perfection!
Its strength had stood at the apex of the mortal world. Moreover, its defense was terrifyingly strong! Breaking its defense was extremely difficult for peers at the same level!

But Ding Ling was at the First-grade Golden Core Realm, even though suppressed by the world, only able to exhibit the Shattering Great Perfection level of strength, he amplified himself over tenfold and wielded the Human Emperor Saber that countered the Divine Dragon. The confrontation was a crushing victory.
Before long.
The Divine Dragon was killed at the lake’s bottom.
Its divine blood was completely sucked and refined by him.
Whoosh whoosh!
The War God Spirit Body immediately transformed and emerged, becoming a smaller version of Ding Ling, anchoring itself at the heart.
Henceforth, the spirit body is immortal.
Ding Ling would not die even if his head was severed.
"Great. The War God Technique has from now reached Great Success. The immortal body is finally achieved!"
Ding Ling took a Dragon Essence from the Divine Dragon’s remains.
This Dragon Essence was as big as a basin, entirely crimson like lava, extremely hot and scorching.
But Ding Ling possessed the Female Drought Demon’s full inheritance!
Fire Manipulation Skill and Fire Control Skill had already reached the pinnacle. A bit of high temperature, how could it possibly harm him?
He held the Dragon Essence, contemplated for a bit, and then began refining it straight away.
The Dragon Essence, in reality, is the Dragon Pearl.
It’s the Divine Dragon’s entire divine power and essence materialized.
If forcibly consumed, there’s a high chance of being assimilated by the beast’s ferocity, becoming a monstrous being neither human nor dragon!
Duann Lang consumed two smaller Dragon Essences and became half-man, half-dragon.
The terrifying power of Dragon Essence assimilation was evident.
Ding Ling was different.
He mastered too many superior martial arts. At this moment, he was using the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell to purify the demon nature within the Dragon Essence!
Simultaneously using Ten Thousand Dao Forest and Eternal Youth Technique to absorb the ’life force’ in the Dragon Essence, refining this force with Xuanyuan Heart Scripture.
The vast life force poured into Ding Ling’s body like an ocean.
Ding Ling’s lifespan visibly surged.
Four thousand years!
Five thousand years!
Six thousand years!
Twelve thousand years!
After exhausting the vast life force in the Dragon Essence.
Ding Ling’s lifespan significantly increased by a full twelve thousand years before it stopped.
"It seems the legend is false."
Ding Ling pondered.
It’s said that consuming a Dragon Essence can grant immortality, eternal life.
But obviously.
This is relative to ordinary human lifespan.

chapters.title: Chapter 735 - 724: Farewell, Chiyou
paragraphs: The lifespan of a mortal lasts no more than a hundred years.
Compared to over ten thousand years, it is indeed insignificant.
Over ten thousand years...
It is a number that would make anyone look up in awe.
A thousand years is enough to witness the vicissitudes of life and the transformation of the sea into mulberry fields.
Ten thousand years is beyond even Ding Ling’s imagination.
After all, the history of the ancient kingdoms in the Earth World of his previous life was only about five thousand years!
Yet he could live for twelve thousand years!
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
His previous lifespan was around three thousand nine hundred years.
This was due to the support of skills like the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, World-Ending Demon Skill, Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, and his own physique!
Now, having increased his lifespan so significantly in one breath was indeed remarkable.
"In this world, even the lifespan of the Ancient Gods is limited. It doesn’t make sense for Divine Beasts to have infinite lifespans."
Divine Beasts would die.
So how long could someone who consumed their Dragon Essence really live?
To live ten thousand years is already a heavenly blessing!
"Besides the immense vitality, this Dragon Essence also contains an enormous amount of Divine Power."
Ding Ling began to absorb this Divine Power.
As he continued to absorb and refine it.
The War God Spirit Body became more and more condensed and substantial.
It began to shift from an ethereal state to a real one.

But perhaps because the divine nature contained in the Dragon Blood he previously absorbed and refined was also quite extraordinary, the divine nature in this Dragon Essence can only be said to be comparable to that in the Dragon Blood.
Even so, it allowed Ding Ling’s War God Spirit Body to advance further.
Up to now.
The War God Spirit Body could not only hide in his heart but also in his lungs.
If more places became available to hide.
It would become increasingly difficult for others to find it in the future!
"If the entire divine nature and Essence Qi of the Divine Dragon were contained in the Dragon Blood, then perhaps, after I refined the Dragon Blood, this Dragon Essence would have shrunk directly."
Ding Ling placed the drastically reduced Dragon Essence into his Storage Pouch.
The current Dragon Essence had become much less scorching hot.
Only pure Spiritual Vitality remained within.
Ding Ling planned to enter the Otherworldly Space where the Female Drought Demon resided to absorb the power of this Dragon Essence to enhance himself.
Because the limitations of the Mortal Realm were too great.
If he absorbed the Dragon Essence, it likely wouldn’t enhance himself much, only his foundation. Naturally, Ding Ling hoped to increase his strength more significantly.
Ding Ling looked at the Dragon Scales at the bottom of the lake.
Perhaps due to the loss of Dragon Blood and Dragon Essence.

The remains of the Divine Dragon were shrinking rapidly, and the Dragon Scales were becoming increasingly dim. Ding Ling grabbed a handful of Dragon Scales and gently squeezed them, cracking them instantly!
"Indeed. The Divine Power of the Divine Dragon is all concentrated in the Dragon Essence and Dragon Blood."
With the loss of Dragon Essence and Dragon Blood.
The Divine Dragon would completely die and vanish into light.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
In just a short time, the remains of the Divine Dragon indeed transformed into rays of light and disappeared into the seafloor, leaving no trace.
The Dragon Scales remained, but they were like useless debris with no value at all.
Ding Ling shook his head, and with a Shrinking Inches, he swiftly cut through the waves to where the Divine Dragon had once resided.
Here, an Ancient Nine Palace Linked Array had been artificially set up!
Ding Ling understood the method of breaking formations.
Because the Female Drought Demon had taught him many Ancient High-Level Arrays.
He had mastered them all at Full Level.
This included the Nine Palace Linked Array.
Click! Click!

Ding Ling performed the Seal Technique with his hands and, following a special route, entered the Life Gate. After several twists and turns, it was as if he had stepped into a strange tunnel. Looking ahead, he saw a cave.
The cave was not large.
In the center, apart from a deep pool, there was nothing else.
Looking up, he could see a light source.
"Is this a well?"
Ding Ling marveled secretly.
It was clearly a sea.
But in the lake of Divine Dragon Island, there was a deep well, and within the well, a deep pool.
Recalling the Female Drought Demon’s words.
Ding Ling walked into the deep pool, and sure enough, poisonous water overflowed, and the demonic force surged endlessly, immensely oppressive and erosive.
"The corrosive power and demonic nature here are far more terrifying than those in Lingyun Cave."
But it’s understandable.
In Lingyun Cave, there were Dragon Veins and Fire Qilin jointly suppressing it.
Here, there was only the Divine Dragon.
"For any ordinary expert to enter here is to court death; they cannot get in deep. But for me, it poses no significant problem."
The depth of the deep pool reached a thousand feet.
The deeper he went, the more immense the demonic nature became.
The more poisonous the water became as well.
Ding Ling, being immune to all poisons and able to refine demon nature.
Naturally, he tread easily.
Upon reaching the bottom of the deep pool, Ding Ling saw a peculiar array here.
It was no different from the Tai Chi Yin Yang Array in Lingyun Cave.
Here too appeared a rotating, uncertain Tai Chi Diagram.
Half of it was condensed into the Fiery Flame Yang Diagram with two Dragon Eggs as the core;
The other half was condensed into the Dark Shadow Map with a coffin as the core.
"Indeed, there are also Divine Dragon Eggs here."

Ding Ling had learned the Artifact Identification Skill from the Female Drought Demon, and by activating the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, he could instantly perceive the essence of an object and understand its true meaning.
At this moment, it was the same. Ding Ling immediately saw the dragon fetus within the eggs!
"However, like the egg of the Fire Qilin, these dragons are deeply demonic and have become demon creatures! They must be slain."
Ding Ling felt slightly regretful.
However, the divine nature within these two Dragon Eggs was also extraordinary, capable of making his War God Spirit Body even more substantial.
He stepped forward.
With Shifting Form and Position.
He effortlessly stepped into the array.
Back in Lingyun Cave, he couldn’t break this Tai Chi Yin Yang Array!
He could only choose to break the array by brute force.
But now he could step easily into the array, naturally benefitting from the Ancient High-Level Array techniques taught by the Female Drought Demon.
It must be said.

The Female Drought Demon, worthy of being the daughter of the Celestial Emperor, possessed immense knowledge. If Ding Ling hadn’t been cheating with the Full Level hack, such extensive knowledge would have taken him hundreds or even thousands of years to learn.
"These Divine Dragon Eggs are too large. My Storage Pouch can’t hold them."
Ding Ling looked at the coffin:
"I should deal with Chiyou’s remains first!"
As he thought this.
Bang!
Ding Ling felt a slight tremor in his body, as if something had entered his body.
In the next instant, hearing a startled shout, Ding Ling closed his eyes slightly, the Sword Spirit opened its eyes, and immediately saw a blurry, fierce figure rushing into his heart.
This person’s form was extremely familiar.
The Sword Spirit’s eyes were sharp, reaching the position of the heart in a moment, directly confronting this person, and raising an eyebrow, he said:
"Chiyou!"
"You recognize me!"
The intruder’s expression changed slightly:
"Could it be that you have visited other suppressions of my presence?!"
"So it is you!"

The Sword Spirit formed a sword with two fingers, and activating Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root, a dense web of Sword Qi ensnared Chiyou in an instant then began to cut and pierce him back and forth.
Chiyou couldn’t react in time, and when he did, he was already caught, leaving him terrified and crying out:
"Who on earth are you!? How can you be this strong?! How do you know the Demon Scripture, War God Technique that only I know!!"
Ding Ling did not reply.
But from Chiyou’s words.
Ding Ling came to understand.
Chiyou being Immortal is not without reason.
He had actually cultivated several Soul Divisions!

sentences.text: The lifespan of a mortal lasts no more than a hundred years.
Compared to over ten thousand years, it is indeed insignificant.
Over ten thousand years...
It is a number that would make anyone look up in awe.
A thousand years is enough to witness the vicissitudes of life and the transformation of the sea into mulberry fields.
Ten thousand years is beyond even Ding Ling’s imagination.
After all, the history of the ancient kingdoms in the Earth World of his previous life was only about five thousand years!
Yet he could live for twelve thousand years!
"Very good."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
His previous lifespan was around three thousand nine hundred years.
This was due to the support of skills like the Heaven-Transferring Divine Technique, World-Ending Demon Skill, Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, and his own physique!
Now, having increased his lifespan so significantly in one breath was indeed remarkable.
"In this world, even the lifespan of the Ancient Gods is limited.
It doesn’t make sense for Divine Beasts to have infinite lifespans."
Divine Beasts would die.
So how long could someone who consumed their Dragon Essence really live?
To live ten thousand years is already a heavenly blessing!
"Besides the immense vitality, this Dragon Essence also contains an enormous amount of Divine Power."
Ding Ling began to absorb this Divine Power.
As he continued to absorb and refine it.
The War God Spirit Body became more and more condensed and substantial.
It began to shift from an ethereal state to a real one.

But perhaps because the divine nature contained in the Dragon Blood he previously absorbed and refined was also quite extraordinary, the divine nature in this Dragon Essence can only be said to be comparable to that in the Dragon Blood.
Even so, it allowed Ding Ling’s War God Spirit Body to advance further.
Up to now.
The War God Spirit Body could not only hide in his heart but also in his lungs.
If more places became available to hide.
It would become increasingly difficult for others to find it in the future!
"If the entire divine nature and Essence Qi of the Divine Dragon were contained in the Dragon Blood, then perhaps, after I refined the Dragon Blood, this Dragon Essence would have shrunk directly."
Ding Ling placed the drastically reduced Dragon Essence into his Storage Pouch.
The current Dragon Essence had become much less scorching hot.
Only pure Spiritual Vitality remained within.
Ding Ling planned to enter the Otherworldly Space where the Female Drought Demon resided to absorb the power of this Dragon Essence to enhance himself.
Because the limitations of the Mortal Realm were too great.
If he absorbed the Dragon Essence, it likely wouldn’t enhance himself much, only his foundation.
Naturally, Ding Ling hoped to increase his strength more significantly.
Ding Ling looked at the Dragon Scales at the bottom of the lake.
Perhaps due to the loss of Dragon Blood and Dragon Essence.
The remains of the Divine Dragon were shrinking rapidly, and the Dragon Scales were becoming increasingly dim.

"Indeed.
The Divine Power of the Divine Dragon is all concentrated in the Dragon Essence and Dragon Blood."
With the loss of Dragon Essence and Dragon Blood.
The Divine Dragon would completely die and vanish into light.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
In just a short time, the remains of the Divine Dragon indeed transformed into rays of light and disappeared into the seafloor, leaving no trace.
The Dragon Scales remained, but they were like useless debris with no value at all.
Ding Ling shook his head, and with a Shrinking Inches, he swiftly cut through the waves to where the Divine Dragon had once resided.

Because the Female Drought Demon had taught him many Ancient High-Level Arrays.

chapters.title: Chapter 736 - 725: Chiyou’s Memories
paragraphs: Each of Chiyou’s soul fragments exists as an independent entity, without much connection to each other.
If it were otherwise.
He wouldn’t be looking at the Sword Spirit as if he’d seen a ghost.
Most likely, the memories between the soul fragments are not shared.
Only when the soul fragments come into contact and fuse into one do they share memories.
Ding Ling, with the War God Technique at full level, knew this well.
However, he had no intention of dividing his soul.
Once the soul is divided, it becomes difficult to tread the path of the strongest again! Potential would be impaired!
Chiyou divides his soul, most likely because he was suppressed.
Whoosh, whoosh!
Sword Qi engulfed Chiyou like a tide.
His soul fragments continuously shattered and reformed amidst a sizzling sound.

A thought crossed Ding Ling’s mind, and he immediately returned to the surface of Divine Dragon Island, retrieved the Emperor’s Sword, broke open the Sword Realm, and once again arrived at Sword Mountain. He activated the Domain Power of the Domain Crystal, thus enhancing the immeasurable might of the Sword Spirit and taking the opportunity to strip away some of Chiyou’s soul fragment memories.
Chiyou’s memories!
The value is unimaginably high!
Ding Ling was full of anticipation.
Therefore, he chose to kill using thunderous means!

He directly activated the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, the Heaven and Earth Righteous Qi Curse, and the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell. With the blessing of these two spells, the Sword Spirit was like a tiger with wings!
The Ten Thousand Swords Return to the Root seemed to inherently carry the Power of Exorcism!
The demonic power in Chiyou’s soul fragments rapidly vanished and collapsed at a speed visible to the naked eye!
This time, it couldn’t reform.
Chiyou screamed in shock and horror:
"Ah! Who exactly are you? We have no enmity, why do you want to kill me?"
Ding Ling ignored Chiyou.
He had witnessed Chiyou’s tricks before.
He could even make the dead seem alive.
This time, the soul fragment actively invaded his body, definitely intending to seize it.
Ding Ling was extremely disgusted by such actions, where one attempts to seize another’s body without a word!
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling increased his power a bit more.
Sizzle!
The speed at which Chiyou’s soul fragment disintegrated accelerated even more, melting away like snow under the sun in an instant.

He couldn’t believe it, making several attempts to break free, even activating his Divine Form Body, transforming into a monstrous form with three heads, six arms, eight legs, and a human body with bull hooves.
In this Divine Form, his speed, power, and spirit all became stronger.
But it was still useless.
"This, this, this..."
Chiyou trembled:
"It’s the spell of the Great Sun Buddha and the heart technique of the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan! How do you know their techniques!
Ding Ling did not respond.

"You know my Demon Scripture, the War God Technique, and also the techniques of the Great Sun Buddha and Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan! You’re definitely no ordinary person. Who are you? An ancient era Divine Spirit? Or a god from my era?! No no no, if you were from my era, why have I never seen you before?! Who exactly are you?!"
Chiyou roared.
His arms and torso had already been dissolved completely.
Every trace of demonic power was refined and purified.
All his soul power had been converted into nourishment for the Sword Spirit, making its foundations increasingly solid.
His memories also started to be stripped away slowly and orderly by the Sword Spirit.
Chiyou seemed to have sensed this, filled with even more surprise, shock, and fear, finding it hard to believe.
[Acquired E-level Achievement Medal: Intimidating Chiyou.]
[Note: Your methods surpassed Chiyou’s imagination. He racked his brains but couldn’t figure out who you are!]
Previously, he got a D-level from Chiyou.
Now, getting another, it’s an E-level.
However, Chiyou wasn’t a C-level, probably due to him being split and suppressed, his strength and cultivation dropping to Shattering Great Perfection.
If it were otherwise, he would definitely not just be a Shattering Level power.
Sizzle!
Chiyou was quickly completely dissolved.
Even as his mouth and ears dissolved, he was using his mental waves to roar and question Ding Ling, urgently wanting to know the answer.
But Ding Ling, from start to finish, did not respond to him!
Chiyou died with eyes wide open!
"I’ve gained a lot this time."
While what he had just eliminated was only a soul fragment of Chiyou!
But the memories it held were extremely rich and vast!
"Maybe it’s all the memories before the main soul fragment, but that benefits me."
Ding Ling smiled slightly.
How strong is Chiyou’s main body?
He’s an Ancient Great God who could stand against the Master of the Celestial Realm, almost defeating the Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan!
The main body is immortal.
Ordinary gods can’t kill him!
He’s versed in all kinds of strange and sudden body snatching methods.

When Ding Ling first encountered Chiyou, he almost got body-snatched by him. Back then, Ding Ling didn’t know the Spirit Killing Sword or have the protection of the Sword Spirit, his means of defeating enemies with spirit were limited.
Fortunately, the library displayed its power, smiting Chiyou, or else he might have died that time.
Thus, Ding Ling was well aware of this Great God’s methods.
Browsing through a small part of Chiyou’s memories now, Ding Ling was immensely astonished.
Just because the small part of memories stripped away by the Sword Spirit were all the Techniques and Laws Chiyou knew.
Just the skills alone numbered tens of thousands, hundreds of thousands!
Laws also numbered over ten thousand, even hundreds of thousands!
Due to the immense knowledge points occupied by these Techniques and Laws,

even the Sword Spirit couldn’t continue to strip away other knowledge points, otherwise it could easily be overwhelmed by this ’vast’ and ’surging’ power, leading to mental chaos and, consequently, memory confusion or loss.
If the Sword Spirit goes insane, it would be the same as Ding Ling going insane.
This, acting within one’s limits, is very necessary.
’Getting too full’ is something to be avoided.
’Exploding’ even more so, something not to be considered!
[Charging Skill at full level]
[Array-Trap Skill at full level]
[Armor Breaking Skill at full level]
[Array Breaking Skill at full level]
[Thunder Drumming Skill at full level]
[Great Storm Skill at full level]
[Earth-Splitting Technique at full level]
[Kuafu Chasing the Sun Art at full level]
Dense and numerous.
Ding Ling’s eyes were dazzled.
Fortunately, he was overpowered.
As long as he glanced once, he could instantly reach full level, turning these Techniques and Laws into instinct, engrained in his bones and soul.
Thus.
The change was visible to the naked eye.
Ding Ling’s aura grew more and more aggressive, powerful, fierce!
His entire foundation became increasingly profound.
Standing there, like a boundless giant mountain;
Or akin to a colossal ancient beast!
This was caused by the Techniques and Laws of Chiyou.
The aura of the newly mastered Techniques would almost uncontrollably leak out of the body surface.
While within a few breaths, Ding Ling had dozens of Techniques at full level.
After a quarter of an hour.
Thousands of Techniques reached full level.
After another span of time.
Tens of thousands, even hundreds of thousands of Techniques at full level.
So, the various auras on his body emitted, exploded, and these techniques were vicious, fierce, ruthless, and bloodthirsty.
This made Ding Ling appear more and more terrifying!
Eventually.
Just standing there, he seemed like a fierce god capable of devouring the sun and moon!
Countless living spirits within the Sword Realm trembled!
Each one stared in shock towards Ding Ling’s direction, either trembling, prostrating, or directly turning and fleeing.

chapters.title: Chapter 737 - 726: The Furnace
paragraphs: Ding Ling’s aura continued to grow stronger.
Since the memory with the Sword Spirit was shared.
Thus.
Ding Ling instantly comprehended whatever the Sword Spirit had seen in his memory.
Therefore, his skill and technique reached full level rapidly!
While others need time for explanation and practice.
By extracting others’ memories, he could immediately grasp all the key information and knowledge.
In an instant, Ding Ling could understand, perceive, and masterfully reach full level!
Woosh woosh!

Where Ding Ling stood, whirlwinds stirred up. The storms were earth-shattering and connected to the heavens, carrying an aura of profundity, ferocity, terror, and darkness, akin to an unparalleled fiend about to awaken. The entire Sword Realm trembled in this power.
Zhang Sanfeng awoke from his epiphany and looked afar, his face full of shock:
"Who is that? Such an aura, it’s terrifying! Could it be a Demon God?"
Thinking that the deceased The Smiling, Proud Wanderer was already incredibly powerful.
Yet now, this aura was hundreds of times stronger than The Smiling, Proud Wanderer!
"This, this, this..."
Zhang Sanfeng’s body trembled slightly, hard to tell if it was fear or helplessness. For Zhang Sanfeng, a Grandmaster, to react this way, showed how intensely his inner feelings surged:
"The world is truly plagued with disasters. I am still too weak!"
He originally thought his Tai Chi Sword Intent, enhanced by the special environment here, had become very strong.
He felt satisfied.
Then, this sudden vast aura hit him like a thunderbolt from the abyss.
Zhang Sanfeng’s body stiffened, feeling anxious:
’Where is Ding Ling now? If he were here, how would he deal with the current situation?’
Zhang Sanfeng took a deep breath, and his eyes suddenly became determined:
"Even if it means death. I will not back down! What must be faced, has to be faced!"
He rose and prepared to see who the owner of this ominous aura was.
However, as soon as he sparked this thought.
In the next moment.
The tornado vanished without a trace, and even the aura was suddenly gone.
"Where did it go?"
Zhang Sanfeng was puzzled:
"Could it have been like Ding Ling, who broke the Sword Realm and left?"
Zhang Sanfeng had received a lot of supplies from Ding Ling.
Yet Ding Ling had come to the Sword Realm several times, asking him if he wanted to leave.
After learning the method of breaking the realm, Zhang Sanfeng desired to break the Sword Realm space himself and leave autonomously. It was both pressure and motivation.
Thus, he only accepted Ding Ling’s help in supplies.
"Seems I must speed up my cultivation."

Now, the progress of his Martial Arts Melting Furnace had reached 100%.
Chiyou’s techniques and skills were too powerful and numerous.
Instantly increased by 17 percentage points.
Pulling progress up to 100%.
With the three legs reaching 100%, the entire Martial Arts Melting Furnace became tangible and resplendent.
Numerous rays of light poured from the bookshelf into the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
This was the law and techniques Ding Ling learned over several worlds.

Iron Sand Palm, Cloud Strike Saber Technique, Dawn Swordsmanship, Sunset Swordsmanship, Gale Spear Technique, Howling Moon Posture, Double Extreme Arrow Skill, Overlord Halberd Technique, Golden Gate Saber Technique, Five Animals Qigong, Inner Scripture, Pulse Diagnosis Technique, Human Emperor Swordsmanship, Sleeve Arrow, Shadow Arrow Skill, Ghost Prison Spear Technique, Calm Wind Swordsmanship, Warm Jade Swordsmanship, Moon Shadow Swordsmanship, Stargazing Skill, Observing People Skill...
In The Smiling, Proud Wanderer World:

Middle Yuan Nine-section Skill, Pine Wind Swordsmanship, Exorcism Sword Manual Internal Power Heart Method, Hundred and Eight Flipping Heaven Palm, Ten Thousand Miles Solo Lightness Skill, Absorption Technique, Seven-string Invisible Sword, Seven Extremes Sword, Profound Celestial Finger Technique, Star Absorption Technique, Cold Ice True Skill, Nine Heavens Thunder Hammer Technique, Dugu Nine Swords, Tai Chi Scripture...
In the Divine Eagle World:
Quanzhen Swordsmanship, Nine Yin Scripture, Eighteen Dragon Subduing Palms, Dog Beating Stick Technique, Ghost Realm’s Howling Wind...
In the Celestial Dragon World:
Star Shifting, Canhe Finger, Turtle Breath Skill, White Rainbow Palm Force, Celestial Mountain Six Yang Palm, Eternal Youth Technique...
In the Wind and Cloud World:

Hero King Swordsmanship, Hero King Heart Method, Roar God Manual, Holy Spirit Swordsmanship, Demon Scripture, War God Technique, Proud Cold Six Formulas, Ten Strong Martial Dao, Wind God Leg, Mother and Child Dragon and Phoenix Rings, Profound Nether Divine Palm, Mysterious Swordsmanship, Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, Treasure Pearl Lotus Curse, Heaven and Earth Righteous Qi Curse, Inner Canon of Huangdi...
All the skills and techniques were fused into the Martial Arts Melting Furnace, continually refining and elevating.
A mysterious aura began to emerge from the furnace.
"The Divine Skill, forged from all skills and techniques, is about to be born."
Ding Ling felt joy.
He had learned too many skills and techniques.
Countless, numbering in millions or tens of millions.
Calling him a walking Human Martial Arsenal was no exaggeration.
"Looks like it’ll take two or three days to forge a technique."
Ding Ling carefully perceived and comprehended.

There were so many full-level techniques and skills, and this Martial Arts Melting Furnace would refine all techniques and skills without waste, distilling the essence into a new Martial Arts Secret Manual!
This manual, undoubtedly, will surpass the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit Realm!
It might help Ding Ling directly attain the Martial Arts Immortal!
"Even a thread of essence from the Third-class Technique Iron Sand Palm was extracted."
Ding Ling observed meticulously, comprehending clearly:

"Plus, the Confucian Dao Realm of Kongmen Fist, the cunning of Cai Family Fist, the swift fierceness of Hundred Birds Phoenix Spear Technique, the supreme sharpness of Sword God Breathing Technique, the benevolent peace of Medicine King Breathing Technique... all extracted and refined!"
Not a single skill or technique was left unused!
All are useful skills and techniques!
Sometimes, an idea from a Third-class Martial Art can exceed those in a First-class Martial Arts Secret Manual.
The more Ding Ling sensed, the more he sighed:
"Fortunately, I ’cheated’ and read every manual I could in every world. Otherwise, I’d miss out on many good things."
What may seem like a modest Third-class Manual.
Often a marvelous idea might give birth to an incredible aura in Ding Ling’s Divine Skill.
And Ding Ling knew so many martial arts.
It’s foreseeable.
A Divine Skill, amalgamating countless Fist Intent, Sword Intent, Saber Intent, along with ideas and essence from various Third-class Martial Arts, will be unimaginably powerful.
"Let’s check again in a few days."
Ding Ling looked at the coffin beside him and opened it.
True enough.
Inside were Chiyou’s hands and legs!

Ding Ling grasped the hands from the void, spewing vigorous qi from his palms, as Chiyou’s hands began to crack bit by bit, the demon qi surging out was swiftly absorbed and refined by Ding Ling, leaving the hands no chance to regenerate.
Before long.
They turned to ashes and scattered away.
"Indeed, hands without the War God Spirit Body, once the demon qi is refined, are no longer immortal."

Thus.
Ding Ling instantly comprehended whatever the Sword Spirit had seen in his memory.
Therefore, his skill and technique reached full level rapidly!
While others need time for explanation and practice.
By extracting others’ memories, he could immediately grasp all the key information and knowledge.

Woosh woosh!

The entire Sword Realm trembled in this power.

Such an aura, it’s terrifying!
Could it be a Demon God?"

What must be faced, has to be faced!"

In the next moment.

chapters.title: Chapter 738 - 727: Gu Skill
paragraphs: Ding Ling cast the same spell on Chiyou’s legs.
In an instant, they were broken and destroyed.
"With this, even if Chiyou is resurrected, he will be a person without hands and feet. The likelihood of him being a scourge to the world has greatly diminished."
Ding Ling looked at the two dragon eggs.
He stepped forward and placed his hand on the eggshell.
Activating the Demon Scripture and the Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, he absorbed and purified the demon qi.
The Xuanyuan Heart Scripture and the War God Technique absorbed and refined the power of divinity.
Whoosh!
The surging divine power was absorbed by the War God Spirit Body.
The War God Spirit Body visibly solidified by thirty percent.
It could transfer from the lungs to the liver.
Ding Ling then absorbed the divinity of the other dragon egg.
This time, the War God Spirit Body solidified by another twenty percent, allowing a transfer to the kidneys.
"It’s time to go."
The remaining energy of the dragon eggs was immensely vast.
Enough to instantly create a Shattering Level expert.
Ding Ling planned to save refining of the dragon eggs for when he returned to the Otherworldly Space.
So he took the dragon eggs back to the surface of Divine Dragon Island and had Nie Feng, Lü Bu, Bu Jingyun, and their group escort the two dragon eggs back to Luoyang.
He himself prepared to suppress other locations of Chiyou’s bodies.
Wherever Chiyou was suppressed, there had to be a divine object.
Ding Ling thought of taking the divine objects along after suppressing Chiyou’s body parts.

Lü Bu, Nie Feng, and Bu Jingyun, however, did not know the details, looking at Ding Ling traveling back and forth between Divine Dragon Island and the Sword Realm. Despite being tongue-tied, they secretly felt admiration.
Especially when Ding Ling had walked out of the Sword Realm not long ago. That world-shaking and ferocious aura scared and shocked even Lü Bu:
"Your Majesty is getting stronger and stronger. I really don’t know what he has been through during this time. How can there be such strange changes happening to him?!"
"Indeed."
Nie Feng watched Ding Ling’s departing figure with a face full of admiration:
"The legendary Divine Dragon was easily killed by Your Majesty! Not even a splash was made. We didn’t have any chance to intervene; we could only watch!"
"Where is Your Majesty going?"
Bu Jingyun looked at the two gigantic dragon eggs beside him:
"And this egg, isn’t it a bit too enormous?!"
"Your Majesty said they are Divine Dragon Eggs. It’s normal for Divine Dragon Eggs to be this large. After all, they are ancient auspicious beasts."
A day later,
Ding Ling arrived at Lingyun Cave.
He had already gone to suppress Chiyou’s head.
This head was suppressed in the vast mountains of the Southern Border.
Because of this head, the ten thousand mountains were shrouded in miasma all year, infested with poisons, and layered with illusions.
A thousand miles without human habitation, birds, and beasts too were often absent.
This place was such a description.
Only poisonous creatures could survive here.
Ding Ling delved into this mountain and found Chiyou’s head in the belly of the highest peak, and once again, a soul fragment entered his body.
Clearly,
Chiyou’s possession of others had almost become instinctual.
And Ding Ling dealt with this soul fragment as before, obtaining many new techniques and laws.
[Miaojiang Gu Technique Full Level]
[Hundred Poison Gu Technique Full Level]
All these were self-created techniques and laws from this Chiyou soul fragment over thousands of years using the unique illusion realm here.
Just a soul fragment was so remarkable.
The wisdom, comprehension, and talent of this person were evident.
And these full-level Gu techniques transformed into streams of light and entered the Martial Arts Melting Furnace, becoming nutrition.
As for the divine object?
Quite regrettably,
The ten thousand mountains were the ’divine object!’
This place was originally blessed with talent and resources. It had an innate earth vein, and this earth vein combined with the ten thousand mountains could perfectly suppress Chiyou.
But Chiyou was indeed remarkable.
For thousands of years,
Not only had he polluted this region,
He had also secretly spread the Miaojiang Gu Technique, nurturing one Gu Dao expert after another!
These experts went to the Ten Directions Realm, captured poisonous creatures, and cultivated the King of Ten Thousand Poisons, engaging in magical battles with others!
The more the poisonous creatures,
The denser the miasma in the ten thousand mountains became.
The degree to which the earth vein was corroded would increase. Given time, when the earth vein was completely corroded, it would be the time when Chiyou’s head would escape its confinement.
"The inventor of the Miaojiang Gu Technique in this world is actually Chiyou, this Demon God."
Ding Ling sighed.
The bizarre changes of the world go no further than this.
And the decay of Chiyou’s head directly led to the miasma of the ten thousand mountains beginning to dramatically reduce!
If nothing unexpected happens,
In several decades to a hundred years,
The ten thousand mountains would return to a flourishing era of lush mountains and clear waters, filled with treasures and resources.
"The Gu Technique may gradually become a trivial technique as the miasma and poison disperse."
Ding Ling shook his head and did not think much about it.
Gu Technique is a crooked way.
Some Gu nurturers fuse with the Gu; some even feed the Gu with their entire essence, even merging their souls with the Gu...
Practicing martial arts and skills is about refining oneself.
But Gu Technique is about nurturing the Gu, achieving the Gu.
Isn’t this a crooked way?!
Tap, tap!
Ding Ling no longer pondered, preparing to go suppress the last part of Chiyou’s body and then take the few Qilin Eggs.
The weight of the Qilin Egg is not trivial; if its divinity could be absorbed for personal use,
imagine,
the War God Spirit Body would certainly transform to a state of being able to go anywhere.
When that time comes,
no one would know where Ding Ling’s vulnerability lies.
Just because they couldn’t kill the War God Spirit Body, Ding Ling wouldn’t die. If by then Ding Ling transferred the War God Spirit Body to the soles of his feet, who could imagine it?!
Tap, tap!
Ding Ling walked increasingly quickly,
following the map,
and soon,
he stepped into the cave where the Fire Qilin resided.
Looking around,
the environment was unchanged.
"Roughly counting, it’s almost been a year since I’ve been here. Time flies."
Ding Ling appeared slightly dazed, but quickly suppressed his strange emotions, walking to the magma pool.
He slightly lowered his head.
What he saw,
half red fire, half black fire, swirling in a Tai Chi pattern.
The scene was the same as before.
Ding Ling didn’t hesitate further, jumping straight in.
But in the next instant,
he saw two blades chopping towards him.
In the faint,
it seemed as if he could hear someone roaring:
"Ten Tribulations of the Evil King!"
A blade light flashed and vanished within the magma.
The next instant,
it seemed as though chaotic visions of a turbulent sea of bitterness and shifting yin and yang flashed rapidly before his eyes!

Ding Ling slightly frowned, the Sword Qi of the Profound Yin Sword Armor revolving around him, transforming into gyroscope-like Sword Qi, continuously obliterating the surging attacks of bitterness, Tai Chi, and gods and demons patterns.
He kept his keen eyes fixed ahead.
Even deep within the magma, his vision remained extremely impressive.
He clearly saw the two people attacking him.
One was tall and robust with a fiercely dominating aura;
The other had short hair and short beard, a benevolent face, but was presently an elder full of ferocity;
"Xiaao Sanxiaao, Wu Wudi."
Ding Ling had once obtained part of the Water Race Leader’s memory pictures.
They contained portraits of these two people.
So, with one glance, Ding Ling knew who was attacking him.
"Quite right."
Xiaao Sanxiaao’s eyes flashed with a hint of shock, but his face wasn’t faint-hearted, he angrily said:
"Ding Ling, you killed my beloved son, usurped beings for your selfish desire, committing countless murders, you’re the great demon of this era. You deserve ten thousand deaths!"
