chapters.title: Chapter 739 - 728: Celestial Destiny Saber
paragraphs: Ding Ling frowned and involuntarily looked at Wu Wudi:
"I wonder what you think, Wu Wudi?"
He received the legacy of Wu Wudi, after all, there was some fate between the two.
Becoming enemies and fighting without reason was not Ding Ling’s wish.
"Ding Ling, if you persist in your folly, then be prepared to decay."
Wu Wudi held a sharp and heavy Golden Saber!
He looked at Ding Ling with sharp eyes, his words were firm and powerful:
"I stand with Elder Xiaao! To vanquish you, the great demon, we have expended countless efforts and set up this situation long ago; you are doomed!"
"It seems there’s no possibility of us being friends."
Ding Ling sighed, feeling regret:
"Since that’s the case, then there’s no choice but to send you to your death."
Clang!
Clang, clang, clang!

Spiral Sword Qi shot out from within the Profound Yin Sword Armor, instantly amplifying tenfold, becoming fiercely terrifying to the extreme, seemingly containing an unrivaled ferocity capable of breaking through all formations and overcoming all obstacles!
Boom! The Spiral Sword Qi spun like a top, stirring up streams of magma, transforming into Fire Sword Qi! This Sword Qi exuded even greater ferocity and dominance!
Once unleashed, it was like a waterfall descending from the galaxy above to shatter and level everything!
"What a powerful move!"
Wu Wudi and Xiaao Sanxiaao’s pupils contracted, their hearts shaken.
From Ding Ling easily blocking a move from the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King earlier, they were mentally prepared!
Yet now, facing this actively unleashed offensive from Ding Ling.
Their hearts instantly clenched, feeling an undeniable sensation that blocking it would undoubtedly lead to obliteration!
"How is this possible?!"
"Even combined, we still feel this way!"

"Could Ding Ling’s move be a combination of various Supreme Techniques? If not, why does a feeling of imminent destruction linger despite us having cultivated the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King and Black Tortoise True Skill?"
The Ten Tribulations of the Evil King were gained with the help of an Alien.
Top-tier fierce weapon, Great Evil King, undoubtedly so.
"It seems we must draw him into that world!"
Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi shouted simultaneously.
Executing a legendary technique!
One unleashed the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King - Four Failures All Void!
The other wielded the familial Treasure Saber, the Celestial Destiny Saber, using the No-Two Blade Technique - Clouds Breaking Through the Blue Sky!
Both struck with lightning speed.

In the sky, a righteous and a wicked unrivaled saber light merged into one. Upon its descent, rumbling explosions began, as the conflicting Yin and Yang attributes forcefully combined, erupting with supreme and terrifying power!
This power could easily destroy a small mountain.
But when collided with Ding Ling’s Spiral Sword Qi, it was swiftly dismantled.
"Not good!"
Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi didn’t hesitate any longer, immediately taking action:
"Enter!"
With their two sabers aimed at Ding Ling.
Striking with an extremely subtle blow.
In the next instant.
All three stood frozen in place, motionless.
Only the activated Protective Gang Qi shield was swirling, guarding their bodies from being washed away and burned by the magma.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling seemed to traverse through time and space, seeing his past self.
Yet before he could observe closely, he inexplicably sensed a deadly crisis approaching him; it was the Supreme Sword Dao’s Nameless Dao frantically alerting him!
He dared not delay, and with a clear shout, the Soul Returning Skill from the Demon Scripture surged through him.
Instantly awakening him from a state of spirit loss.
What met his eyes were two sharp blades capable of shattering the heavens and earth.
"He’s awake!"
Xiaao Sanxiaao was even more shocked. In his meticulous setup of the Soul-Stealing Skill to lure Ding Ling, he even enlisted Wu Wudi’s help against Ding Ling, unexpectedly failing again!
"Attack quickly!"
Their Divine Weapons accelerated towards Ding Ling!

One stabbing unleashed chaos all around, space oscillated, and the aura of Reincarnation coalesced into a halo, seemingly encompassing Ding Ling, dragging him into Reincarnation, leading to ultimate extinction;
One stab’s blade light exploded, as if to annihilate the entire firmament.
Such was their gathering in mid-air.
Further inciting a storm in heaven and earth, amidst rumbling thunderous sounds, as if Heaven itself was enraged, determined to bury everything!
Ding Ling didn’t even bother to lift his brow, merely shifted his thought!
Supreme Sword Dao!
Heartless Dao!
Demon Scripture!
Chaotic Soul Skill!
In an instant, two Skills were executed, transforming into a Sword Qi capable of inverting Yin and Yang and plunging everything into chaos, piercing towards the blade light!
Crunch!
Rumble!
This Sword Qi, heartless and indifferent, shapeless, traceless, and formless, empowered by the Chaotic Soul Skill, was sufficient to disrupt any spirit and annihilate everything!
Under the enhancement of Ding Ling’s First-Grade Golden Core’s Spiritual Realm.
This Spirit Killing Sword was enough to crush.
In a mere moment, the twin blade lights were shattered, and within the void, in one turn, pierced through the soul bodies of Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi.
Their brows throbbed with severe pain, and they couldn’t help but let out a scream, ready to be expelled from this strange space in the next instant.
Ding Ling slightly raised his brow, his hand forming a ’Soul-Breaking Claw’, grasping forward.
Snap!
Snap!
Two crisp sounds.
Like an eagle catching chicks.
The soul bodies of Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi were effortlessly seized by the Soul-Breaking Claw, brought before Ding Ling.
Ding Ling squeezed their necks, the sound of crunching echoes.
"Spirit Bodies, huh?"
Ding Ling ignored their contorted and painful faces.
Instead, he snatched the two sabers from their hands.
Carefully comprehending them.
"Indeed, Celestial Destiny Saber and Great Evil King!"
Both weapons were the finest treasures.
Without exception.
Surpassing the quality of the Unparalleled Sword.
Though the Unparalleled Sword was forged with the Nuwa Stone, in this respect, these two weapons couldn’t compare.

However, in the original storyline, the Great Evil King required the Unparalleled Sword, Silence-breaking Saber, Sword of Defeat, and Celestial Sin—the four great fierce artifacts—to lead its resurgence in the Jianghu as a top-tier evil weapon!

The material for crafting this saber must undoubtedly be extraordinary; Ding Ling’s Artifact Identification Skill and Casting Skill were at full level, and a simple perception revealed the saber’s material originated from ancient ’Heart of Evil Demon!’ ’Evil Demon Iron!’
The Heart of Evil Demon was the essence transformed after the death of a Demon Lord level expert in the Demon Realm!
The Evil Demon Iron was the most sinister refined iron of the Demon Realm!
The fusion of these two substances.
Achieved the Great Evil King! Naturally, some top-tier balancing substances were added, but compared to these two, they were insignificant.
"This Great Evil King possesses spirit yet does not perish. It seems that ancient Demon Lord hasn’t truly perished."
Ding Ling saw through the sword’s interior at a glance, about to use the Spirit Killing Sword to subdue the sword’s spirit!
He didn’t need such uncontrollable sword spirits.

Unexpectedly, as soon as this thought emerged, the Great Evil King began to tremble frantically, with a sharp saber light bursting from the tip, sweeping wildly, as if wanting to cut open the heavens and obliterate Ding Ling.
"Indeed, it holds Spiritual Qi."
Ding Ling coldly laughed:

"The Demon Lord does not die. It’s no wonder barely anyone can truly master this saber in the world. Those who allegedly mastered it, it’s merely because the Demon Lord wished them to. The true owner of this saber is none other than the Demon Lord."

chapters.title: Chapter 740 - 729: Nine Void Realm
paragraphs: The more wicked someone is, the faster the Demon Lord inside the Great Evil King restores when they become its master.
Given enough time.
The Demon Lord’s rebirth isn’t impossible.
As for how Xiaao Sanxiaao became the holder of the Great Evil King, Ding Ling doesn’t care. He must now fully subdue this Great Evil King.
Therefore, he squeezed hard with the Soul-Breaking Claw.
Crack!
Crack!
Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi’s necks were immediately snapped!
As he tossed their soul bodies into the void, the Soul-Breaking Claw tore them apart!
Their soul bodies were completely shattered.
Their soul bodies crumbled.
There was no chance for their survival.
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Xiaao Sanxiaao.]
[Obtained D-level Achievement Medal: Intimidated Wu Wudi.]

[Note: The two schemed to kill you. They plotted for a long time, even teaming up with the Mud Bodhisattva to predict the future, accurately calculating that you would once again step into the magma pool of Lingyun Cave at a specific time. They waited patiently, ready to deliver a fatal strike. However, multiple ambushes failed! They died in shock, disbelief, and not at peace upon their deaths!] The prompt sound made Ding Ling feel somewhat relieved.
He was puzzled.
How did these two know he would go to Lingyun Cave?
And stood watch so precisely at the magma pool? Since it was the Mud Bodhisattva who leaked it, it’s no longer surprising.
Yet the Mud Bodhisattva divulged such a Celestial Secret.
He probably won’t last long.
The power of Celestial Punishment penetrates the bones and soul. Can the Mud Bodhisattva withstand the backlash for revealing Ding Ling’s secret without going mad?
Ding Ling stopped worrying about this and started to focus all his efforts on subduing the Great Evil King.
To this end, he even used the Celestial Destiny Saber to draw the Sword Spirit from Lingyun Cave.
At this point.
Ding Ling became aware of where he was.
Unexpectedly.
It should be the ’Nine Void Realm’.
This world requires either the ’Great Evil King’ or the ’Celestial Destiny Saber’ as a key to open.

Now that Ding Ling possesses both weapons and his strength far exceeds the First-Grade Golden Core Cultivation of the mortal world, with a mere thought, he can easily wield the Divine Weapon to break through the world’s boundary.
This time, the Sword Spirit charged into the Nine Void Realm from his body.
Ding Ling could clearly see the fate of Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi in the Lingyun Cave magma pool.
After their Spirit Bodies were destroyed, they became living dead.
Their bodies continued to float up and down in the magma pool.
The Protective Gang Qi still shielded them, making them appear intact.
Ding Ling cast a glance and did not dwell on it.
Instead, he entered the Sword Spirit.
The next moment.
The Sword Spirit surged into the internal space of the Great Evil King, carrying a torrent of densely packed Spirit Killing Swords.
Bang!

With a magnified power of ten times, the Sword Spirit wielded the Supreme Sword Dao, like the Sword God descending upon the world. In one strike, a trace of the Demon Lord’s remnant soul hidden in the internal space crumbled instantly.
The scattered stream of consciousness churned incessantly in the Great Evil King’s internal space.
The Sword Spirit grasped it, comprehending.
After a short time.
[Evil King Ten Tribulations Full Level]
"Such a powerful Evil Blade Technique."
Ding Ling shivered slightly.
The Evil King Ten Tribulations is indeed a technique at the Primordial Spirit Level!
"Yet Xiaao Sanxiaao’s Evil King Ten Tribulations felt just so-so. It seems he never attained the essence of the Evil King Ten Tribulations!"
The essence of the Evil King Ten Tribulations is all in the Demon Lord’s stream of consciousness!
Unless the Demon Lord fully imparts it to the wielder.
Otherwise, the wielder can never truly grasp the Evil King Ten Tribulations!
And the Demon Lord merely seeks to exploit the wielder to gather demon and evil energies to resurrect himself!
There’s no way he truly intends to treat the wielder sincerely.
"A demon is a demon."
Ding Ling carefully contemplated the Evil King Ten Tribulations:
"But this saber technique is indeed domineering and unparalleled, surpassing the No-Two Blade Technique by far."
This saber technique consists of ten moves.
Each move is incredibly powerful, slicing out at will could cleave the heavens and rend the earth! Truly immeasurable!
Moreover, given that Ding Ling has reached full level in this Sword Skill.
He could perform it with just his hands.
Simply because his body is already the War God Physique, immortal, even his hand blade can unleash the Earth-shaking power of the Evil King Ten Tribulations.
Of course, using the Human Emperor Saber to perform the Evil King Ten Tribulations would certainly be better.
As for the Great Evil King?
"The material of this blade is too wicked. I’ll find a chance to destroy it completely, or fuse it and the Celestial Destiny Saber into my Human Emperor Saber!"
The Human Emperor Saber is already at its most powerful.
If it fuses with the Celestial Destiny Saber and the Great Evil King, it would surely be invincible.
Being the world’s number one full-level blade forger, Ding Ling at the current First-Grade Golden Core Realm, will definitely forge an even stronger saber!
"I’ll deal with it after I return."
Ding Ling strapped the Great Evil King to his back, holding the Celestial Destiny Saber, he glanced at the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
Because the Evil King Ten Tribulations reached full level just now.

The Secret Manual of the Evil King Ten Tribulations immediately transformed into a stream of light and entered the Martial Arts Melting Furnace. Needless to say, with the nutrients of the Evil King Ten Tribulations, the melted Secret Manual is bound to be stronger!
"I seemed to see myself earlier?"

Ding Ling took a step forward, the Great Evil King on his back shone brilliantly, the Celestial Destiny Saber in his hand emitted a dazzling light, as Ding Ling stepped on a certain point, in the next instant.
Ding Ling seemed to have traversed through time and space, arriving at a new world.
A vast forest lay before his eyes.
He saw ’Ding Ling’ lying on the ground.
Beside ’Ding Ling’, two Ferghana Horses guarded him.
"What a strange feeling."
He saw himself.
Yet he couldn’t touch himself.
But there was no doubt that he could clearly perceive it.
But obviously, the other ’Ding Ling’ lying on the ground was unaware of his existence.
"Roar!"
A tiger roared in the forest.
Ding Ling turned his gaze.
Sure enough, a fierce tiger came rushing from one side.
Not far behind it, another fierce tiger sat crouching, vigilantly eyeing ’Ding Ling’ and the Ferghana Horses.
"Two tigers?"
"It doesn’t quite match the scene in my memory."
While hesitating.

One of the tigers was already fighting fiercely with a Ferghana Horse, the horse was no match, blood flowed profusely, yet it showed no intent to retreat, stubbornly guarding ’Ding Ling’, not yielding an inch.
"Roar!"
The other tiger saw this, also leaped forward, intending to bite the Ferghana Horses, upon seeing this, Ding Ling frowned, flicked a finger!
Evil King Ten Tribulations!
Four Defeats, All Void!
As this move erupted, a bone-chilling Sword Intent seemed to penetrate through time and space, clanging, descending upon the tiger. In an instant, it completely ground the tiger’s body to nothing.
Its flesh, remains, and spirit were all ground to a fine powder, seemingly vanished completely.
Ding Ling shivered slightly, his pupils dilated a bit.
"What a terrifying Evil King Ten Tribulations! Truly the essence of the Demon Lord’s life’s learning, truly a technique at the Primordial Spirit level, both powerful and sinister and ruthless!"
The righteous Techniques would leave a margin.
This technique, truly kills to the fullest!
Leaves not a trace of life!

chapters.title: Chapter 741 - 730: Twenty-Third Sword vs. Ten Tribulations of the Evil King
paragraphs: The second tiger died silently, without even a scream from beginning to end.
Only the two Ferghana Horses facing the tiger seemed to sense something, whinnying in fear.
Yet, the tiger attacking the Ferghana Horse remained oblivious, possibly thinking it had intimidated the Ferghana Horse, and intensified its attack.
"Hmm."
Ding Ling suddenly felt a strong force of tearing and rejection.
"Is it because I intervened, and now this space-time and the Heavenly Dao are rejecting me?"
If he intervened again.
Ding Ling would likely face Celestial Punishment.
He thought for a moment and just pointed at the position of ’Ding Ling’ again.
Clang!
Clang clang clang!
The sound of swords ringing pierced the ears of ’Ding Ling’!

’Ding Ling’ lying on the ground was struck by a thunderbolt, instantly opening his eyes. He surveyed his surroundings, suddenly reached out to point at the tiger, and a ray of Six Meridian Sword Qi shot out, striking the tiger’s heart!
The tiger fell instantly dead on the ground.
"Such a familiar feeling."
A cycle of reincarnation.
Ding Ling gave ’Ding Ling’ a deep look, then stopped resisting the pull and rejection of space-time, leaping upward as if bouncing out of this space-time, headed to another space-time realm.
In his thoughts.
He always wanted to learn the Twenty-Third Sword.
Therefore.
In the realm he stepped into.
He saw an elderly man with sharp eyes and a tall, upright stature, his hair white.
He sat on a stump, looking spirited and full-faced, yet the vitality in his body visibly decreasing, Ding Ling knew he wouldn’t live much longer.
But despite the rapid decrease in vitality, another soul-stirring Sword Qi on him was changing at an extremely fast pace, becoming stronger, ethereal, and unfathomable.
Suddenly, pong!
The old man seemed to see Ding Ling, and thrust a sword toward Ding Ling.
Once this sword was unleashed.
Time and space seemed to be locked!
With Heaven and Earth Destruction, it seemed capable of destroying the soul, mercilessly stabbing toward Ding Ling.
Crack crack!
The membranes of time and space were crackling under the stab of this sword!
A halo fluctuated around Ding Ling, unharmed by the aftershocks of the sword!
"Remarkable young man! I’ve been waiting for you for a long time!
After the old man’s exclamation, his face suddenly turned solemn:
"You truly deserve to die. You killed the successor of my Unrivaled City. With no choice, I must kill you!"
"You can see me?!"
Ding Ling was very surprised!
This was a conversation across time and space!
Even ’Ding Ling’ couldn’t see him, yet the old man could see him! Moreover, he made a precise strike, this was truly extraordinary!
"I’m almost dead. I’ve already felt the Sword Heart Hell calling me! In such a strange state, how could I not see you?"
The old man looked up at Ding Ling:
"This next sword of mine, you absolutely can’t block! We’ll settle our scores, and with your death, our grudges will be resolved!"
With the last of his words!
Boom!
Sword Qi shot out from the old man’s body, stabbing toward Ding Ling with greater speed and density!

The next moment, the old man’s soul stepped out, strolling in the void, his whole being shining with a white light that soared to the sky, resembling a Saint from the Immortal Realm, embodying an indescribable supreme ease and transcendence!
A Sword Qi Barrier condensed around him!
Within it, everything paused as Sword Qi danced around him!
This move, upon execution, seemed capable of destroying everything.
"Twenty-Third Sword. You are the Dugu Sword Saint!"
Ding Ling realized.
He was curious about who could possess such methods.
Yet, that Dugu Sword Saint knew it was he who killed Dugu Ming, apparently someone had informed him.
No matter how.
Since it was destined to be enemies.
Ding Ling felt no need to hold back, as he flipped his palm down in a chopping motion!
Ten Tribulations of the Evil King!
Evil across the world, everything returns to emptiness!
With this move, a decaying, evil, chilling, and empty aura condensed, cleaving through space-time with fierce Sword Intent, shrouding the Twenty-Third Sword.
Boom!
Rumble!
Two unparalleled forces clashed and collided in the void.
One could freeze everything, annihilate all with Sword Intent Space! Within this space, Dugu Sword Saint was the invincible Sword God, able to crush opponents with ease;
The other could destroy everything, collapse the world with Absolute Destruction Sword Intent Space!
The two spaces clashed fiercely in the void for only a moment!
Boom!

The Sword Intent Space was crushed by the Sword Intent Space with absolute superiority, falling onto the soul body of Dugu Sword Saint like a mountain, then pierced through him and landed on Dugu Sword Saint’s body.
Boom!
With a loud bang, Dugu Sword Saint’s soul and body were shattered into nothingness, leaving not even a drop of blood, the entire person dissipating into mist and vanishing completely.
[Achieved D-level Achievement Medal: Overwhelming the Dugu Sword Saint.]

[Annotation: Dugu Sword Saint learned from the Alien and Emperor Shitian Disciple that you were responsible for the death of Dugu Ming and further knew from Mud Bodhisattva that he would meet you here. So he waited for you here. Approaching death, he finally awaited your arrival! He decisively launched what he deemed his most powerful attack.
However, he still lost, defeated utterly.
He was stunned, incredulous. He admired and marveled at your Martial Arts, Cultivation, and Divine Techniques, mixed with anger and shock.
He couldn’t let go and perished unwillingly.]
"How could the Twenty-Third Sword lose?"
In a hazy whisper, Ding Ling seemed to hear the sigh of the Sword Saint.
Ding Ling hadn’t expected the last move of the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King to be so powerful, even more malevolent and terrifying than Four Defeats to Void.
"Even fighting across time and space, it easily shattered the Dugu Sword Saint. The true Ten Tribulations of the Evil King, worthy of being a Primordial Spirit Level skill!"
Ding Ling’s Ten Tribulations of the Evil King was full-level, and a complete version.
Thus he could unleash the true power of the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King.
This was secondary.
Most importantly, Ding Ling was now already a First-grade Golden Core Strongman, even people like the Primordial Spirit Level Limu were easily wiped out by him.
The Dugu Sword Saint was just a Grandmaster who broke through last minute, not even a Shattering Strongman, how could he withstand his absolute strike?
Twenty-Third Sword is very strong.
But it depends on who uses it.
In Ding Ling’s hands, it would undoubtedly become powerful enough to destroy everything.
"The rank difference is too great. If the Dugu Sword Saint’s cultivation were as strong as mine. The outcome of this battle would still be hard to predict."
"It’s just a pity for the Twenty-Third Sword. I ultimately couldn’t learn it."
Ding Ling glanced at the Sword Saint.
The Sword Saint of this world, it was obvious that here he truly comprehended the essence of the Twenty-Third Sword.
Ding Ling wanted to learn the Twenty-Third Sword.
He could only learn it here.
Unfortunately, the Sword Saint is dead!
"But the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King is also very strong. Not being able to learn the Twenty-Third Sword doesn’t matter."
Ding Ling did not ponder further but looked toward another direction.
He remembered that place was the World Association.
"Unexpectedly, after going in circles, I discovered that the Sword Saint was actually killed by me."

chapters.title: Chapter 742 - 731: Fierce Demon
paragraphs: One of the main reasons Ding Ling originally came to the World Association was to find Dugu Sword Saint and learn the Twenty-Third Sword.
But unfortunately.
He searched the four corners of the Earth Realm but couldn’t find any trace of Dugu Sword Saint.
Thinking of it now.
Dugu Sword Saint was completely obliterated into nothingness by his ’Ten Tribulations of the Evil King’, not even leaving a single drop of blood!
If he could find him, it would truly be a miracle.
"Didn’t Duann Lang say that Dugu Sword Saint came to the World Association to seek revenge on Xiong Ba?"
"It seems there are some hidden secrets here that even Duann Lang couldn’t uncover."
"Mud Bodhisattva..."
Again, Mud Bodhisattva.
This divine charlatan, does he really enjoy leaking celestial secrets so much?
Ding Ling couldn’t understand.
Wouldn’t it be better to just live well? Why insist on fortune-telling and revealing celestial secrets?
"But since I’ve come to the World Association..."
Ding Ling took a step out, light swirling beneath his feet; in an instant, he traversed thousands of miles with just a step, arriving above the realm of the World Association.
He gazed down at the Lower Realm.
The people of the World Association came and went, bustling like weaving threads.

However, perhaps startled by Ding Ling’s recent battle with the Sword Saint, many of them were shouting, and just as it seemed someone was about to leave, a figure suddenly appeared in the World Association.
Boom!

This person stood tall and imposing, as if both demon and deity, with fists of iron swirling with flames and the power of thunder, appearing as a spinning black flame tornado charging into the crowd, effortlessly burning and piercing through everything in his path.
"Ah!"
Qin Shuang rushed out, only to be shattered by this person’s slap along with several others in the Martial Arts Arena!
From start to finish, Qin Shuang only had time to let out one angry howl before he was completely annihilated.
"So that’s how Qin Shuang died."
Ding Ling held quite a fondness for Qin Shuang, and seeing him die so tragically, he couldn’t help but be enraged.
He shot a glare like lightning:
"But who is this man after all?"
A person he had never seen before.
Clad in black armor, towering a full one Zhang, mighty and fierce like an ancient beast walking out of history.
His appearance was so abrupt, with no warning signs whatsoever.
Once he appeared, he began slaughtering the people of the World Association.
Even if Ding Ling wanted to stop it.
He couldn’t.
Because he had already intervened once in this space-time, and if he acted again, it would be just a sound, without substantial attack, or else he would certainly face celestial punishment.
Thinking of this, Ding Ling pointed towards the rear of the World Association, emitting a clangorous sound, hoping that those who heard this would flee in time.
"Ah!"
"No!"
The screams in the World Association rose one after another.

The fierce demon buried himself in killing, his iron fists occasionally blazing with fire, occasionally encased in lightning, often unleashing a punch that could easily smash through hundreds of people, bodies of hundreds of elite disciples of the World Association shattered, becoming mangled corpses!
The level of slaughter so tragic.
Speaks volumes.
"Who exactly is he?"
Ding Ling wanted a clearer look, so he stepped forward, his feet swirling like stars shifting, arriving in front of the fierce demon in an instant.
Swish!

The fierce demon halted abruptly, slightly raising his head to look at the sky realm, seemingly seeing Ding Ling, a trace of smile appearing on his slightly ferocious face, he suddenly clenched his fist, suddenly punching towards Ding Ling’s face heavily.

This punch, terrifyingly strong, seemed capable of smashing through space-time, causing ripples in the void, small black holes emerging, piercing with the force of this punch, booming towards Ding Ling.
Ding Ling’s pupils contracted, from this black hole he sensed a deadly force capable of shattering spirit and soul.
Thus.
He no longer resisted the pulling force of this space-time, jumped upwards, escaping from this space-time.
Boom!
Behind him, there seemed to be the sound of a sky-shattering explosion, as if each world was collapsing and obliterating under that punch.
"What a terrifying fellow."
Ding Ling slightly furrowed his brow:
"How could this guy suddenly appear in the Human Realm?! And strike such an earth-shattering punch? This doesn’t make sense."
Ding Ling puzzled, but didn’t dwell deeply:
"Seems like I’m still not strong enough. Once I can defeat this person, all problems will naturally be resolved."
Ding Ling chose to return, slicing through the Nine Void Realm with the Celestial Destiny Saber.
In the next instant.
The Sword Spirit returned to its original body.
Hum!
Ding Ling opened his eyes, feeling a strong force boiling in his Dantian.
This was the power of the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King.
He carried the Great Evil King, Celestial Destiny Saber, on his back.
At present.
He now carried four weapons on his back. Three sabers and one sword.
Ding Ling looked at the bodies of Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi not far away, employing Dragon Capturing Skill to seize them into the air.
Carefully sensing.
Both were truly Shattering Level masters.
Xiaao Sanxiaao was even at Shattering Level Great Perfection.
"Unfortunately, their souls were obliterated. Otherwise, I could have dragged them into the Sword Realm to strip their memories, acquiring all their magic and skill."
Although that was the case.
Once Ding Ling left this realm.
He could still use the special methods of the Nine Void Realm, traveling to past space-times, learning from these two’s magic and skill.
Not everyone could discover his spirit body like the Sword Saint.
And if the Sword Saint could find him, it only meant he was still not strong enough.
Once he became powerful enough, presumably even the Sword Saint would never be able to notice him!
Ding Ling placed their bodies into the Storage Pouch, their True Qi surging, in the future could go to Otherworldly Space for refining, better not waste.
He continued deeper into the lava pool, following the path previously taken, arriving at a dark territory.
Now his eyesight is incomparable to the past. This time he looked clearly, indeed many monstrous beasts were hiding here, but most were neither human, nor ghost, nor demon.
Ding Ling captured one, explored carefully.
Enlightened:

"These monsters might be Ancient Celestial Soldiers. They are in charge of guarding here. But they invariably were gradually influenced into demonization, each of their bodies starting to mutate, becoming so demonic."
Ding Ling sighed.
One by one he killed these Celestial Soldier and Demon.
Letting them out would be a disaster to Jiuzhou of the Human World, Ding Ling naturally wouldn’t do such a thing.
Continuing deeper.
Arrived at that special Tai Chi Yin Yang Array.
Ding Ling once again saw those eight Qilin Eggs and that coffin.
This time Ding Ling directly chose to go forward and opened the coffin, boom! In the next instant, rolling Demon Qi mixed with a gust of demonic wind rushed into his body.
"You brat! You dare to return. This time I will kill you!"
Chiyou’s Demon Soul manifested before Ding Ling’s chest.
This Demon Soul was his main soul.
Much stronger than his Soul Division:

"Paradise has roads you don’t walk, and hell has no doors you charge in, hahaha, you wouldn’t think that destroying my Soul Division could contend with my main soul, would you? This time you dared to directly open the coffin sealing me, truly heaven is helping me. Brat, die!"

chapters.title: Chapter 743 - 732: Reincarnated as a Child
paragraphs: Chiyou transformed into a demon god form with three heads, six arms, eight legs, a human body, and cow hooves.
Like an iron plow tilling the land, he charged violently towards the depths of Ding Ling’s inner world:
"This time, I’m going to completely shatter your heart! Make you truly serve me!"
He stamped down with his cow hooves.
Various breaking arrays, shattering true intents flowed beneath his hooves, as if they could crush everything.
This was a skill attached to the Demon Scripture and War God Technique!
Ding Ling knew it too.
Therefore, he didn’t fear in the slightest, just raised his eyebrows slightly, shook his head, and said:
"Fool’s dream."
Before the words could land.
With a thought.
The sword spirit flashed, almost like instant teleportation, appearing in front of Chiyou in an instant, and without thinking, slashed a hand blade towards him!
Ten Tribulations of the Evil King!
Reincarnation of the Six Paths!

Crackling! As soon as this sword technique was unleashed, amidst the crackling and blazing light, a Reincarnation Blade Intent spun forward, seemingly slow but actually fast, everything in its path appeared to be frozen, leaving Chiyou with no room to dodge or escape!
In just a moment, he was ensnared solidly!
In the next instant, visibly, Chiyou’s demon god form was instantly pulled back to human form, rapidly shrinking into a baby form within just two breaths.
"How is this possible?!"
Chiyou was shocked, terrified, and in disbelief:
"What is this skill?! Why does it seem familiar?!"
His voice was incredibly childish, like a child’s voice.
Ding Ling was also secretly shaken, this full-level Reincarnation of the Six Paths was even more formidable than he imagined!
Indeed, the complete version of the Reincarnation of the Six Paths is not just a bit stronger than the incomplete version; it’s a world of difference!
No wonder Chiyou couldn’t resist it. If it were Ding Ling, without a skill of the same level, he would also have difficulty resisting it!
"It’s the Great Evil King’s sword skill from the Demon Realm!"
Chiyou’s body trembled, as if a bolt of lightning flashed through his sea of consciousness, and in an instant, he seemed to recall many things from the past, staring wide-eyed, terrified:

"How do you know the Great Evil King’s sword skill? I clearly remember the Great Evil King said this sword skill is extremely sinister and outstanding, even he couldn’t achieve Great Perfection. How could you cultivate this sword skill to perfect blade intent, with Reincarnation Tribulation Qi flowing freely! Even the Great Evil King couldn’t do it!"
He fell into the ’void’.
With a delicate and exquisite appearance, short hands and legs, he looked like a little blessing boy.
At this moment, his large eyes were wide open, filled with a sense of shock and incredulity, looking somewhat comical.
There was a temptation to pinch his cheek.
But Ding Ling’s heart was as hard as stone, unmoved, without unnecessary words, just coldly continuing to slash forward.
Reincarnation of the Six Paths!
The Reincarnation Blade Intent once again enveloped Chiyou!
Chiyou’s body began to shrink again.
This time he shrank from the size of a blessing boy rapidly into an embryo, and eventually, even his entire being completely vanished.
"Dead?!
Ding Ling carefully scanned around.
Indeed, he was dead.
Dead silently.
Extremely bizarre!
Reincarnation ended in emptiness!
Completely extinguished!
Only a faint childish wail resonated in all directions:
"Ding Ling, I surrender, don’t kill me~"
"You’re quite good at acting."
Chiyou’s attitude before and after was too drastically different.
But as a generation of demon gods, unbothered even if the sky falls, that was his true nature.
The so-called facade was all pretend.
Ding Ling’s Observing People Skill was at full level, now in the First-Grade Golden Core Realm, he saw through Chiyou’s thoughts at a glance, so why heed his words?
Perhaps at the moment of final extinction, Chiyou was indeed terrified.
But as fated enemies, why would Ding Ling show mercy?

Ding Ling shook his head, returned his consciousness, opened his eyes, and looked towards the coffin. Perhaps because the main soul had died, this body that was once shining with life suddenly dimmed, appearing like a deadwood without essence or soul.
But to be safe.
Ding Ling still stepped forward, hovering the body in the air, activating Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, Demon Scripture, Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, and Heaven and Earth Righteous Qi Curse.
Refining Demonic Qi.
Purifying the demonic body.
Creak creak!
In just a moment, Chiyou’s demonic body began to crack inch by inch, and in another moment, completely shattered into a puff of smoke that dissipated.
"The demon god Chiyou has returned to dust and dirt, completely extinguished."
Is there any chance to see Chiyou again in the future?
Ding Ling wasn’t sure.
But he’s heard that there’s a Chiyou in the Primordial World.
Perhaps when seeing Chiyou again, that Chiyou might be an unparalleled hero of the Witch Race?
To this.
Ding Ling didn’t know.
The Chiyou he knew was through history, novels, dramas, stories, and TV series.
Therefore, the specific image was uncertain.
"Now it’s time for these Qilin Eggs."
Ding Ling turned around and walked to the Qilin Eggs.
There were a full eight of them.
He placed his hand on them.
The Demon Scripture absorbed the Demon Qi.
The Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell purified the Demon Qi.
Xuanyuan Heart Scripture and War God Technique absorbed and refined the strength of divinity.
Very soon.
The divinity of one Qilin Egg was completely absorbed.
Ding Ling’s War God Spirit Body condensed further.
It could now transfer from the kidney to the spleen.

Now all five parts of the heart, liver, spleen, lungs, and kidneys could transfer freely, making it difficult for an ordinary person to lock onto the War God Spirit Body, greatly enhancing Ding Ling’s survivability.
He then absorbed the divine power from the second Qilin Egg.
Very soon.
The War God Spirit Body could transfer from the spleen to the left hand.
The third egg, right hand.
The fourth egg, left leg; the fifth egg, right leg.
The sixth egg, back; seventh egg, dantian; eighth egg, brow.
After all the divinity of the Qilin Eggs was absorbed.
Ding Ling’s War God Spirit Body seemed to transform and ascend once more, becoming radiant, and condensed as a realistic living form, almost like a smaller version of Ding Ling.
Compared to the previously hazy and unreal spirit body.
Now the spirit body could rival the sword spirit, walking in the void unnoticed, one might think it was a smaller version of Ding Ling.
"Excellent."
Ding Ling was very satisfied.
With this War God Spirit Body.
Who can kill him?!
Even if dismembered!
As long as he protects one leg from destruction, he can return reborn!
This is the formidable aspect of the War God Technique.
"The energy in these Qilin Eggs is extremely abundant. The energy in one egg is enough to create a Grandmaster. Although it’s inferior to dragon eggs, the quantity is enough."
Ding Ling pondered:
"The Grandmaster level energy is useless to me. I can grant it to others. Oh yes."
Ding Ling suddenly thought of the two Ferghana Horses.
These two horses are ordinary horses, and since he can fly and traverse the earth as usual, he no longer rides them.
Thus, they became dispensable, kept and raised near Luoyang by designated caretakers.
Now seeing these Qilin Eggs.
He suddenly remembered the scenes in Nine Void Realm where the two horses desperately protected him.

Like an iron plow tilling the land, he charged violently towards the depths of Ding Ling’s inner world:
"This time, I’m going to completely shatter your heart!
Make you truly serve me!"
He stamped down with his cow hooves.
Various breaking arrays, shattering true intents flowed beneath his hooves, as if they could crush everything.
This was a skill attached to the Demon Scripture and War God Technique!
Ding Ling knew it too.

chapters.title: Chapter 744 - 733: Dragon Spirit
paragraphs: "These two horses have accompanied me through several worlds, and they are extremely fond of me, trusting me, regarding me as their master. Moreover, they are quite intelligent. It would be a real pity to let them go."
Ding Ling decided to feed the eight Qilin Eggs to the two Ferghana Horses.
He still did not believe it.
With the eight Qilin Eggs consumed.
The two Ferghana Horses would surely undergo an astonishing transformation.

"After all, the Qilin Eggs are useless to me and to Little Zhao. Besides, if I return to the Lower Realm, I can’t bring anything but a set of clothes. I can’t give them to Diao Chan or Little Dragon Girl either. Thus, it can only be given to the Ferghana Horses."
As for giving them to Nie Feng, Lü Bu, and others?
Ding Ling did not consider it.
He has already opened the Royal Armory, Medicine Warehouse, and Armory to these court ministers who have accomplished meritorious deeds.
They can exchange their merits for the Treasure Manual, Secret Technique, Great Medicine, Divine Weapon, and more!
If he were to show favor to Nie Feng, other ministers would surely have opinions.
Thus, it is better to give it to his mount.
After all, the mount can accompany him across the heavens, and perhaps in the future, it could still be of use.
Just like last time.
If it weren’t for the Ferghana Horses fighting desperately to protect him, he might have been eaten by wolves, tigers, and leopards.
Who can guarantee a lifetime of smooth sailing without an accident?
Ding Ling, though blessed, cannot guarantee that.
So having two intelligent Ferghana Horses by his side is somewhat of a safeguard.
Thinking of this.
Ding Ling calmed his mind, then grabbed the eight Qilin Eggs and walked out.
He did not return the same way, but walked along the path he had previously taken, reaching the portal on the surface of the array within the cave.
Whoosh whoosh!
Indeed, the next moment, the array tried to absorb his True Qi.
But this time, Ding Ling’s Dantian is as stable as Mount Tai.

A First-Grade Golden Core sits in the Dantian, its aura unwavering, and after the array absorbed for a moment without success, it started to tremble violently. Ding Ling smiled lightly, proactively injecting True Qi, just a bit, and BOOM!
The portal seemed satisfied and instantly opened.
Ding Ling immediately stepped in.

This time Ding Ling’s cultivation compared to when he first came is like day and night! When he first came here, he was only a Grandmaster, but now he has entered the Martial Dao First-Grade Golden Core Realm, becoming an unparalleled existence that can easily extinguish Grandmasters!
It’s already incomparable!
Thus.

His current strand of True Qi can easily open the portal, unlike before where a lot of cultivation had to be leaked. Now only a wisp is lost, which to him is almost no loss; with a slight operation of Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, it quickly recovers.
"It’s a cross-space tunnel."
Ding Ling secretly marveled, greatly admiring the person who set up this array.
No one could construct such an ingenious suppressive array without a solid foundation in array, forging skills, mechanical skill expertise, and more.
Exiting the cross-space tunnel.
Thud!
Lands on flat ground.
Surveyed the surroundings.
Indeed, it’s still the old place.
Stone sculptures are placed all around, with a hundred-meter-long stone dragon at the center.
At the end of the stone dragon is the Dragon Vein.
Unlike the first time.
This section of the Dragon Vein is surrounded by the Eight Array Map.
Ding Ling stepped directly into the Eight Array Map and took the Dragon Vein out.
This time his cultivation is far superior to before, by dozens if not hundreds of times!
So, he easily glimpsed a peculiar space within the Dragon Vein.
"A Dragon Spirit?"
Ding Ling’s eyes ablaze as the Sword Spirit stepped out of his body, and the next moment entered the inner space of the Dragon Vein.
Inside, half is filled with powerful Righteous Qi, surging and majestic;
The other half is a torrent of Demonic Qi, changing shape like a storm, seemingly roaring and growling;
In the center of the Righteous Qi, a small dragon is controlling the Righteous Qi, constantly wearing down the Demonic Qi.
The arrival of Sword Spirit startled it, and it unsteadily controlled the Righteous Qi, causing it to scatter, but it quickly stabilized, casting a somewhat uncertain glance at Sword Spirit.
The intention in its eyes is clear: ’Who are you, and how did you enter the deepest space of the Dragon Vein?!’
"I am the Jiuzhou Human Emperor."
Sword Spirit solemnly spoke, the voice echoing like a bell, loud and strong:
"The master of the Mortal Interface!"
"So it’s the arrival of the Human Emperor."
Dragon Spirit is very respectful:
"Little Dragon is unable to split its attention, please forgive me."
"Since you have a spirit, would you be willing to leave this place?"
"Little Dragon is naturally willing."
Dragon Spirit’s eyes brighten, but seeing the raging storm-like Demonic Qi ahead, it becomes disheartened:
"I must eradicate this Demonic Qi."
"I can help you."
"Oh?"
Initially Dragon Spirit is happy but soon becomes disbelieving, questioning:
"Demonic Qi overflowed from the Demon Realm, the most difficult negative Qi to deal with in the world. Anyone contaminated by even a trace will turn into a relentless demon, only knowing slaughter.
If Divine Beasts are contaminated by traces, their bloodline gets polluted, eventually turning into Demon Beasts.
Even Ancient Divine Beings if contaminated, will inevitably fall into the Demon Dao.
What makes you dare to boast such words?"
"Just watch."
Sword Spirit said, without wasting words, slightly closing its eyes.
Immediately begin contacting his true form.
Both unite strength, preparing to refine the Demonic Qi.
BOOM!
Sword Spirit leaps into the ocean of Demonic Qi, allowing it to envelop its body.
Dragon Spirit is shocked:
"Don’t! It’s dangerous!"
It turned into a stream of light, wanting to pull Sword Spirit, but Sword Spirit stopped it:
"Rest assured, just watch!"
This is the second time Sword Spirit said this.
Dragon Spirit, doubtful yet alert, retreated, its large dragon eyes fixed on Sword Spirit’s actions, without blinking.
BOOM!
Sword Spirit cleaved a hand knife into the Ink Sea formed by concentrated Demonic Qi!
The next moment!
Ink Sea churned, forcibly split a deep ’knife path’!
On both sides of this knife path, the Demonic Qi transformed into tornadoes, shot up to the sky, and injected into the unknown void depth.
And the endpoint of this void depth is Ding Ling’s true form’s arm.
Ding Ling’s palm opened, facing the Dragon Vein, frantically absorbing and refining the Demonic Qi.
He suddenly felt this was unfair.
Because if the Demonic Qi was refined in the Otherworldly Space, his cultivation could grow; here, refining means just refining, with no cultivation gain, incredibly uneconomical.
Thinking this way, Ding Ling temporarily stopped refining.
Instead, he took the Dragon Vein and left the cavern.
Swish!
The next moment.
He appeared before Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang, both still guarding the Dragon Vein without leaving their post!
Being just, selfless, loyal like this.
Ding Ling greatly admired them.
Thus he wanted to meet with them before leaving, lest they be scared half to death due to the loss of the Dragon Vein.
"Your Majesty!"
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann were shocked to see Ding Ling, then quickly knelt down to greet Ding Ling:
"Long live Our Emperor, long live, long long live!"
The fact that Ding Ling is the Human Emperor.
They also now know.
After all, they have yet to reach the Grain Avoidance Realm.

chapters.title: Chapter 745 - 734: Return to Otherworldly Space
paragraphs: Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang also need to eat.
Before, one of them would go buy food while the other guarded the place.
And now?
Duann Lang and Nie Feng have arranged for several people to deliver food and clothes.
So, the two of them are eating much better than before.
It’s precisely because there are people coming and going,
they know quite clearly about the outside world.
Initially, they were shocked by Ding Ling’s quick unification of the world, but after hearing the food delivery people talk endlessly about it, they became numb.
Among the young food delivery people, two are Aliens.
To win the job of delivering food, the competition among the Aliens was extremely fierce; they desperately wanted to latch onto Ding Ling.
But they couldn’t even see Ding Ling, how could they latch on?
They could only turn to Nie Feng and Duann Lang, those of the next tier.
And if Nie Feng and Duann Lang were hard to latch onto, what could be done?
Naturally, they would latch onto the fathers’ legs; as long as they could cling to Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann, wouldn’t benefits follow?
Wouldn’t they become Innate Experts?! By then, beating up a hundred people in reality would just be like playing!
With this mindset, the competition for ’food delivery’ almost led to fights several times.

The chosen Aliens, or rather the players, were fans of Ding Ling, worshipping him to their core, so while chatting with Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang, they naturally included many of Ding Ling’s deeds.
Initially, Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang were quite interested and gave the players many benefits, which made them ecstatic and collect various information about Ding Ling.
But after nearly a year of listening,
Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang naturally became somewhat numb.
Though numb, upon truly meeting Ding Ling, they were instinctively shocked, respectful.
They couldn’t be anything but respectful.

The Aliens depicted Ding Ling as unparalleled in heaven and unique on earth, plus Ding Ling was indeed the Jiuzhou Human Emperor, the ’direct superior’ of their sons; they felt immense pressure, how could they not be respectful?
"Rise without ceremony."
Ding Ling waved his hand, a breeze arose out of nowhere, effortlessly lifting the two up, making them stand without control.
Nie Renwang and Marshal Duann were shocked, thinking, "It’s only been a year. How has Your Majesty become so strong! This speed of progress in cultivation is too terrifying!"
Earlier, they could perceive some of Ding Ling’s cultivation.
Now, they can’t even perceive it clearly!
As if before them stands not merely a person, but a mountain towering into the clouds, an endless ocean!
Facing Ding Ling.
They feel so small, as if Ding Ling blowing a breath could extinguish them!
"I have taken away the Dragon Vein."
Ding Ling spoke concisely:
"You should go report to Duann Lang and Nie Feng. Formally return to the court, become Generals in the human world, and contribute to the world’s stability!"
"Yes, Your Majesty!"
Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang dared not defy the order:
"We humbly obey the sacred order and will return to the court today!"
"Good."
Ding Ling turned and walked with the wind:
"We shall meet again in court one day!"
Whoosh!
Ding Ling’s appearance was abrupt, but his disappearance was even quicker.
The two only saw rays of red light like meteor showers streaking across the sky, and in the next moment, Ding Ling had completely vanished.
"Was that just now...?"
"An egg?!"
Marshal Duann was wide-eyed:
"I didn’t see wrong, did I? It was an egg, right?!"
"It was indeed an egg!"
Nie Renwang confirmed.
"How could there be such a big egg! Where did Your Majesty find it?!"
Marshal Duann and Nie Renwang exchanged glances, once again falling into confusion and bewilderment.
Ding Ling returned to Luoyang.
After meeting Little Zhao, he ordered the Ferghana Horses to be brought over and personally fed them a Qilin Egg.
They were too weak.
Even with Ding Ling placing his hand on their backs and other areas to help them digest the Qilin Egg. After consuming half each, they still struggled and fell into a deep sleep.
An astonishing aura began to slowly emanate from their bodies.
As for when they will wake up.
It is completely unknown.
Ding Ling looked at the remaining seven eggs.
After having Little Zhao watch over them momentarily, he directly took two Dragon Eggs to the Otherworldly Space in the Western Realm to find the Female Drought Demon again.
The Female Drought Demon was surprised at his quick arrival:
"Can you deal with the Demon Emperor now?"
"I am not confident."
Ding Ling said:
"So, I need to enhance myself."
As he spoke, Ding Ling began absorbing the Spiritual Vitality from the Dragon Eggs.
[Inner Power Value +10]
[Inner Power Value +10]
Ding Ling’s cultivation and power began rising again.
The Spiritual Vitality in a Dragon Egg was too rich.
Sufficient to create a Shattering Level Perfection expert.
But for Ding Ling.
It only increased by...
[Inner Power Value +900]
Directly increased by 3 drops of True Water.
[True Power Value: 224 points]
This is because the quality of the Spiritual Vitality in the Dragon Eggs is very high, almost equivalent to Martial Arts Golden Core Level experts.
Know that Limu and other Golden Core Level experts only gave Ding Ling about 1200 points of Inner Power Value.
And now Ding Ling’s strand of True Qi,
which is a strand formed by 100 points of Inner Power Value, is enough to easily annihilate a Grandmaster.
One can imagine, the majestic True Qi of a Grandmaster, in terms of quality, weight, level, True Intent, etc., is completely incomparable to Ding Ling’s True Qi.
This is also why the Grandmaster’s True Qi and Qilin Egg are useless to Ding Ling today.
With the ’Qi’ being on different levels and differing too vastly, Ding Ling refining it is not very beneficial, or refining it has no effect at all.
To put it clearly, the Grandmaster’s Qi is like tofu, Ding Ling’s Qi is like a Divine Weapon!
"Let’s do another one."
[Inner Power Value +900]
Refined another Dragon Egg.
[True Power Value: 227 points]
Ding Ling grew stronger.
The pressure emanating from around him began causing the vacuum to wrinkle.
Ding Ling took out the shells of Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi, continuing to absorb their True Qi.
[Inner Power Value +200]
[Inner Power Value +70]
Xiaao Sanxiaao’s Shattered Great Perfection Level provided 200 points. Its refining level was extremely high, stronger than the usual Shattered Great Perfection.
Besides.
His True Qi contained an immortal Divine Power!
This belonged to the Qi of the Auspicious Beast Dragon Turtle.
Ding Ling used the War God Technique to extract this Divine Power from his bloodline for his own use.
As this Divine Power was completely extracted! Absorbed, refined.
Ding Ling’s War God Spirit Body grew stronger again.
From a mere two feet in stature, it increased to two and a half feet tall.
This showed the density of the Divine Power in Xiaao Sanxiaao’s bloodline!
Calling him a walking Dragon Turtle would not be excessive.

chapters.title: Chapter 746 - 735: Forging the Blade Again
paragraphs: Xiaao Sanxiaao actually swallowed the essence blood of a Dragon Turtle alive.
Otherwise, there wouldn’t be so much Divine Power gathered in the bloodline.
Ding Ling felt relieved in his heart.
With a flick of his fingers, he shattered the bodies of Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi into mist.
He kept Xiaao Sanxiaao and Wu Wudi to absorb their True Qi for his own use.
Now that their value had been exhausted, there was naturally no need to keep their bodies.
Afterward.
Ding Ling took out the Dragon Vein, and together with the Sword Spirit, began to absorb and refine the surging Demonic Energy.
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
There was too much Demonic Energy accumulated in the Dragon Vein.
It’s been accumulated over thousands of years.
Although it had been worn down by the vast Righteous Qi for the most part.
The remaining small part was still like a vast ocean, raging endlessly!
After Ding Ling began refining the Demonic Energy with the Sword Spirit.
His strength began to rise rapidly.
[Inner Power Value +330]
In a moment.
Combined with the previous True Qi, two drops of True Water appeared in his Dantian.
His strength ascended to another level.
[True Power Value: 229 points]
"Continue."
Ding Ling closed his eyes to cultivate, his aura becoming more and more overwhelming and boundless.
Xiong Ba watched in shock.
The Female Drought Demon was also amazed, but she was psychologically prepared for this and was not overly shocked, just moved:

"It seems Ding Ling can indeed freely digest and refine Demonic Energy. I must let him enter the Demon Realm again, cultivate to the extreme, and then cooperate with me to obliterate the Demon Emperor."
Without a certain level of cultivation.

The Female Drought Demon dared not let Ding Ling act rashly. After all, the strength of the Demon Emperor was extraordinary, and if Ding Ling were to fall in the Demon Realm, Jiuzhou would have no hope left.
Now the Female Drought Demon is betting all her ’assets’ and hopes on Ding Ling.
If Ding Ling dies.
She would definitely not live long either.
But she would bear more pressure, and seeing no hope, her heart would turn to ash, leading to gradual decline and extinction.
"Ding Ling... the last ray of hope!"
[Inner Power Value +1]
[Inner Power Value +1]
Streams of Demonic Energy gathered into a tornado storm, swirling towards the void of the Earth Realm.
The Sword Spirit stood in the Ink Sea, with a solemn expression, slicing down again and again as if cutting and integrating the Demonic Energy, gathering it into tornadoes to soar into the sky.
The Demonic Energy vanished completely.
As if it had been entirely refined.
The Dragon Spirit watched in awe, amazed as if seeing a ’Celestial God’!
"So strong. How is it done?!"
It previously questioned the Human Emperor, but now realized its ignorance, knowing it was senseless.
This Jiuzhou Human Emperor was overwhelmingly powerful, beyond comprehension.

"I’ve seen quite a few Jiuzhou Human Emperors. After the Three Emperors and Five Kings, only a few like Emperor Qin Shi Huang and Li Shimin caught my eye! But now it’s not about whether he catches my eye, it’s about whether he thinks I’m worthy!"
The disparity was too vast.
Like the difference between clouds and mud! More like a feather versus Mount Tai!
Completely unmatched, as if separated by heaven and earth, not in the same league.
"Comparing with past Human Emperors, this new Emperor is frighteningly powerful."
The Dragon Spirit admired greatly, its dragon eyes fixed on the Sword Spirit.
Whoosh!
The Ink Sea in the Dragon Vein Space was dwindling at a speed visible to the naked eye.
[Inner Power Value +100]
[Inner Power Value +100]
Once Ding Ling was familiar with the refining process, he almost devoured it all like a whale.
The True Power Value began to surge wildly. After refining all the Demonic Energy.
An additional 20 drops of True Water appeared in his Dantian.
[True Power Value: 249 points]
Adding to the previous ones, he gained over 21 drops of True Water.
This was an extremely terrifying amount.
You should know, a single stream of True Qi from Ding Ling can easily pierce and obliterate a Grandmaster.
A drop of True Water can effortlessly erase a Shattering Level master!
A full 21 drops.
Just the added amount alone can wipe out a large group of Shattering Level masters.
This illustrates.

The abundance of Demonic Energy in the Dragon Vein has reached an alarming and terrifying level. If this Dragon Vein were to explode, releasing Demonic Energy, not only would it spawn a huge demon, but it would also birth increasingly cruel, selfish, crazed, bloodthirsty Human Demons!
And these Human Demons might not even realize they’ve entered demonhood.
Others might not know either.
This is the terror of a Dragon Vein bursting.
"Is this the Dragon Vein of the human realm?"
The voice of the Female Drought Demon whizzed by his ear.
Clearly, she saw through Ding Ling, who had fully refined the Demonic Energy in the Dragon Vein.
Ding Ling opened his eyes and nodded: "Indeed."
"Excellent."
The Female Drought Demon smiled slightly:

"Now, only the raging Righteous Qi remains in this Dragon Vein. If you use it to perform the Heaven and Earth Righteous Qi Curse, it will surely be twice as effective! You should now refine this Dragon Vein well and make it your Magical Treasure. By relying on it, you can traverse the Demon Realm unhindered. And even using it to confront the Demon Emperor, it will be much easier for us."
"Yes. Senior."
Ding Ling responded, then asked:
"This Dragon Vein is relatively weak. I don’t know how to make it stronger."

"You are the world’s top Caster. Perhaps you can forge a layer of defensive metal around the Dragon Vein’s surface, or you might try merging the Dragon Vein with your weapons. The Dragon Vein thrives on the Righteous Qi and Dragon Spirit within, where the Dragon Spirit is, is where the Dragon Vein lies..."
The Female Drought Demon offered a suggestion.
Ding Ling remembered it in his heart.
Once again exiting the Otherworldly Space.
Heading to Luoyang to forge a saber.
This time, the disciples of Iron Heart Island, including Iron God, Huaikong, Huaimie, Bai Ling, etc., gathered again as assistants to help Ding Ling forge a new weapon.
Ding Ling gathered the Great Evil King, Celestial Destiny Saber, Dragon Vein, and Human Emperor Saber to begin merging.
This time took longer and was extremely difficult.

Fortunately, this realm restrains the Great Evil King and Celestial Destiny Saber’s explosion of absolute power, while Ding Ling can easily amplify himself tenfold, allowing him to easily subdue the two sabers from start to finish.
And the Dragon Spirit within the Dragon Vein was wholeheartedly convinced by Ding Ling as the Human Emperor, cooperatively forging together the new Human Emperor Saber.
This forging process.
Took a full eighty-one days.
When the new Human Emperor Saber was born, heaven and earth changed color.
An astonishing sword aura manifested over Luoyang, subdued heroes and champions across Jiuzhou.
"What is that?!"
Emperor Shitian was fishing outside Chang’an City when he saw the unparalleled, unmatched saber gleam from Luoyang, sucking in a breath of cold air, feeling a toothache:

"My god! Does Ding Ling have to be so exaggerated?! The saber he forged previously was already strong enough. And now to actually forge an even stronger saber? With this saber’s support, Ding Ling is definitely a force to be reckoned with; who can challenge him then?!"
He shook his head, and the idea of lying low and not standing out became increasingly stronger.

chapters.title: Chapter 747 - 736: Journeying Through Realms to Learn Techniques
paragraphs: Emperor Shitian had not received any news of Xiaao Sanxiaao for several months.
He was unsure whether Xiaao Sanxiaao had died.
However, his subordinates had reported that Mud Bodhisattva had disappeared, leaving a message before vanishing: ’Human Emperor Invincible!’
"Human Emperor Invincible?"
Emperor Shitian pondered:
"It must be referring to Ding Ling."
Emperor Shitian also understood the Divination Skill.
Yet he refrained from using it.
For he had witnessed the power of Celestial Punishment, and having lived long enough, he wished not to entangle himself with such inescapable matters.
"It seems Xiaao Sanxiaao’s scheme with Mud Bodhisattva and others against Ding Ling has failed. Likely Xiaao Sanxiaao has perished as well. The passing of such an elder is truly unexpected."
Emperor Shitian shook his head, sighing:
"They have lived so long. How can they not let go of their sons’ life and death? Even I, Emperor Shitian, have had sons but moved on..."
He gazed towards Luoyang:
"When will Ding Ling shatter the void? I’ve waited so long that the flowers have wilted!"
For over a thousand years, he had passed the time similarly.
Emperor Shitian didn’t feel the time was long.
But now, over the course of a year,
he was most impatient with the waiting.
Such is human nature.
With anticipation comes the longing to fulfill aspirations quickly.
Without achievement, day-to-day waiting becomes painful.
"Human Emperor Saber."
Ding Ling observed the Treasure Saber in hand, well pleased.
The newly forged Human Emperor Saber not only bore the weight and sharp elegance of the Celestial Destiny Saber but also the mysteriousness, Supreme Yin, and Demon Dao of the Great Evil King;
Incorporating the grandeur and righteous pressure of the Dragon Vein.
Integration of righteousness and evil.
Combining Yin and Yang, Tai Chi Eight Trigrams in perfection!
Furthermore, the Dragon Spirit hidden within the blade bestowed the saber with a ’spirit’!
"This is truly a Supreme Divine Saber."
Iron God’s heart trembled: "I have witnessed the birth of a Divine Saber!"
"Indeed."
Huaikong, Huaimie, Bai Ling and others gazed at Ding Ling with reverence:
"Congratulations, Your Majesty!"
"Haha..."
Ding Ling laughed three times, saying:
"Following me in forging the saber counted as three merits, later let the personnel department note it down for you."
"Thank you, Your Majesty!"
Huaikong, Huaimie and others felt joyful, expressing gratitude again.

Ding Ling smiled faintly, holding the Human Emperor Saber, took a step and vanished from the spot. In the next moment, he appeared in the Imperial Palace, entrusted Little Zhao to care for the physical form, then wielded the saber to cleave through the Nine Void Realm.
His mind pondered on learning Wu Wudi’s Magic and Skill.
Thus.
The next instant.
He arrived at a cave, witnessing Wu Wudi practicing Ten Strong Martial Dao, Black Tortoise True Skill.
Even techniques he hadn’t studied, the Ten Directions Invincible Guarding Technique, Annihilation Technique, Kill Technique were all demonstrated.
Ding Ling observed them all.
[Ten Directions Invincible Guarding Technique Full Level]
[Ten Directions Invincible Annihilation Technique Full Level]
[Strongest Ten Dao Full Level]
[Heavenless Sword Tiger Technique Full Level]
Ding Ling comprehensively understood Wu Wudi’s Magic and Skills here and achieved full level mastery of each.
He grasped the Ten Directions Invincible Guarding Technique, Kill Technique, and Annihilation Technique.
Ding Ling’s application of techniques became more skillful and at ease, reaching the pinnacle of finesse.
Although Ten Directions Invincible isn’t comparable to Ten Tribulations of the Evil King.
Yet its technique application and subtleties have unique, profound aspects.
Having learned these techniques, Ding Ling could perfectly unleash the power of his First-Grade Golden Core, making it harder for peers at the same level to resist him.

Regarding Heavenless Sword Tiger Technique, this involves the unification of five weapons along with fists, palms, legs, claws, fingers, encompassing the essence of Ten Strong Martial Dao, embodying unbounded transformation.
Understanding Wu Wudi’s entire legacy.
Ding Ling then contemplated learning ’Xiaao Sanxiaao’s’ Magic and Skills.
Thus the next moment, he disappeared from this space-time, heading to another space-time realm.
Meanwhile, practicing martial arts in the cave, Wu Wudi slightly felt as if someone was secretly observing him, experiencing confusion and bewilderment:
"Was it a hallucination just now? Why do I feel like someone is clandestinely spying on me?!"
He scanned around, searched carefully without results, feeling baffled:
"I’m so strong already. Can I still have illusions?!"
Ding Ling arrived at a farmstead.
Xiaao Sanxiaao, with short hair and beard, practiced martial arts here.
Ding Ling comprehended it thoroughly.
This was the demonstration of Ten Thousand Dao Forest.
Different from the Ten Thousand Dao Forest of Patriarch Xiaao Aoshi.
Xiaao Sanxiaao’s Ten Thousand Dao Forest harnessed stronger ’Dao’!
Such as the Fire Dao;
Dao of Profound Yin;
Dao of Annihilation;
Dao of Frenzied Thunder; Dao of Frost and Snow; Dao of Spring and Autumn...
A myriad of varied Dao.
Ding Ling witnessed all, instantly achieving full level mastery.
He mused:

"This old guy Xiaao Sanxiaao surely knows plenty. So many Dao, choosing any one could create a Shattering Level expert! But he cultivated all to the Realm of Perfection. What a pity. He encountered me, unable to display his skills before his demise."
There was a vast disparity in realm between Xiaao Sanxiaao and Ding Ling.
Ding Ling overwhelmed him completely; hence he died quickly.
Nevertheless, being defeated by Ding Ling doesn’t denote his Magic and Skill are weak.
Conversely.

In this world, apart from Master of the Celestial Realm Yellow Emperor Xuanyuan, Great Sun Buddha of the Divine Realm, Great Evil King of the Demon Realm, Female Drought Demon of Otherworldly Space, and a few others, no one’s Magic and Skill surpass Xiaao Sanxiaao’s.
Xiaao Sanxiaao’s Magic and Skill had reached the pinnacle of the world, enough to overlook the world, even Emperor Shitian couldn’t rival him.
"Indeed, one of endurance over millennia."
Ding Ling finished observing these Dao.
About to continue, when Xiaao Sanxiaao ceased, uneasily scanning the surroundings, muttering:
"Strange. It feels as though someone is covertly watching me, who could it be? In this heavens and earth, who possesses the capability to spy on me? And yet I only felt it now?!"
"Ah."

Ding Ling, silently surprised, contemplated having upgraded several segments, his prowess significantly enhanced compared to clashing with Twenty-Third Sword earlier, making Sword Saint possibly incapable of seeing him.
Xiaao Sanxiaao was unexpected to have sensed it.
"Is Dragon Turtle’s Sixth Sense at play? Or is Dragon Turtle’s Divine Power meddling?"
Ding Ling pondered:
"To be safe, better to go elsewhere to study Xiaao Sanxiaao’s Magic and Skill."
Next moment.
Ding Ling flipped to the day Great Demon God Xiaao Jingtian was inspecting the ’Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities’ Secret Manual.
Swish!
Xiaao Jingtian flipped through the Secret Manual rapidly.
Ding Ling observed beside him.
After finishing reading.
[Chaotic Heaven Four Extremes Internal Power Heart Method Full Level]
[Chaotic Heaven Four Extremes External Skills Full Level]
Previously he only obtained Chaotic Heaven Demon Dao from Xiaao Aoshi, containing some techniques of Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities. But incomplete.
Now he acquired the complete version of Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities.
Ding Ling not only could perfectly unleash the power of these techniques;
But the accompanying Inner Power Heart Method also allowed him to absorb the essence of heavens and earth, sun and moon.

sentences.text: Emperor Shitian had not received any news of Xiaao Sanxiaao for several months.
He was unsure whether Xiaao Sanxiaao had died.
However, his subordinates had reported that Mud Bodhisattva had disappeared, leaving a message before vanishing: ’Human Emperor Invincible!’
"Human Emperor Invincible?"
Emperor Shitian pondered:
"It must be referring to Ding Ling."
Emperor Shitian also understood the Divination Skill.
Yet he refrained from using it.
For he had witnessed the power of Celestial Punishment, and having lived long enough, he wished not to entangle himself with such inescapable matters.

Likely Xiaao Sanxiaao has perished as well.
The passing of such an elder is truly unexpected."

How can they not let go of their sons’ life and death?
Even I, Emperor Shitian, have had sons but moved on..."

I’ve waited so long that the flowers have wilted!"

he was most impatient with the waiting.
Such is human nature.

Iron God’s heart trembled: "I have witnessed the birth of a Divine Saber!"
"Indeed."

"Haha..."

chapters.title: Chapter 748 - 737: Holy Heart Technique at Full Level
paragraphs: This is a ’Qi Cultivation’ technique.
Directly drawing on the power of the sun and moon for one’s own use, it’s extremely terrifying.

However, for those with a weak physique, it’s impossible to directly draw on the sun’s power, as the True Sun Flame is scorching hot, and absorbing it into the body can easily lead to self-combustion!
Therefore, the Great Demon God absorbs the power of the moon; at night, when the moon is high, is when his power is at its peak.
Ding Ling then, with a leap, in the next moment.
Arrived at the Celestial Gate Void Sacred Realm where Emperor Shitian practices the Holy Heart Technique method.
He carefully watched Emperor Shitian’s demonstration technique.
In an instant.
[Holy Heart Technique Full Level]
This time it was the complete version of the Holy Heart Technique.

It included the Illusion Skill ’Celestial Palace Illusion’, the Holy Heart Four Extremities: Cold Heaven Extremity, Profound Ice Extremity, Ten Thousand Ridges Piercing the Clouds, Emperor Heaven Frenzy Thunder.
And the Four Tribulations of the Holy Heart, the Seven Wonders of the Extremes and other techniques.
These techniques and laws.
Ding Ling mastered them at a glance.

After comprehending all the martial arts esoteric truths of Emperor Shitian, Ding Ling couldn’t help but sigh: Emperor Shitian is someone who accumulated strength over time, with Phoenix Blood protecting him, and not lacking in talent, to have created such a method, he is indeed a talent.
He turned his palm, intending to see if he could subdue this Emperor Shitian.
Only to find this time his action.
The intimidation, oppression, and tearing force of space-time and the Heavenly Dao against him had reached an unprecedented level.
He had a premonition.
Once he acts, he will surely face Celestial Punishment!
Not only him, but other ’Ding Lings’ in other space-times would also suffer Celestial Punishment.
"Why is this?"
After contemplating thoroughly, Ding Ling was both understanding and surprised:
"Could it be due to the time loop?!"
Because of his arrival.
Unknowingly, the river of space-time seemed to have already formed a time loop.
If he forcibly breaks this time loop.

It will definitely cause the world to collapse, the Heavenly Dao to retaliate, space-time to retaliate; if by then he cannot withstand the power of the Sea of Space-Time, the Heavenly Dao, he may be reduced to ashes.
"Why at this time does a time loop form? Could it be..."
Ding Ling looked towards the direction of the Otherworldly Space:
"Is there some change happening in the Sea of Space-Time?"
Ding Ling didn’t know.
But he had a strong premonition.
There must be an astonishing change happening in the Sea of Space-Time.
Otherwise, why would it form a loop now of all times?
"The past me has also become a part of the loop."
Ding Ling shook his head.
Now he was no longer qualified to be called a member of the loop.
Just because if a major change occurs in the Sea of Space-Time.
Although the Nine Void Realm can traverse easily across the world’s dimensions and space-time.
Strictly speaking, it is merely a world attached to the Sea of Space-Time and the real world.
It will change with the Sea of Space-Time.
Ding Ling didn’t find this strange.
"It’s just a pity. I want to go further beyond the time loop, but it seems very difficult."
Ding Ling secretly felt fortunate.
Fortunately, he acted early enough.
If he had split open the Nine Void Realm any later, he might have ended up just staring blankly.
"The Nine Void Realm has undergone major changes."
"For me, many realms are now inaccessible. But for others, this place remains a land of opportunity."
Here, one can see the past and future.
See various exquisite techniques and laws.
Even able to converse with the strongest beings of a particular space-time.
Nine Void Realm.
This world’s mystique has reached an incredible level.
How it came into being is unknown.
One can only say the creation of this world might be due to ’luck’, like someone winning five million, ’fate’ led to its birth.
And such a world.
Perhaps among All Heavens and myriad realms, it’s hard to find another similar one.
"I should head back."
Ding Ling wanted to see his future self.
But in the Nine Void Realm, there was only ’emptiness’.
No image appeared.
He then knew, his future was indeterminate, having transcended beyond this world, so much that even the Nine Void Realm couldn’t provide an accurate answer.
Ding Ling thought of Emperor Shitian and wanted to see where Emperor Shitian was.
But perhaps due to the time loop, or the Nine Void Realm simply not supporting such an endeavor.
Thus, this time again he saw nothing.
"Forget it."
The fusion of Ding Ling’s Sword Spirit and Spirit Body wielded the blade to slice open the Nine Void Realm, returning to his body.
Kom!
As soon as the Sword Spirit entered his body.
Ding Ling suddenly erupted with strands of mysterious aura.
This was the full-level Holy Heart Technique, Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities, Dao of Frost and Snow, Dao of Storms, etc., taking effect.
But soon.
With a single thought from Ding Ling, all the auras returned to himself, becoming complete.
Swish, swish!
In Ding Ling’s perceptive mind.
Flows of light from the library shelves again flowed into the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
These flows of light were transformed from Holy Heart Technique, Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities, etc.
"The secret manual in the Martial Arts Melting Furnace is about to be completed.
Ding Ling calculated, it should take another one or two days.
But the joining of methods like just now’s Holy Heart Technique has made the birth of this secret manual a bit tougher.
Ding Ling wanted this newly born secret manual to become stronger, so he chose to continue reading.
With him forging the blade for eighty-one days.
During this time.
The Imperial Palace had already sent two batches of books.
Each batch consisting of hundreds of thousands of volumes.
Ding Ling spent a few days reading them all.
[Wisdom +0.6]
[Buddha Qi +3 Paths]
Volumes on Music, Chess, Calligraphy, and Painting, medicine, array, mechanical skill, Confucian, Mo Family, Daoist, Buddhist, and other famous school classics, read until full level.
The related flows of light in Ding Ling’s library densely converged into the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
On this day.
More than a dozen various secret manuals emerged from the Martial Arts Melting Furnace.
Each was exceedingly heavy.
As these secret manuals fell onto the library shelves.
The next moment.
[Martial Dao True Understanding Full Level]
[Celestial Patrol Step Full Level]
[Heaven-Flipping Palm Full Level]
[Divine Emperor Fist Full Level]
[Celestial Cry Saber Technique Full Level]
[Breaking Sword Skill Full Level]
[Flowing Light Escape Skill Full Level]
In an instant.
Ding Ling grasped all the esoteric truths and essences of the new methods.
And at this moment.
He clearly understood how powerful the new methods were.
Except for the Martial Dao True Understanding being an Inner Power Heart Method, the others were all skills!
The capability of this Inner Power Heart Method was so strong, it surpassed others’ imagination.
It could not only absorb skills, transform skills, and store skills, but also absorb skills from afar, even the True Qi scattered in void from a deceased person could be absorbed into the Dantian!
Such a method, it’s already as if it belonged to Ghost Gods!
It could also activate a protective shield invisible to the naked eye, beyond others’ perception.
Within this protective shield, water and fire cannot invade, blades and spears cannot penetrate, poison gas cannot corrode!

Unless someone’s cultivation is a whole major realm higher than Ding Ling, or they have cultivated a method similar to the Martial Dao True Understanding in the same realm, they can’t break this protective shield!
As for detoxification, healing, self-healing, and attack reflection, these are just basic abilities.
Its strongest aspect is.
When Ding Ling walks or breathes, ’Martial Dao True Understanding’ can automatically absorb Heaven and Earth Spiritual Mechanism Essence Qi anytime, anywhere to become stronger!
