chapters.title: Chapter 749 - 738: Martial Dao True Understanding
paragraphs: Moreover, the "Martial Dao True Understanding" automatically absorbs and refines that special divine power, transforming Ding Ling’s core constitution, allowing Ding Ling to achieve a ’Divine Bone’ body!
Besides.
Eternal youth, immortality, these are but trifles.
This technique at full level.
Can effortlessly increase lifespan by twenty thousand years!
This is an extremely terrifying number.
One must know that even after Ding Ling absorbed all Dragon Essence, his lifespan only increased by eight thousand years, bringing his total lifespan to twelve thousand years.
Yet, the Martial Dao True Understanding at full level instantly increases his lifespan by twenty thousand years!
"Not only that, the Martial Dao True Understanding can also protect me on the path to becoming a Martial Arts Battle Immortal."
Ding Ling, through the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Learned that above the Martial Arts Primordial Spirit, there are levels like Martial Arts Dharma Aspect and Martial Arts Battle Immortal!
"Battle Immortal?"
Ding Ling eagerly anticipates becoming immortal.
He has already maxed out the Martial Dao True Understanding.
In the future, as long as he continues to absorb ’qi’, he can continuously become stronger.
"The Martial Dao True Understanding can absorb True Qi, Demon Qi, Inner Qi, Medicinal Qi, Spiritual Vitality, and various other types of qi!"
"Basically, any qi in the world can be absorbed and refined by the Martial Dao True Understanding, thereby strengthening oneself!"
With this technique protecting him.
Ding Ling no longer fears venturing into any harsh environment.
Simply because this technique at full level can automatically absorb various qi to supplement oneself, ensuring extremely formidable combat power!
"Not only that, this method can refine the body and assist me all the way to cultivating a Martial Arts Immortal Body!"
War God Technique, Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill, etc., can also refine the body.
But the Dragon Elephant Wisdom Skill can only be practiced to the Shattering Level.

And the War God Technique Ding Ling acquired through Chiyou’s Soul Fragment, with all its magic and skill, can only be used up to the Primordial Spirit Level, beyond which there’s hardly any path for body refining.
But this Martial Arts Immortal Body can directly help Ding Ling break through to an Immortal Physique.
"Refining the body, cultivating qi, and even cultivating the soul, they’re all here."
Soul Cultivation Skill.
Also comes with the Martial Dao True Understanding.

Because Ding Ling has not obtained many ’spiritual’ techniques, the Soul Cultivation Skill, even as it continuously operates with the Martial Dao True Understanding, tempers Ding Ling’s spirit body, making it stronger.
But the progress and efficiency aren’t high.
To enhance the efficiency of soul cultivation.
In the future, more ’soul skills’ must be acquired.

"Another very potent effect of the Martial Dao True Understanding is its ability to endlessly fuse the advantages of various magic and skills, thereby possessing the capabilities of these magic and skills!"
The Martial Dao True Understanding is all-encompassing, just like that!
"Very good."
Ding Ling is extremely satisfied.
With this divine skill protecting him.
He can roam the world.
Who can stand in his way?
"My First-Grade Golden Core is still somewhat weak."

Ding Ling looks at the Tai Chi Bagua First-Grade Golden Core in his dantian, and then at the ever-circulating ’Martial Arts True Qi’ throughout his meridians, knowing he must shatter the core and condense a Martial Arts Golden Core once again!
This time, the Martial Arts Golden Core must be forged with the ’Martial Dao True Understanding’ as its core.
"I must go to the Otherworldly Space and have the older Female Drought Demon guard me."
The main issue is that the human realm’s limit is Shattering Great Perfection, unable to support Ding Ling’s core shattering and condensing.
He can only venture to the Otherworldly Space.
Before leaving.
Ding Ling helps the two Ferghana Horses again, allowing them to devour and digest two Qilin Eggs.
One horse gets one egg.
Previously, each horse had half an egg.
Half a month ago, they awoke, having already drastically transformed.
With prominent features, two Qilin Horns, hooves transformed into Qilin Hooves, sharp claws underfoot, and their bodies covered in some Qilin scales.
They appeared extremely majestic and powerful.

A neighing roar, like a dragon’s cry and a tiger’s howl, intimidated nearby horses, preventing them from approaching, while the horse’s eyes showed reverence and fear, each Royal Horse gazing at the Ferghana Horses as if viewing a ’Divine Horse’!
At this moment.
Each horse consumes a Qilin Egg, once again entering slumber.
It is believed that when they awaken again.
Their bodies will certainly undergo even more astonishing transformations.
"Your Majesty, do you have more busy work ahead?"
Little Zhao’s watery eyes looked at Ding Ling, filled with tender affection:
"You’ve been busy both inside and outside for a year without any proper rest. Shouldn’t you take a break and rest well?"
"Once I finish this period of work, I will accompany you for some good rest."
Ding Ling slightly smiled:
"Rest assured, it won’t be long."
He turned and stepped into the air.
The Flowing Light Escape Skill activated, transforming him into a stream of light, disappearing at Heaven’s Edge in an instant.
"Your Majesty..."
Little Zhao gazed longingly at the direction where Ding Ling vanished, unable to snap out of it for a long time.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Ding Ling seems to transform into a stream of light, covering over ten miles in an instant, akin to a great teleportation.
The friction with air sparked flames.
But soon, Ding Ling operated Martial Dao True Understanding.
The Martial Dao True Understanding automatically ran, and the protective shield opened along with it.
With the protective shield activated.
Ding Ling once again traversed through the void, and no flames were generated, and he moved like a fish swimming leisurely in the ocean as he navigated the heavens.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Like a lightning bolt streaking across the sky.
This time, heading to the Western Realm.
Ding Ling arrived in just an instant.
A thousand miles, it took very little time!
This is the ’Flowing Light Escape Skill’ formed by integrating countless lightweight skills and body techniques!
It’s a skill at the Martial Immortal Level!
As Ding Ling grows stronger.
The power unleashed by this skill will become even greater!
Once Ding Ling ascends to the Martial Immortal, this skill will allow him to become a true beam of light, traversing tens of thousands of miles in an instant!
Of course.
That’s assuming he becomes immortal.
At the very least.
Ding Ling, after maxing out the Flowing Light Escape Skill, deeply feels this.
He knows that the Flowing Light Escape Skill can only truly achieve traveling tens of thousands of miles in an instant when paired with the Martial Dao True Understanding!
But he can’t achieve that now.
Not to mention that the Martial Dao True Understanding has not yet become the core method in the Golden Core.
Ding Ling’s current cultivation is insufficient.
Unable to sustain traversing tens of thousands of miles in an instant, for fear he’d collapse and destroy himself due to insufficient True Qi, Blood Qi, and the like.
So, at this stage, Ding Ling can only use the most basic version of the Flowing Light Escape Skill.

As his strength continues to rise, he will naturally be able to tap into the true ’Flowing Light Esoteric Truth’ of the Flowing Light Escape Skill, transforming into light in an instant, reaching the extreme speed!
"So powerful."
Ding Ling secretly clicked his tongue.

This Flowing Light Escape Skill fuses the essence of the lightweight skill in the Holy Heart Technique, the Thunder and Lightning Esoteric Truth of the Chaotic Heaven Four Extremities, the Sun Chasing Principle of the Kuafu Chasing the Sun Art, and combines the Ripple Step, Soaring in the Void, Ten Thousand Miles Solo, Dragonfly Water-landing, Ascending Skill, Cloud Smoke Flying Evasion Technique, Golden Swan Skill, and various other methods of Dao and principle, all melted together.
Additionally, it draws on some peaceful methods from the Confucian and Daoist schools.
Making the Flowing Light Escape Skill, when paired with the Martial Dao True Understanding, completely devoid of smoke and fire when executed.
If it were just the Flowing Light Escape Skill alone, it wouldn’t be as strong.
It can only be said.
This is a martial art!
Just like the Demon Scripture and the heart technique and skill of the Holy Heart Technique.

chapters.title: Chapter 750 - 739: Shattering the Core
paragraphs: "Strong!"
Ding Ling was very satisfied.

Not just the Flowing Light Escape Skill, but also other skills like the Celestial Patrol Step, Heaven-Flipping Palm, Breaking Technique Sword were all Martial Immortal Level skills that require the Martial Dao True Understanding to unleash their true supreme power.
This is a complete set of martial arts.
Except for the Inner Power Heart Method.
There are also body techniques, stepping techniques, sword techniques, saber techniques, palm techniques, leg techniques, fist techniques, and so on.
Aside from the soul cultivation skill being relatively weak and needing improvement.
The other skills are all Martial Immortal Level.
Think about it.
Ding Ling has traversed many worlds and read countless books, an ocean of them, indeed.
And the essence, esoteric truths of these books have all been integrated into the Martial Dao True Understanding, thus creating this supreme classic manual.

This secret manual contains the Xuanyuan Heart Scripture, Great Sun Buddha Purifying World Spell, the Dao of Fire of the Female Drought Demon, the Dao of Demons of Chiyou, the Ten Tribulations of the Evil King, the martial arts of various worlds, Confucian principles, Buddhist philosophies, Daoist truths, and more!
The potential and upper limit of this Martial Dao True Understanding are extremely high.
Naturally, not something ordinary people can imagine.
One might say, what the future holds for this Martial Dao True Understanding, even Ding Ling does not know.
All because.
This Martial Dao True Understanding is all-encompassing.
In the future, it can continue to absorb and integrate the essence of other martial arts, Daoist and Buddhist principles!
It’s conceivable that if enough is integrated, this Martial Dao True Understanding may undergo another metamorphosis and transformation.
Swoosh!
Ding Ling transformed into a stream of light and appeared before the Female Drought Demon.
The Female Drought Demon was startled:
"What body technique is this? So fast!"
"It’s the Flowing Light Escape Skill."
Ding Ling prepared to pass on this Martial Dao True Understanding to Diao Chan, Little Dragon Girl, and others.
Because if this Martial Dao True Understanding is cultivated to its peak, it can increase lifespan by more than twenty thousand years.
He believed that if Little Dragon Girl and others received his careful instruction and practiced diligently, extending their lifespan to twenty thousand years would not be a problem!
Therefore.
He must pass on this technique.
In the future, the techniques and skills he acquires will only increase, and integrating them into the Martial Dao True Understanding may lead to version updates like 2.0, 3.0, and so on.
The current Martial Dao True Understanding can only be considered version 1.0.
As for this version of the Martial Dao True Understanding, Ding Ling passed it on to the Female Drought Demon without reservation.
Of course, he chose the secret transmission method to teach the Female Drought Demon.
Xiong Ba, who was standing nearby, could not hear.
Regarding the Female Drought Demon, Ding Ling held her in high regard and believed that after learning the Martial Dao True Understanding, she might someday avoid death.
Her ability to avoid death would naturally be best, for such a selfless divine maiden willing to sacrifice herself to save all beings deeply impressed Ding Ling.
Hence, Ding Ling hoped the Female Drought Demon could live.
After hearing the Martial Dao True Understanding, the Female Drought Demon naturally felt Ding Ling’s intentions, and she was quite moved, saying:
"This technique is so strong, you, you, you..."
She was so shocked that for a moment, she couldn’t speak a complete sentence.
Ding Ling smiled:
"If you could use this technique to live longer, wouldn’t that be better for the world?"
"It’s rare for you to think that way."
The Female Drought Demon comforted and said:
"I will carefully comprehend this technique and certainly not disappoint you. But did you come specifically to give me this technique?"
"I still need to shatter the core and then condense it again."
"Shatter the core and condense it."
The Female Drought Demon recalled briefly and realized:
"You feel that the previous technique is too weak compared to the current technique, and want to condense a stronger Golden Core?"
"Indeed."
"Remarkable."
The Female Drought Demon exclaimed:

"You are already a First-Grade Golden Core. If you forge it again, you may recreate the myth of the Saint-Grade Golden Core, such martial arts Golden Core that no one has ever successfully condensed in history. I have only heard my father mention it briefly, saying that in the era of creation, a divine being condensed a Saint-Grade Golden Core. But how many years has it been since the era of creation? These stories have all become legends!
Ding Ling, if you can genuinely forge a Saint-Grade Golden Core.
You will become a living legend!"
The Female Drought Demon stared at Ding Ling with eyes filled with three parts anticipation and seven parts fervor:
"If you can condense a Saint-Grade Golden Core, our chances and probability of defeating the Demon Emperor will greatly increase!"
The more she spoke, the more spirited she became, and she couldn’t help but say:
"I’ll guard you. You go ahead and try."
"Yes, senior."
"If anything goes wrong, I will protect you no matter what, even if it costs me my life!"
The Female Drought Demon said solemnly.
Ding Ling nodded and then closed his eyes, beginning to shatter the core.
His First-Grade Golden Core was extremely solid, and shattering it was almost impossible.
Yet his Martial Dao True Understanding, after reaching full level, naturally gave rise to a strand of unbreakable true qi!
This strand of true qi circulates in the limbs and bones, and with each complete cycle, it becomes thicker.
As this true qi absorbs spiritual vitality, fire qi, demon qi from the otherworldly space, it gradually gathers into a droplet of True Water that seems capable of piercing anything.
This droplet of True Water, under Ding Ling’s control, transformed into a sword that pierced the First-Grade Golden Core with a roar.
The Golden Core trembled slightly, but remained unscathed.
"So hard!"
Ding Ling raised his eyebrows.
It just proves the worth of the First-Grade Golden Core.
If it were any other Golden Core expert, facing Ding Ling’s strand of true qi, they would certainly be pierced and severely injured instantly.
Yet this Golden Core stood firm.
Ding Ling’s First-Grade Golden Core, even among First-Grade ones, could be considered top-notch!
The toughness of such high-quality First-Grade Golden Core, like fine iron or a Divine Weapon, is difficult to break.
Ding Ling could only use water grinding technique to constantly strike and chisel open this First-Grade Golden Core.
Bang, bang, bang!
The True Water born from the Martial Dao True Understanding gathered into a sword and continuously pierced the First-Grade Golden Core.
After a while.
Crack!
Amidst violent trembling, the Golden Core cracked open.
"No wonder it’s True Water from the Martial Dao True Understanding! How extraordinary."
Ding Ling praised.

If True Water can break the defense of a First-Grade Golden Core, then the Golden Core condensed by the Martial Dao True Understanding would be incredibly tough and powerful. When that happens, Ding Ling won’t have to find another method to break it!
So this time, success is the only option.
Bang, bang, bang!
This time, the sword formed by True Water aimed at the gaps and kept striking, amidst cracking sounds, the gaps expanded until finally, there was a bang, and it split into two.
The Golden Core shattered, no longer perfect or complete.
Lacking the kind of natural, flawless true intent.
The shattered Golden Core then became easy to crush.
Under the assault of the True Water.
The broken Golden Core was thoroughly ground to dust after a while.
Then.
Ding Ling began to operate the Martial Dao True Understanding.
Once the Martial Dao True Understanding began operating, it immediately started madly absorbing the qi that flowed wildly in the Dantian, left behind by the shattered Golden Core.
This qi, at a speed visible to the naked eye, condensed into droplets of Martial Dao True Water!
